izzyondroid:com.gallantrealm.modsynth.name: ModSynth
izzyondroid:com.gallantrealm.modsynth.description:
ModSynth is a powerful modular synthesizer allowing construction of complex polyphonic instruments. Connect any number of oscillators, filters, delays and other synthesizer modules in a graphical editor. Adjust the settings of each module while playing the instrument to get a desired sound. Save as many instruments or variants of an instrument as you’d like. Ten built-in instruments are provided to help you get started.
 NOTE: This app is not receiving updates anymore .
 The free version contains the following modules:
 Keyboard
 Pad (for theremin and "scratching" effects)
 Oscillator
 Filter
 Envelope
 Mixer
 Amp
 LFO
 Sequencer
 Delay (echo)
 Output (with scope to see the sound)
 In-app purchase the full version ($5 US) to expand polyphony (from 3 voices to 10), unlock advanced capabilities, and access these additional modules:
 Arpeggiator for sequential playing of the notes in a chord
 Melody for more complex sequences of notes
 MultiOsc for strings and other chorus sounds,
 Unison for more complex chorusing,
 Operator for building FM synthesis,
 PCM for sampled sounds (WAV and SF2 SoundFont files),
 Reverb for simulating room acoustics.
 Crusher for adding digital distortion.
 Compressor to combine all voices and even the sound levels
 Pan to direct sound to either left or right stereo channels.
 SpectralFilter to control the spectrum of a sound with a bank of 25 bandpass filters
 Function module allowing entry of an arithmetic expression for the module’s function
 The full version also provides the ability to record sounds to a WAV file.
 ModSynth has support for external MIDI controllers such as keyboards or DAWs, including mapping of controls to CCs. It has low latency on devices supporting Android low latency. All oscillators are anti-aliased, providing low distortion at higher frequencies.
 A guide to using ModSynth can be found at bjowings.weebly.com/modsynth.html .
 A VST plugin is available to run ModSynth created instruments on VST hosts on Windows. See bjowings.weebly.com/modsynthvst.html for the free download and instructions.

Call Limiter is a simple, open-source Android app that helps you take control of your phone calls. Set time limits for specific contacts and let the app automatically hang up when the limit is reached — making it easy to save time, avoid distractions, and manage conversations better.

fdroid:com.byarchitect.linkstow.name: Linkstow
fdroid:com.byarchitect.linkstow.summary: Unofficial Karakeep client: read, sort and clean up your self-hosted bookmarks
fdroid:com.byarchitect.linkstow.description:
Linkstow is an open-source mobile client for Karakeep, the self-hostable "bookmark everything" app. Sign in to your own server — or Karakeep Cloud — and read, sort and clean up your bookmarks from your phone.
 Connect 
 Any Karakeep server: self-hosted (LAN http://, private CAs) or Karakeep Cloud
 Email and password, or an API key for servers that use single sign-on
 Custom request headers for servers behind Cloudflare Access, Authelia or another auth proxy
 Your password is never stored: it is exchanged for an API key kept in secure storage
 Browse 
 Link-preview cards with image, title, description, site and every tag
 All bookmarks, Favorites, Archived, your lists (nested and smart lists) and tags
 An "unarchived / total" count on every list — archived means read in Karakeep
 Search with Karakeep's query language, inside the open list or tag
 Sort by date added, title or website, in either order
 Create lists and tags
 Add 
 Save links, notes and pictures from your gallery with the + button, straight into the open list, tag or Favorites
 Read and act 
 In-app viewer with the live page or Karakeep's saved reader view
 Swipe between bookmarks; favorite, archive, share, tag, add to lists or delete
 Configurable swipe actions on cards, with Undo for everything
Linkstow needs a Karakeep server (0.33 or newer). It collects no data and contains no trackers. Your login, API key and custom headers are only ever sent to the server you sign in to.
To draw the bookmark cards, Linkstow loads each site's icon straight from the bookmarked website, and its preview image too when Karakeep has not stored one. Scrolling the list therefore makes requests to those websites, which can see your IP address. No headers or credentials are sent with them. The live-page viewer also opens the bookmarked page itself.
Linkstow is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Karakeep or Localhost Labs Ltd.

fdroid:com.sunilpaulmathew.debloater.name: De-Bloater
fdroid:com.sunilpaulmathew.debloater.summary: Use the power of Magisk/Kernel SU to de-bloat system applications systemless-ly
fdroid:com.sunilpaulmathew.debloater.description:
De-Bloater is an application using the power of Magisk/Kernel SU/APatch to de-bloat unwanted applications systemless-ly. It easily remove system apps from "/system", "/vendor", and "/product" directories.
 De-Bloater requires Root Access and a fully functional Magisk or Kernel SU/APatch environment, including modules, for proper working. As a result, De-Bloater won't work with other rooting solutions as well as in Magisk core-only mode.
 Features 
- Easily remove system applications from "/system", "/vendor", "/product", and other directories (Reboot required).
- Restore de-bloated apps, either individually or as a whole (Reboot required).
- Includes smart app suggestions from UAD-NG project.
- Elegantly designed user interface with an auto-dark/light theme.
- A lot more.
 How to Use 
Open the app, click the remove button on each app you want to remove. The selected apps will be removed systemless-ly after a reboot. To restore an app, either Reset Module (on the top menu) or selectively restore from the second page. Please note that a restart is necessary to get any of the changes in effect.
The app will systemless-ly replace the selected APKs by making a Magisk/Kernel SU/APatch module. As a result, you will see a new Module (name: De-bloater).
 Troubleshooting 
In case, if you accidentally remove some important apps and your phone bootloops, please delete "/data/adb/modules/De-bloater" via recovery.
 Translations 
Please help me to translate this application via POEditor . You may also translate after downloading the original language string available here .
 Please Note 
Please be noted that De-Bloater contains its own auto-update implementation, which is only (from v0.10 onwards) available for installation from GitHub release page (and consequently, for IzzyOnDroid). In that case, APK files provided by the developer is directly acquired from the official GitHub release page.

fdroid:org.comunes.tane.name: Tane

fdroid:org.comunes.tane.description:
Tane (種, "seed"; from tanemaki 種まき, "to sow seeds") is a local-first, decentralized app for
keeping and sharing traditional seeds.
Every traditional seed is a letter written by thousands of generations, passed
from hand to hand. Tane helps people and seed-saver collectives keep a
friendly inventory of their bank, decide what they offer, and share it locally
— without a central intermediary that could control, censor, or be fined for
it.
MANAGE YOUR BANK
• Add a seed with just a photo and a name — no Latin required.
• Note the year, how much you have, where it came from, germination tests.
• Search and filter; snap a photo now and name it later.
YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS
• Your seed book works with no internet at all. What you write stays on your
 phone; nothing goes out unless you put some of your seeds up for sharing, or
 write to someone.
• Everything is encrypted at rest on your device.
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no trackers.
• Save an encrypted backup and keep a printed recovery sheet — restore your
 whole bank on a new device.
SHARE, THE WAY IT'S ALWAYS BEEN DONE
• Mark what you have spare to give away, swap or sell.
• Print a catalog of what you share to take to a seed fair.
SHARING NEEDS THE INTERNET
Keeping your seed book needs nothing but your phone. Sharing does need a
connection: to get an offer or a message across to someone, Tane leaves it on
community servers — machines run by people, not by a company. Tane comes with
four: relay.comunes.org, which Asociación Comunes runs (the same people who make
Tane), plus three public ones that others already use — nos.lol, relay.damus.io
and relay.primal.net.
Tane only talks to them when you choose to: first to have a look at what people
share (that sends nothing about you), then, if you write to someone or share
your seeds, after agreeing to the community rules. Before that it doesn't
connect to anything, and messaging stays switched off. When you write or share,
those servers see the key that stands for you and the address your phone
connects from — no name, no email, no account. Your seed book itself is never
sent anywhere, unless you turn on keeping your own devices up to date: then an
encrypted copy only you can read is left for your other phone or computer.
You stay in charge of that list of servers. In the sharing setup you can switch
off any server on it, switch off every one of them — Tane then goes back to
being a seed book that never connects — or add the address of a different
server. Anyone can run a server of their own, and Tane works just as well with
it.
Tane is free software (AGPL-3.0). No ads, no commissions, no business model
— it exists to support traditional varieties and push back against the seed
monopoly.

flathub:io.gitlab.secu_design.usb-imager.name: USB Imager
flathub:io.gitlab.secu_design.usb-imager.summary: Write many USB drives at once
flathub:io.gitlab.secu_design.usb-imager.description:
USB-Imager writes a disk image to several USB drives at the same time.
 Connected drives are detected automatically.
 Drive access is handled by the udisks2 service of the system. Entering a
 password is only required for writing when the policy of the distribution
 in use demands it.
 Before writing, the image can be checked against a checksum. After
 writing, it is possible to verify the content of the drives.
 Features:
 Writing an image to multiple USB drives at once
 Automatic drive detection
 Fast writing through the sendfile() system call
 Adjustable write buffer between 1 MiB and 4 MiB
 Optional validation of the written image
 Optional checksum verification of the selected image
 Automatic unmounting of the drives
 Warning for ISO files that do not look bootable
 Statistics about writing time and overall speed
 Selectable color scheme (Auto, Light, Dark)

fedora-packages:cracklib/cracklib.description: CrackLib tests passwords to determine whether they match certain security-oriented characteristics, with the purpose of stopping users from choosing passwords that are easy to guess. CrackLib performs several tests on passwords: it tries to generate words from a username and gecos entry and checks those words against the password; it checks for simplistic patterns in passwords; and it checks for the password in a dictionary. CrackLib is actually a library containing a particular C function which is used to check the password, as well as other C functions. CrackLib is not a replacement for a passwd program; it must be used in conjunction with an existing passwd program. Install the cracklib package if you need a program to check users' passwords to see if they are at least minimally secure. If you install CrackLib, you will also want to install the cracklib-dicts package.

fedora-packages:gfs-nicefore-fonts/gfs-n.description: As it is known, the Greek alphabet was used in majuscule form for over a millennium before the minuscule letters gradually replaced it until they became the official script in the 9th century A.D. Thereafter, majuscule letters were confined to sparse use as initials or elaborate titles until the Italian Renaissance. The new art of Typography, as well as the need of the humanists to mimic the ancient Greco-Roman period brought back the extensive use of the majuscule letter-forms in both Latin and Greek typography. Greek books of the time were printed using the contemporary Byzantine hand with which they combined capital letters modeled on the Roman antiquity, i.e. with thick and thin strokes and serifs. At the same time the Byzantine majuscule tradition, principally used on theological editions, remained alive until the early 19th century. GFS Nicefore is a typical Byzantine sample of the 5th-7th century period. It has been designed by George D. Matthiopoulos.

fedora-packages:mlmmj/mlmmj.name: mlmmj

fedora-packages:mlmmj/mlmmj.description: Mlmmj(Mailing List Management Made Joyful) is a simple and slim mailing list manager (MLM) inspired by ezmlm. It works with many different Mail Transport Agents (MTAs) and is simple for a system adminstrator to install, configure and integrate with other software. As it uses very few resources, and requires no daemons, it is ideal for installation on systems where resources are limited, such as Virtual Private Servers (VPSes). Although it doesn't aim to include every feature possible, but focuses on staying mean and lean, and doing what it does do well, it does have a great set of features, including: - Archive - Custom headers / footer - Fully automated bounce handling (similar to ezmlm) - Complete requeueing functionality - Moderation functionality - Subject prefix - Subscribers only posting - Regular expression access control - Functionality to retrieve old posts - Web interface - Digests - No-mail subscription - VERP support - Delivery Status Notification (RFC1891) support - Rich, customisable texts for automated operations

Afterwards it determines the address of each network hop between the machines and sends a sequence of ICMP echo requests to each one to determine the quality of the link to each machine. While doing this, it prints running statistics about each machine.

fedora-packages:radvd/radvd.name: radvd
fedora-packages:radvd/radvd.description: radvd is the router advertisement daemon for IPv6. It listens to router solicitations and sends router advertisements as described in "Neighbor Discovery for IP Version 6 (IPv6)" (RFC 2461). With these advertisements hosts can automatically configure their addresses and some other parameters. They also can choose a default router based on these advertisements. Install radvd if you are setting up IPv6 network and/or Mobile IPv6 services.

fedora-packages:rtmidi/rtmidi.description: RtMidi is a set of C++ classes (RtMidiIn and RtMidiOut) that provides a common API (Application Programming Interface) for realtime MIDI input/output across Linux (ALSA & Jack), Macintosh OS X, Windows (Multimedia Library), and SGI operating systems. RtMidi significantly simplifies the process of interacting with computer MIDI hardware and software. It was designed with the following goals: * object oriented C++ design * simple, common API across all supported platforms * only two header files and one source file for easy inclusion in programming projects * MIDI device enumeration

firefox-addons:2900545.name: IO Tools - Developer Kit
firefox-addons:2900545.summary: 50 developer tools in your side panel — encode, hash, convert, generate, plus search 1,000+ more on iotools.cloud
firefox-addons:2900545.description:
🧰 A developer toolbox that lives in your browser's side panel.
IO Tools - Developer Kit puts 50 everyday utilities one keystroke away, and they run right there in the panel, next to the page you're working on. No tab switching, no uploads, no waiting on a server. Encode a string, hash a password, format a blob of JSON, check a colour contrast ratio, decode a JWT, then get straight back to what you were doing.
It also searches the full catalogue of 1,000+ tools on iotools.cloud, so the 50 bundled ones are a starting point rather than a limit.
🌟 Why you'll want it
⚡ It's fast because it's local. The 50 bundled tools are plain JavaScript inside the extension. Your text is processed in your own browser and is never uploaded, logged, or sent anywhere. They work on a plane, on hotel Wi-Fi, or behind a corporate firewall. And you can paste in a production API key to decode it without thinking twice.
📌 It doesn't get in your way. The side panel docks beside your page and stays put while you browse (Chrome, Edge and Opera). It doesn't vanish the moment you click somewhere else, the way a popup does.
🔍 Search finds it before you finish typing. Fuzzy search across every tool name and description, focused the instant the panel opens, so you can start typing before the list has even finished loading. No mode to be in, no filter to remember to clear.
🖱 Transform text without opening anything. Select text on any page, right-click, and convert case, Base64, URL-encode, hash, slugify or format JSON in place. The result goes straight to your clipboard with a confirmation toast.
✨ Features
✓ 50 tools that run locally. No network, no upload, no account.
✓ Docked side panel. Stays open while you work instead of closing on click-away.
✓ Fuzzy search across 1,000+ tools, focused the moment the panel opens.
✓ No modes to get lost in. An empty box shows the 50 that run here; typing searches all 1,000+.
✓ Pin your favourites to the top of the list. They stay pinned across sessions.
✓ Right-click menu with 15 one-click text transforms on any page.
✓ Keyboard navigation. Ctrl+Shift+0 (⌘+Shift+0 on Mac) opens the panel, arrow keys walk the list, / jumps back to search.
✓ Dark mode that follows your system theme.
✓ No account, no sign-up, no tracking. Nothing to configure.
🛠 The 50 tools that run in the panel
📝 Text (8)
✓ Case Converter: switch between upper, lower, title, camel, snake and more
✓ Word Counter: characters, words, sentences, paragraphs and lines
✓ String Length Calculator: character, grapheme, word and UTF-8 byte length
✓ Word Frequency Counter: count how often each word appears
✓ Whitespace Trimmer: trim lines, collapse repeated spaces, strip blank lines
✓ Duplicate Line Remover: remove repeated lines, keeping the first
✓ Reverse Text: reverse by character, word or line order
✓ Slug Generator: turn a title into a URL-friendly slug
🔐 Encode & Cipher (10)
✓ Base64 Encoder / Decoder: encode text to Base64 or decode it back
✓ URL Encoder / Decoder: percent-encode text for a URL, or decode it
✓ HTML Entity Encoder / Decoder: escape HTML-sensitive characters or decode entities
✓ Base32 Encoder / Decoder: RFC 4648 Base32
✓ Base58 Encoder / Decoder: Bitcoin-alphabet Base58
✓ Caesar Cipher / ROT13: shift letters by N positions
✓ Atbash Cipher: classic A↔Z substitution cipher
✓ Morse Code Translator: text to Morse and back
✓ Leetspeak Converter: l33t sp34k substitution
✓ Pig Latin Translator: translate English to Pig Latin
🔑 Hash & Security (5)
✓ Hash Generator: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 digest
✓ UUID Generator: cryptographically random UUID v4s
✓ Password Generator: strong random passwords via crypto.getRandomValues
✓ Password Strength Analyzer: estimate entropy and strength
✓ CRC32 Checksum Generator: IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 checksum
🔢 Number & Data (11)
✓ Binary ⇄ Text Converter: text to space-separated binary bytes and back
✓ Text ⇄ Hex Converter: text to hex bytes and back
✓ Number Base Converter: integers between binary, octal, decimal and hex
✓ Unix Timestamp Converter: timestamps to dates and dates to timestamps
✓ Roman Numeral Converter: numbers to Roman numerals and back
✓ Number to Words: spell out a number in English
✓ Temperature Converter: Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin
✓ Percentage Calculator: X% of Y, what % X is of Y, or % change
✓ JSON Formatter & Validator: pretty-print or minify JSON with validation
✓ CSV to JSON Converter: parse CSV rows into a JSON array of objects
✓ JSON to CSV Converter: flatten a JSON array of objects into CSV

firefox-addons:2941011.description:
🚀 ALL-IN-ONE VIDEO & PHOTO DOWNLOADER FOR TIKTOK
Save your favorites. All at once.
Download supported TikTok videos and photo posts directly from your browser. Save a single post, an entire photo carousel, or batches from profiles, playlists, collections, likes, favorites, reposts, feeds, Explore, and search results.
Choose the best available quality, keep files organized your way, and stay in control with download limits, progress tracking, and recovery tools.
Use only with content you own or have permission to save.
✨ DOWNLOAD MORE, WITH LESS EFFORT
• Videos and photos — save individual videos, selected carousel images, or all images in a photo post.
• Flexible bulk downloads — download from supported profile tabs, playlists, collections, and other accessible TikTok pages.
• Short-drama episodes — choose supported episodes or an episode range from an available series.
• Your choice of limits — download all accessible posts or set a maximum. Process larger lists in manageable batches without loading everything upfront.
• Pause, resume, and stop — control supported batch downloads and continue eligible interrupted sessions.
• Recovery tools — recover supported sessions after a page refresh, with clear summaries of saved, skipped, pending, and unconfirmed items.
• Duplicate protection — skip previously saved items where supported and avoid repeating confirmed downloads when resuming.
• Optional auto-scroll — collect and download newly loaded posts as you browse.
🎬 QUALITY YOU CAN SEE
• Best available sources — selects from the video sources TikTok makes available for each post.
• Experimental HD — attempts supported 1080p-or-higher sources, including compatible video-and-audio combinations, with automatic fallback to a standard source if needed.
• Audio-aware downloads — checks experimental sources for video and audio rather than saving a silent video stream.
• Clear quality labels — identify standard, experimental HD, and unknown-quality sources before downloading.
• No-watermark sources — preferred when TikTok provides them.
• Visible progress — follow fetching, HD processing, saving, batch completion, and paused states without losing track of your download.
📁 FILES ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
• Custom filenames and folders — use naming templates and presets to organize files by creator, post, date, and other available details.
• Live filename previews — check your naming choices before saving.
• Organized photo carousels — preserve image sequence with numbered filenames.
• CSV exports — export available post details and download records.
• Download history — review saved-post records and local download statistics.
🌍 MADE TO FIT YOUR BROWSER
• Eleven interface languages — English, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean, French, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, German, and Indonesian.
• Automatic language selection — follows supported TikTok or browser language settings, with an easy manual override.
• Theme choices — Light, Dark, and System modes.
• Movable controls — keep the floating downloader in your preferred corner or drag it to a custom position.
• Quick settings and reset — adjust preferences, restore defaults, or turn the extension off without uninstalling it.
• No separate extension account required.
🆕 WHAT’S NEW IN V5.4
Expanded photo and episode downloads, more flexible incremental batches, improved recovery and progress reporting, customizable filename templates, a fully localized interface, and stronger source-readiness and HD fallback handling.
IMPORTANT NOTES
Quality, audio, watermark availability, and supported formats depend on the sources TikTok provides. HD is not available for every post, and the extension does not upscale videos or guarantee creator-original quality.
Some TikTok features require signing in to TikTok. The extension does not bypass private-content restrictions or other access controls. Recovery is time-limited, and some sessions may require confirmation or cannot be resumed.
TikTok changes may occasionally affect functionality. Keep the extension updated for the latest compatibility improvements.
INDEPENDENT PROJECT NOTICE
This is an independent, unofficial browser extension. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, authorized by, or approved by TikTok, ByteDance, or their affiliates.
TikTok and related names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners and are referenced only to identify compatibility.
Use responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws, creator rights, and TikTok’s Terms of Service.

firefox-addons:2703122.name: Passky - Password Manager
firefox-addons:2703122.summary: Simple, modern, open source and secure password manager
firefox-addons:2703122.description:
Passky 
Passky is a simple, modern, lightweight, open source and secure password manager.
 How Much Does it Cost? 
Passky is a free, open-source password manager that simplifies your digital life. Both the free and premium plans include advanced security features such as two-factor authentication to ensure the safety and security of your sensitive data.
While the free plan allows you to store up to 100 passwords, the premium plan offers additional benefits such as the ability to store an unlimited number of passwords. Upgrade to the premium plan to gain access to all of Passky's features and take your password security to the next level.
At Passky, we take your security seriously, and we don't compromise on safety when it comes to password management. Sign up now and experience the peace of mind that comes with using Passky.
 How it Works? 
Passky uses a combination of advanced encryption methods to ensure the security of your data.
Passky is based on a zero trust architecture and uses advanced encryption methods such as XChaCha20 and Argon2id to ensure the security of your sensitive data.
For sensitive data encryption, Passky uses XChaCha20, a state-of-the-art encryption algorithm that provides a high level of security and performance. This encryption method is designed to be resistant to known-plaintext attacks and other forms of cryptanalysis.
For master password hashing, Passky uses Argon2id, a password-hashing algorithm that has been recognized as the winner of multiple password-hashing competitions, such as the Password Hashing Competition (PHC) held by the community. It is designed to be resistant to brute-force attacks. This algorithm uses a combination of memory-hard and data-dependent techniques to make it difficult for attackers to guess your master password.
When you save your account information to Passky, all sensitive data is fully encrypted using XChaCha20. The encrypted data is then stored on Passky's servers.
When you try to access your account, Passky will prompt you to input your master password. The master password is then hashed using Argon2id algorithm to ensure its security. The hashed master password is then used to decrypt the sensitive data, allowing you to access your account.
In summary, Passky uses advanced encryption methods such as XChaCha20 and Argon2id to ensure the security of your sensitive data and master password, making it difficult for anyone to access your information without your permission.

bluejetty:00037357:ios.description:
Nitefall is a Safari extension that converts all your websites to dark mode and reduces eye strain, especially helpful at night. It works automatically with system appearance so that your websites are only dark when the whole system is in dark mode.
Features:
-3 dark themes to pick from (Dark gray, Monokai, Midnight)
-Darken navigation maps
-Support for blacklisting specific websites
-Increase transparent PNG icons contrast (especially when they are very dark and not easily to viewable)
-Per site configurable image brightness (useful if the website is displaying bright images)
You can try the extension for free on a limited number of websites. To use it on an unlimited number of webpages, you need to purchase a premium plan which can be used on both Mac and iOS.
If you find any website that is broken with Nitefall on, please report it to foxfortmobile@gmail.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00169083:ios.description:
Build hospital, help patients get better and become rich in this simulator!
If you like management and idle hospital games, you will enjoy this tycoon. Here you can build your own idle mental hospital, rehabilitate patients and earn money.
As usual in tycoon games, you start small: a few wards and some patients. 
Сreate all the conditions for recovery
Take care of your patients and feed them, provide them with clean clothes and a shower, make sure they get enough sleep. Doing all this will not be difficult, because this is an idle games with simple controls. 
Help to heal and release your patients
The more patients you cure, the more money you get. Don't forget that your main goal is not only to help, but also to get rich.
Manage a hospital like a tycoon
Hire cooks, cleaners, orderlies and doctors. The staff will help you to control the situation and achieve all your goals.
Keep an eye on the calm level
Do not allow the occurrence of mass riot, otherwise your orderlies will have to chase after patients to prevent them from escaping!
Grow your hospital business
Patients will come over and over again, so you need to quickly build hospital and expand it. Add new wards and rooms to accommodate more patients and earn money. Open locations for the construction of new hospitals - in the forest, on an island, in the mountains, or even at an orbital station. 
Grow your business and help people at the same time. Become the richest manager in this idle hospital simulator!

bluejetty:00162695:ios.description:
ПЭК — управляйте перевозками в одном приложении!
Рассчитывайте стоимость, оформляйте перевозки, отслеживайте грузы, управляйте доставкой и оплачивайте услуги онлайн. 
Всё необходимое для работы с перевозками — от оформления заявки до получения груза — в одном приложении.
ОФОРМЛЯЙТЕ ПЕРЕВОЗКИ
- Рассчитывайте стоимость перевозки и создавайте заявки с помощью онлайн-калькулятора.
- Просматривайте свои заявки, подписывайте накладные онлайн и получайте информацию о назначенном водителе.
ОТСЛЕЖИВАЙТЕ ГРУЗЫ
- Проверяйте статус перевозки по номеру груза или находите нужный груз в списке. 
- Используйте поиск и фильтры, просматривайте информацию о перевозке, заборе и доставке, проверяйте габариты, заказанные услуги, фотографии приёмки и накладные.
УПРАВЛЯЙТЕ ПЕРЕВОЗКОЙ И ДОСТАВКОЙ
- Меняйте получателя и плательщика, оформляйте изменение места получения или приостановку перевозки. 
- Устанавливайте и снимайте запрет выдачи груза. 
- Заказывайте доставку по адресу, планируйте её и изменяйте параметры.
ОПЛАЧИВАЙТЕ ОНЛАЙН
- Оплачивайте услуги прямо в приложении, применяйте купоны и списывайте бонусы программы лояльности.
ПОЛУЧАЙТЕ ГРУЗЫ УДОБНЕЕ
- Используйте QR-код для выдачи груза.
- Оформляйте и аннулируйте заявление на получение по СМС.
РАБОТАЙТЕ С ДОКУМЕНТАМИ
- Заказывайте счета, бухгалтерские документы, отчёты по страхованию и акты сверки с отправкой на электронную почту.
УПРАВЛЯЙТЕ ЛИЧНЫМ КАБИНЕТОМ
- Просматривайте данные профиля и карту клиента, добавляйте контрагентов и повышайте уровень доступа. 
- Настраивайте способ входа, меняйте и восстанавливайте пароль. При необходимости удалите аккаунт.
ПОЛЬЗУЙТЕСЬ ПРОГРАММОЙ ЛОЯЛЬНОСТИ
- Подключайтесь к программе, следите за своим статусом и просматривайте информацию о бонусах.
НАХОДИТЕ ОТДЕЛЕНИЯ ПЭК
- Ищите отделения на карте или в списке, используйте фильтры, уточняйте адреса, часы работы и контакты.
БУДЬТЕ В КУРСЕ СОБЫТИЙ
- Получайте push-уведомления о важных событиях, связанных с вашими грузами. 
- Обращайтесь за помощью к виртуальному помощнику и используйте официальные каналы связи.
О КОМПАНИИ ПЭК
ПЭК — одна из ведущих российских компаний в сфере транспортно-логистических услуг. Компания организует перевозки сборных грузов и предлагает решения для доставки между городами.
Мы развиваем цифровые сервисы, чтобы взаимодействовать с ПЭК было удобнее на каждом этапе перевозки — от расчёта стоимости и оформления заявки до отслеживания и получения груза.
Подробнее о компании и услугах: pecom.ru
ПЭК — ваши перевозки под контролем.
Оформляйте, отслеживайте и управляйте грузами в удобное время и в одном приложении.

bluejetty:00169459:ios.name: Avatar Maker Life: Terra World
bluejetty:00169459:ios.summary:
Welcome to Terra World, a pretend play world game where kids create their own avatar world. It blends dress up games, an avatar maker, and a gentle life simulation into offline games for girls and boys who love to imagine and play.
Explore
bluejetty:00169459:ios.description:
Welcome to Terra World, a pretend play world game where kids create their own avatar world. It blends dress up games, an avatar maker, and a gentle life simulation into offline games for girls and boys who love to imagine and play.
Explore 8 Lively Scenes
Terra World holds 8 lively scenes: a school, a grocery store, a restaurant, a park, a cozy house, a police station, a rustic cabin, and a beauty salon. Drag the sun or moon to switch between day and night. Go to class, run the store, picnic in the park, or play police officer at the station.
Create Your Own Avatars
Design kawaii avatars with the avatar maker's over 1000 character components — facial features, hairstyles, skin colors, clothes, hats, glasses, and face decorations. Pick from 34 ready-made characters — kids, teens, adults, and grandparents — plus a few monsters, or create your own. Mix 22 expressions with 16 actions to give each avatar personality.
Play With Everything
Props can be picked up, dragged anywhere, and played with. Unwrap packages, slice fruit, stack food into containers, pour a drink, hang things on hooks, or toss the trash away. Kids can plant seeds in the park and watch them grow into a harvest. 10 cats live at home, and the salon's photo booth pairs 10 backdrops with 7 filters — each photo becomes a prop to pick up and place. Hundreds of props hide more surprises.
Tell Your Own Stories
There is no script and no wrong way to play. Dress your avatars, place them in any scene, and let a school day or a quiet evening at the cabin become whatever story you want to tell. Swap characters and scenes anytime.
All 8 Scenes Open From the Start
All 8 scenes are unlocked from day one — nothing to earn, nothing to wait for. An optional Stylist Pack (in-app purchase) adds 27 more character slots and outfits. It's playable offline, anywhere. No third-party advertisements interrupt the fun.
We believe open-ended play sparks children's creativity and imagination.
Product Features
• 8 lively scenes: School, Grocery Store, Restaurant, Park, House, Police Station, Cabin, and Beauty Salon.
• Over 1000 avatar components to create your own kawaii avatars.
• 34 ready-made characters, plus your own creations.
• 22 expressions and 16 actions to bring characters to life.
• A beauty salon photo booth with 10 backdrops and 7 filters.
• Day and night in every scene.
• Hundreds of props with hidden interactions.
• Playable without an internet connection.
• No third-party advertisements.
Terra World is an avatar world game for kids who love dress up games, avatar maker apps, and life simulation play. Girls and boys style kawaii avatars with hairstyles, skin colors, and facial expressions, then carry their story from school to salon and back. Kids games should work anywhere – Terra World plays offline, anytime.
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00100607:ios.description:
The PYBL app is your all-encompassing guide for sporting events, meticulously crafted to cater to the needs of team and college coaches, media, players, parents, and fans. Designed to bring every essential aspect of the event to your fingertips, this platform ensures you stay connected and well-informed.
Key Features:
• Quick team search and user-friendly shortcuts.
• Up-to-the-minute schedules to keep you on track.
• Live standings and brackets for real-time updates.
• Immediate game notifications so you never miss a beat.
• Venue directions for easy navigation.
• Access to team rosters and live results with box scores (when available), all at your fingertips.
• Essential event documents, messages, and contact details for complete guidance.
• Information on event sponsors for additional insights.
With the app, every detail of the event is conveniently at your fingertips, ensuring an immersive and comprehensive experience for everyone involved.

Parcel Pending makes it simple to receive your packages and online orders! With our easy-to-use mobile app, you can manage your account, retrieve your packages, set up vacation mode, and more!

Think of it as a steamier version of Cards Against Humanity, Evil Apples, Picolo, Exposed, and Truth or Dare all rolled into one. Prepare for your mind (or privates) blown, whether playing DAQUQ at a party or an adventurous date night. 
JOIN DAFUQERS WHO::
• Break out of their shells (or clothes) /
• Hear your friends’ craziest stories /
• Keep the conversations flowing /
• Make game nights memorable /
• Complete risqué challenges /
• Connect with someone new /
• Are not easily offended /
• Learn dirty secrets /
• Hate small talk /
• Laugh /
▶ 10+ PROVOCATIVE CARD PACKS ◀
[ DO OR ACTION] 
Complete a ridiculous challenge or down that shot. See which of your buddies becomes the most wasted after losing too many savage challenges.
[ WOULD YOU RATHER ] 
Would you rather date your best friend or someone you don't know? The hypothetical dirty question game offers nightmare scenarios you dread hearing your friends answer.
[ LADIES NIGHT ] 
Bond with your besties over fantasies, boundaries, and dirty secrets. The adrenaline-fueled bachelorette party game breaks down barriers.
[ TRUTH OR DARE ] 
Uncover dirty secrets or perform an absurd action with the party game known to facilitate a hook-up or two. 
[ BLAZED ] 
You’re ganja have a good time answering thought-provoking questions that elevate your sesh. Just doob it!
[ Down to **** ] 
Say goodbye to awkward icebreakers and hello to your new favorite party game, where you'll find out who's down to get down.
[ BYOB ] 
The bold and buzzed-inducing card game where you and your group must answer before the timer runs out. Make a decision, or take a shot!
[ CONFESSIONAL ] 
Unleash your wildest fantasies and confess your deepest desires in this sizzling confessional card game.
[ 18+ ]
Try your hand responding to sizzling scenarios that explore your wildest desire. The steamy and intoxicating card game will spice up any party.
[ RATED PG ] 
The version you can play with your mother where the only limit is your family-friendly imagination (and the ticking clock). It’s sure to have you and your group laughing and blushing in equal measure.
[ CREATE YOUR OWN ] 
Tailor the next match to your group's sense of humor. Write in your own card prompts or customize your game using cards from any of the 10+ game packs.
▶ HOW TO PLAY ◀
The concept of each in-app card prompt is simple. Each player gets up to 8 seconds to answer a raunchy question or complete a provocative challenge. Examples:
• List 3 things you probably should have been arrested for
• Give your 3 realistic reactions to when she says she’s still pregnant on April 2nd
• Truth or Dare: Bend over and place a cup on your lower back, twerk till it flips
▶ GET STARTED ◀
1 - Designate the player with the lowest IQ as your card master to begin.
2- Choose one or more card packs. Begin adding players to your victims' list.
3 - Start the timer’s countdown allowing a player to answer in 8 seconds or less.
4 - The winner becomes the new card master.
▶ READ WHAT DAFUQ USERS ARE SAYING ◀
• "[...] Awesome game for friends game night"
• "A funny way to get into the heads of your friends!"
▶ UNLOCK PREMIUM CARDS◀
Get started playing with a free card pack or upgrade to a recurring subscription starting from 
• $2.99 USD/week
• $8.99 USD/month 
• $39.99 USD/annually for the best deal
------------
Download DAFUQ to level up your game night. The app is available in English, Spanish, Italian, German and French. Questions or feedback? Get responsive support at contact@dafuqapp.com or https://www.dafuqapp.com/contact/.

bluejetty:00017891:ios.description:
First Northern Bank
Mobile Banking from your Apple iOS device.
Mobile Banking offers you the ability to view account balances and recent transactions, transfer funds between your accounts, and locate a First Northern Branch and surcharge free ATMs. Our Mobile Banking service provides you with the ultimate in convenience for managing your finances anytime, anywhere from any Apple iOS device!
Requirements: 
Customers must be an active Online Banking user to enroll in Mobile Banking. You can enroll in Online Banking on our website at www.thatsmybank.com. Existing Online Banking users can enroll in Mobile Banking by selecting ‘Mobile Banking’ under the 'Other Services' menu. Your mobile carrier’s text messaging and web charges may apply.
Security: 
Fist Northern Bank’s Mobile Banking service is an extension of the Bank’s Online Banking service. When you login you will use the same security questions, PassMark, and phrases you are accustomed to in Online Banking. The FNB App uses SSL encryption to keep your information secure. 
Features: 
• View account balances on all accounts
• View recent transactions
• Transfer funds between your accounts
• Find the nearest branch or surcharge free ATM using your mobile phone’s GPS 
• Call our 24-hour telephone (TeleBank) service for automated information 
First Northern Bank, an independent community bank headquartered in Solano County since 1910, serves Solano, Yolo, Sacramento, Placer, Contra Costa County and the west slope of El Dorado County. First Northern has nine full service branches located in Dixon, Davis, West Sacramento, Fairfield, Vacaville, Winters, Woodland, Roseville, and Auburn, and has a full service Trust Department in Sacramento. The Bank also offers 24/7 real estate mortgage loans, SBA loans, and non-FDIC insured Investment & Brokerage Services at each branch location. First Northern’s Real Estate Mortgage Loan office is located in Davis, and real estate loan representatives are available to meet customers at any of the Bank’s branches by appointment. The Bank specializes in relationship banking and employs experts in the area of small business, commercial, agribusiness, and real estate lending, as well as wealth management, and is rated as a “Superior” 5-Star Bank by BauerFinancial Inc. (www.bauerfinancial.com). The Bank can be found on the Web at www.thatsmybank.com.

bluejetty:00152570:ios.description:
Virtual Staging AI is the ultimate solution for real estate professionals who want to transform empty properties into fully staged, photorealistic showcases. Designed specifically for realtors, real estate agents, and interior designers, our app helps you turn vacant rooms into stunning, buyer-ready spaces with ease and speed. By leveraging advanced AI technology, Virtual Staging AI eliminates the need for costly furniture rentals, time-consuming physical staging, and complicated manual design software. Whether you need to stage an entire house, individual rooms, or outdoor spaces, Virtual Staging AI makes it fast, affordable, and effortless.
Traditional home staging can cost thousands of dollars, take several days to set up, and require physical logistics. With our Virtual Staging solution, you simply upload photos of the empty spaces and let the app work its magic, instantly transforming them into fully designed rooms that help potential buyers visualize their future home.
Unlike other solutions that can alter room proportions or layouts, our AI respects the original dimensions, floors, and walls, enhancing spaces only with realistic furniture and décor. Fully MLS compliant, staging can include a “Virtually Staged” label for transparency, keeping listings professional, accurate, and completely listing-safe.
Key Features
Professional-Quality Staging
Experience photorealistic, high-resolution virtual staging created by advanced AI. No need for in-person staging or expensive photoshoots.
Rapid Turnaround
Get fully staged property images in seconds by uploading a simple photo. No waiting days or coordinating multiple service providers.
Affordable Staging Solution
Stage homes at a fraction of the cost compared to traditional methods. Save time and money while presenting your properties in the best light.
Multiple Design Styles
Choose from a wide variety of preset styles including modern, classic, minimalistic, and luxury. Tailor the staging to match the target market or property style.
Custom Style & Mood Boards
Upload your own mood boards or design inspirations and let the app customize the staging according to your vision. Perfect for interior designers and creative professionals.
Shop Furniture & Decor
Directly purchase the furniture and decor items featured in your virtual staging from online stores. Streamline your workflow and complete your staging in one place.
Remove, Reskin, Replace, Upscale
Remove unwanted objects, swap furniture pieces, change material finishes, or upscale image resolution, all with simple tools designed to save you time.
Perfect for Real Estate Pros
Whether you're a solo agent, part of a large brokerage, or a design firm, Virtual Staging AI scales to your needs. 
Boost Buyer Interest & Sales
Properties virtually staged show +83% more buyer interest, sell +73% faster, and receive +25% higher offers on average.
Why Virtual Staging AI Is Better Than Traditional Staging
Traditional property staging can be expensive, slow, and logistically challenging. You have to rent or buy furniture, coordinate deliveries, and schedule a professional photographer. Virtual Staging AI eliminates all these hassles. With just a few taps, your empty room becomes a visually stunning space, helping buyers imagine themselves living there. This drives quicker decisions, higher engagement, and faster property sales. Plus, the ability to easily experiment with multiple design styles gives you the flexibility to appeal to different buyer tastes.
Trusted by Design and Real Estate Professionals
Virtual Staging AI is created by the same team behind Remodel AI and Paint AI, leaders in smart home design technology. Our solutions are built for professionals who demand speed, quality, and simplicity.

Terms & Conditions: https://remodelai.app/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00014620:ios.description:
Quick Checkbook is a smart personal finance management app, you can track multiple accounts info easily and conveniently.
With Quick Checkbook, you will manage your accounts at a glance. You can see clearly balance of all your accounts and each account, add recurring or no cycle transactions, mark transaction as cleared or not, transfer between accounts, and reconcile transactions etc. In reports page, you will see visually where your money comes and goes. 
Key Features: 
⁃ Create multiple accounts, such as checking, saving, credit and cash etc.
⁃ Add/Edit income/expense/transferring transactions.
⁃ Add/Edit recurring transactions with different cycle.
⁃ Mark transaction as cleared or not.
⁃ Add payee info for a transaction.
⁃ Reconcile transactions.
⁃ Check balance of all accounts and each account.
⁃ Check total cleared of all accounts and each account.
⁃ Pie reports for categories of income and expense.
⁃ Histogram reports to compare income and expense.
⁃ Supports the split transactions.
⁃ Supports more comprehensive cycle types.
⁃ View the daily expenses in calendar.
⁃ Supports reconcile account after each transaction.
⁃ Supports different currencies & Running Balance for each account.
⁃ Supports managing Payers and Payers.
⁃ Supports more function chart statistics.
⁃ Adds the function of closing useless accounts and archiving data.
⁃ Set your own currency.
⁃ Pass code protection.
⁃ Search transactions.
⁃ Send data by email in form of PDF, CSV or HTML.
⁃ Supports AirPrint.
⁃ WiFi Backup & Restore.
⁃ iCloud Backup & Restore. 
⁃ Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports migrate data to paid version.
⁃ Supports both iPhone and iPad.
If you have any questions or suggestion, please mail to userfeed@vip.tom.com.

bluejetty:00029319:android.description:
Are you fond of home renovation, city design and room makeover? Do you craze for a casual mobile game that lets you live out your interior design fantasies in a fun, relaxing environment where you can try out different furniture and décor concepts in any way you want? Then let's play Merge Town - Decor Mansion!
Angela - an armature interior designer just came back to her hometown for the Holiday. Unfortunately, the earthquake that suddenly occurred has destroyed most of the town. Can you help Angela renovate the city and make this town great again? 🌈
Your mission is to help Angela to fix 🔧🔨 everything that's broken, restore the shops and buildings, houses, restaurants, stores and give the city a glamorous look like it was before. Build your dream city and decorate houses by yourself.
🛠 Decorate your ideal city.
Solve fun & tricky matching PUZZLES!!! Match and combine resources to create a toolbox that can help you with the city design. Get ready to redesign, rebuild and customize things the way you want. Learn tips and get more inspirations from the latest decorating trends, pick your favorite styles from a variety of choices to accomplish your design ideas, there is a lot to repair!
🗝 Discover hidden objects and unlock unique areas.
Merge and collect tools that've been hidden in the city by expanding the town. Use them to repair the stores, restaurants, houses, or sell extra items to make sure every shop has a glamorous look!
🏆 More rewards are awaiting and enjoy the PLOT TWIST!
The city you will be remodelling is large and abounds with secrets and mysteries! Have an extraordinary life in the town with new people, untold stories and astonishing secrets. It's time for you to plan an amazing city makeover. You will be surprised by your creativity and design talent in this renovation game challenge!
Game features:
✔ Easy to learn and quick gameplay with more challenges to discover
✔ Merge items to create useful tools and build a city of your dream
✔ Hundreds of decorating options and styles to choose from
✔ Unlock special items and treasure chests along the game
✔ Extra gems and coins to help you complete the tasks and more
HOW TO PLAY:
- Merge 2 similar items to help restore the piece
- Fix the broken things and clean up the stores and building

bluejetty:00128513:ios.name: Screen Mirroring – Chromecast
bluejetty:00128513:ios.summary:
Chromecast Mirroring & Remote mirrors your iPhone or iPad screen with sound, full HD quality and low-latency to Chromecast and Google TV Streamer.
You can mirror videos, websites, photos, games, apps, presentations, spreadsheets and docume
bluejetty:00128513:ios.description:
Chromecast Mirroring & Remote mirrors your iPhone or iPad screen with sound, full HD quality and low-latency to Chromecast and Google TV Streamer.
You can mirror videos, websites, photos, games, apps, presentations, spreadsheets and documents and to your Chromecast.
You can also remote control your Chromecast.
* Supported devices: Chromecast, Google TV Streamer and TVs with Chromecast built-in or Google Cast.
* Supported TVs and streaming players: Xiaomi MI Box, NVIDIA Shield TV and all TVs with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, e.g. Sony, TCL, Vizio, Sharp, Philips, Hisense, Skyworth, Soniq.
* Your iPhone/iPad and your Chromecast must be connected to the same Wi-Fi to make screen mirroring work. 
* Latency is very low (below 1 second) when you have good Wi-Fi network conditions.
* The app has no hidden subscriptions or costs and mirroring can be used for free and without time limitations. Some extra features are available as a upgrade and can be purchased for a small one-time fee.
* If a third party app, for example Spotify, does not mirror sound correctly, please FORCE CLOSE and restart Spotify while the mirroring session is active. Please check the Apple Support page to learn how to FORCE CLOSE an app: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201330.
* Black screen problems: Some third party apps don not allow screen mirroring. When you try to mirror their content, a black screen will appear on your TV, for example with Amazon Prime, HBO and other services. This is a restriction chosen by the content providers.
* This unique app is developed and maintained since 2019. With every update we improve the quality of the app.
* Our support team is here to help you via email. Please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything we could do to improve the app for you. 
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google or any other trademark mentioned here. Chromecast and Google TV Streamer are trademarks of Google LLC.

bluejetty:00035504:ios.description:
Coinwise – Your Ultimate Coin Identification & Valuation App
Discover the fascinating world of coins with Coinwise, the all-in-one tool for coin collectors, hobbyists, and treasure hunters. Whether you’ve found an old coin, inherited a rare piece, or simply want to know more about your currency, Coinwise makes coin identification effortless and accurate.
With just a quick photo, Coinwise instantly identifies coins from around the world, providing you with detailed information, historical background, and real-time market value. Say goodbye to guesswork—let advanced AI technology do the research for you.
Key Features of Coinwise:
Instant Coin Identification – Snap a picture and get accurate identification in seconds.
Detailed Coin Information – Learn about the coin’s origin, year, mint, and history.
Market Value Estimation – Stay informed with up-to-date coin values and price ranges.
Global Coin Database – Access information on coins from different countries and eras.
Personal Coin Collection – Save your favorite coins in a personalized digital gallery.
Condition Grading Guide – Understand how a coin’s condition impacts its value.
Whether you are a beginner learning about coin collecting or an experienced numismatist tracking market trends, Coinwise is your reliable companion. Our powerful AI technology ensures high accuracy, making it easier for you to buy, sell, and trade coins confidently.
Why Choose Coinwise?
Covers coins from ancient times to modern currency.
Regularly updated database for the latest coin values.
Easy-to-use interface designed for collectors of all levels.
Saves you hours of manual research.
Coinwise isn’t just about finding the value—it’s about exploring the story behind every coin. From historical currency to rare collector’s pieces, our app connects you to the rich heritage of numismatics.
No matter if you’re evaluating a coin for sale, verifying authenticity, or expanding your collection, Coinwise makes the process simple and enjoyable.
Start your journey into coin collecting today with Coinwise—where every coin has a story waiting to be told.

bluejetty:00080146:ios.description:
Step into the arena and dominate the action in Smash Ball, the ultimate PvP sports game where precision and strategy determine victory. Smash, hit, and outplay your opponents in fast-paced multiplayer battles that keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you’re competing online or challenging friends, every match is a test of timing and skill!
Smash Ball Features:
◉ Thrilling Action
Experience intense battles where every hit counts! Time your shots perfectly to accelerate the ball and deliver devastating smashes. Whether you're a fan of sports games or looking for competitive PvP games, Smash Ball is your ultimate arena.
◉ Friendly Smash Mode
Invite your friends for epic showdowns! Create a game, share a unique code, and engage in real-time multiplayer matches. Prove your skills and earn the bragging rights in this exciting ball smash challenge.
◉ Collect Smashers!
Unlock, collect and upgrade all types of smashers! Each come with abilities and skills unique to their own and are further customizable with gear to ensure you can outclass your competition.
◉ Dynamic Smash Gameplay
Master the art of timing! Land a perfect smash to send the ball hurtling at incredible speeds, forcing your opponent to miss and take heavy damage. Precision is the key to victory in this high-speed sports game.
◉ Progression and Special Abilities
Unlock game-changing special abilities and passives tailored to your play style. Earn rewards, level up, and equip better gear as you climb the ranks and dominate the leaderboards.
◉ Multiple Game Modes
Explore a variety of exciting game modes that keep the action fresh and engaging. Test your skills in Wall Smash, survive the chaos of Deathmatch, or challenge opponents in classic duels. Each mode offers unique rules and challenges to push your gameplay to the next level.
◉ Smash Your Way to the Top
Compete in high-stakes matches, outplay your rivals, and claim victory in this adrenaline-filled online game. With quick matches and strategic depth, Smash Ball is the ultimate multiplayer sports experience.
Ready to take on the world and smash your way to victory?
Download Smash Ball now and enjoy the most exciting PvP sports game on mobile. Master the ball smash, challenge friends, and become the undisputed champion!

bluejetty:00033898:ios.summary:
Find your Healthy. Simple journaling. Smart coaching.
You already know a lot about your body. AteMate helps you connect the dots. Snap a photo of your meal, note how you feel, and your AI Coach helps you see what is really shaping your ener
bluejetty:00033898:ios.description:
Find your Healthy. Simple journaling. Smart coaching.
You already know a lot about your body. AteMate helps you connect the dots. Snap a photo of your meal, note how you feel, and your AI Coach helps you see what is really shaping your energy, mood, and sleep.
No rules. No guilt. No starting over.
•• A Journal That Gets Out of Your Way ••
Food, mood, hydration, movement, and sleep, all in one simple food journal. Snap a photo and your meal is recognized automatically. No typing, no measuring, no math. Your day, captured in seconds.
•• A Coach Who Knows Your Story ••
Your AI Coach sees months of your journal, so you never start from scratch. 
Ask the things you have always wondered:
 "Why do I crash every afternoon?"
 "Am I eating enough protein this week?"
 "How do I recover after a big weekend?"
It helps you notice patterns and choose a small next step.
Already working with a health coach? Connect with them in AteMate so they can support you between sessions.
•• CGM and WHOOP Support ••
Wear a continuous glucose monitor? Your readings sync through Apple Health. Use WHOOP? Your workouts and sleep come straight into your journal. Everything sits next to your meals and mood, so you can see how your day connects.
•• AI on Your Terms ••
Prefer to keep it simple? Turn off Smart Features in Settings, including photo analysis and your AI Coach. Your journal keeps working, and you can switch them back on anytime.
•• Calories and Macros, If You Want Them ••
They are there to help you learn, never to set rules. Use them, or skip them entirely. AteMate is a reflective health journal, not a diet app.
•• People Use AteMate To ••
Lose weight without the cycle of restriction and regain
Figure out what is draining their energy
Build habits that hold up through busy weeks and travel
Build a calmer relationship with food
"First time I've made it past 3 months without starting over."
•• Trusted and Featured ••
Featured in Women's Health, TIME, The New York Times, Forbes, and The Washington Post. Partnered with the YMCA, the American Council on Exercise (ACE), and the U.S. Air Force.
•• Plans ••
 AteMate: your full journal, insights, and a preview of your AI Coach.
 AteMate Coach: 4x coaching allowance.
 AteMate Coach Plus: 8x coaching allowance.
 Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, Coach included.
Joining through your health coach? Ask them how your account is set up. Client accounts are covered by your coach and built around their coaching instead of the AI Coach.
•• Your Privacy ••
No ads. We never sell your information. Your health journey is yours.
Start with one photo today. See what works for your body, and Find your Healthy.
Are you a health coach? Support your clients between sessions with AteMate for Coaches: atemate.com/coach
AteMate is a wellness journal and does not provide medical advice. Payment is charged after the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00095772:ios.description:
Welcome to Spiralix Snake: Fun World, the ultimate casual adventure where fun, colors, and challenges come together!
If you love games that are easy to play but keep you hooked for hours, this is the perfect game for you. Guide your playful Spiralix Snake through exciting environments, grow bigger, avoid obstacles, and enjoy a world full of surprises.
Why You’ll Love Spiralix Snake: Fun World
Simple and Addictive Gameplay – Just swipe and control your snake. Easy to learn but full of challenges.
Explore Colorful Worlds – Travel through bright and fun environments designed to keep you entertained.
Grow Bigger – Eat, expand, and become the longest snake in the world!
Smooth Controls – Relaxing, responsive, and family-friendly for all ages.
Endless Fun – Levels full of surprises, obstacles, and hidden rewards.
Replay Anytime – Quick sessions that fit into your day whenever you want a break.
A Casual Game for Everyone
Whether you are a kid, a teen, or an adult, Spiralix Snake: Fun World is designed for everyone who loves to play fun and lighthearted games. The rules are simple – explore, grow, and survive. The longer you play, the more exciting challenges you discover.
Fun, Relaxing, and Engaging
Take a break and dive into this playful snake world. The colorful graphics, smooth animations, and cheerful sound effects make it a game you can enjoy anytime, anywhere. Whether you’re waiting, relaxing at home, or just want a quick adventure, this game is always ready.
Play, Compete, and Enjoy
Challenge yourself to grow the biggest Spiralix Snake. Explore levels, unlock new areas, and test your skills. Each run feels fresh and full of fun, making you want to come back again and again.
Key Features Recap
Play as the unique Spiralix Snake
Fun and safe for all ages
Easy controls, exciting levels
Explore, grow, and discover surprises
Relaxing but challenging gameplay
Bright 3D environments full of life
Why Choose Spiralix Snake: Fun World?
Unlike other snake games, this one gives you a cheerful, lighthearted adventure. With its smooth design and unique Spiralix theme, it’s not just another snake game – it’s a world of fun waiting for you to explore.

bluejetty:00180136:ios.name: ZEISS Hunting
bluejetty:00180136:ios.summary:
ZEISS Hunting – By hunters for hunters
With hunting maps, ballistics calculator, hunting diary, hunting weather and much more! Connect your ZEISS thermal imaging camera, clip-on or rangefinder to the app via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi and use the w
bluejetty:00180136:ios.description:
ZEISS Hunting – By hunters for hunters
With hunting maps, ballistics calculator, hunting diary, hunting weather and much more! Connect your ZEISS thermal imaging camera, clip-on or rangefinder to the app via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi and use the wide range of app features.
- Ballistics: Calculations tailored to your ZEISS riflescope and even to riflescopes from other brands
- Hunting Grounds: Create your hunting grounds and manage them together with fellow hunters
- Newsfeed: Receive ZEISS news and promotions and share content with your friends
- Hunting Diary: Document your trips and successes
- My Products: Easily record your equipment and important data
- Connected Products: Conveniently connect your ZEISS products to the app where you can easily use various product features
- Weather: Hourly weather data and 5-day forecast
ZEISS Hunting features in detail:
Ballistics Calculator: 
Calculate the ballistics for your long-range or angled shot – precisely tailored to your ZEISS Terra/Victory/Conquest riflescope and your reticle or ASV/ASV+.
Get your results in imperial and metric units as tables and reticles, including ASV data. For riflescopes from other manufacturers, use the ballistics table.
Atmospheric data ensures the correct calculation for your on-target long-range shot. 
For even more precision, simply calculate the ballistic coefficients for your ammunition.
Save ballistic profiles to have them at hand any time.
Sharing:
Keep your friends up-to-date about your hunting successes, ballistics and equipment by sharing your entries with them.
News:
Keep track of all shared entries from you and your friends, like and comment on your friends' posts and stay up-to-date with ZEISS product news and promotions. 
Hunting Grounds:
Draw the borders of your hunting ground, mark no-go areas and define points of interest on your ground map such as raised hide, high seat, feeding point and many more.
Set the permissions for fellow hunters on the hunting ground. They can also use your hunting ground maps, support you with management or add diary entries to the hunting ground.
Configure your map settings and use practical map features such as your current position in the area and geo-fencing to support you during the hunt.
Assign your diary entries to your hunting grounds for administration.
Hunting Diary: 
Choose from an extensive type list and note down the weight, sex and age. This can also be used for comparing with the shooting plan.
Easily mark kill, shot and sighting position and other incidents on the hunting ground map using GPS.
My Products:
Record your equipment in the app and have all important information at hand, such as invoices, traders, serial numbers and manuals.
Connected Products:
Connect to your thermal imaging camera ZEISS DTI 6 via Bluetooth to conveniently manage your device settings and set up configuration profiles. Take photos and videos in the live stream via Wi-Fi and have your recordings available at a glance in your gallery.
Connect your thermal imaging clip-on ZEISS DTC 3 via Bluetooth and ZEISS DTC 4 via Wi-Fi to use the digital zeroing assistant for creating zeroing profiles. Easily adjust the device settings for your clip-on in the app. Thanks to the Wi-Fi connection, the app also offers you a live stream and a practical gallery feature for your ZEISS DTC 4.

bluejetty:00025902:ios.description:
Find a trusted roommate or your next place to live—Roomie makes it simple.
Whether you're moving for college, relocating to a new city, or looking to fill an open room, Roomie connects you with verified users in your area and on your campus. No more scrolling endless listings or sketchy DMs—just real people looking for what you're looking for.
WHY ROOMIE
- Verified profiles and active spam protection
- AI-powered profile suggestions that help you stand out
- Filter by location, university, gender, and recent activity
- List your room and let interested renters reach out to you
- Free to use, with 5 free chats to get you started
HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign up with email, Apple, Google, or Facebook
2. Complete a quick identity verification
3. Tell us your preferences—roommate type, location, lifestyle
4. Browse matches and start chatting
WHAT YOU CAN DO ON ROOMIE
- Find a college or university roommate
- Match with potential roommates in your neighborhood
- List a room or apartment for rent—free
- Join university group chats to connect with classmates
- Filter searches by gender, distance, and activity
- Block or report users to keep the community safe
ROOMIE PRO
Upgrade for the full experience:
- Unlimited chats
- Ad-free browsing
- Enhanced profile features
- Boost your listing to the top
We offer flexible subscription options because we want Roomie to work for everyone. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch a short ad to unlock more chats anytime.
OUR PROMISE
Roomie will always have a strong free tier. We're an independent team that listens—your feedback shapes every update. Need help? Email and in-app chat support are always available.
Whether you're searching for a roommate or filling a room, Roomie helps you find the right match without the hassle.
Terms of Service: https://www.theroomieapp.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.theroomieapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00080486:ios.description:
Find flexible jobs with JobStack for Work.
Start your job search and find flexible local work with PeopleReady’s job finder app, JobStack for Work! Take control of your job search and work when you want, where you want and as often as you want. Our job finder can help you find a job or gig that fits your schedule and your skills. JobStack for Work has flexible job opportunities with thousands of local businesses across the United States. Start your job search now!
Here’s what you can expect when using JobStack to find a job:
Easy sign-up:
Open the app, create an account and start your job search.
Showcase your skills:
Set your job preferences, add your skills and set a radius of where you want to work. 
Choose jobs that work for you:
We partner with local businesses looking for people like you! Whether you’re interested in short term gig work or a more permanent position - JobStack has you covered! All you need to do is start your job search. 
Flexible jobs, quick pay:
Find a job that works with your schedule and get paid quickly. Many of our positions are eligible for next day pay!
Access more relevant jobs every day:
Whether you’re looking to supplement your income, expand your skillset or just want a flexible work schedule, JobStack for Work has you covered. JobStack helps workers connect with flexible, in-demand gig & temp jobs daily direct from your mobile device. 
Download JobStack today to find a job, fast. JobStack has a variety of roles within our job finder, from construction, events & venues, janitorial & cleaning, disaster & restoration, hospitality – and so much more!
Check out reviews from our workers:
“The new app is great. People Ready staff are highly professional.”
“The ability to instantly search the map allows you to plan jobs out at any location and travel the country. It’s so easy!”
“I love PeopleReady! They have many jobs, great pay and it’s easy to navigate the app to look for jobs. Sign up!”
Use our job finder, sign-up now and start accepting jobs in JobStack for Work!

Learn to code with interactive, hands-on coding labs you can run right on your iPhone or iPad—no setup, no internet required. Tinkerstellar pairs bite-sized tutorials with an on-device Python IDE, so you can practice with real data, libraries, and APIs while you learn.
Start from Python basics (syntax, variables, functions, loops) and progress to practical topics like data analysis, data visualization, web scraping, HTTP/networking, XML/JSON parsing, and machine learning—all at your own pace.
What you’ll do with Tinkerstellar
• Follow step-by-step, self-paced labs with instant feedback
• Run real Python code in a built-in editor that works like a mobile IDE
• Work on practical, real-world projects using real datasets and APIs
• Explore advanced topics gradually, with clear explanations and examples
• Learn anywhere: labs are fully pre-configured and work offline
Why it’s different
• All-in-one environment—no Python install, no configuration, no extra apps
• Interactive learning—write, run, and tweak code as you go
• Real skills—apply Python to everyday tasks: analysis, scraping, automation, ML
Whether you’re a complete beginner or brushing up on advanced concepts, Tinkerstellar offers a clear, approachable path to learning Python and applying it to real problems. The lessons are compact and easy to digest, and the interactive exercises make learning engaging and effective—all directly on your device, even offline.
If you want a practical way to learn Python programming, practice coding, and build confidence with tools used in data science, automation, and more, Tinkerstellar is for you.

bluejetty:00033578:ios.name: ParkColumbus
bluejetty:00033578:ios.summary: The ParkColumbus app, powered by ParkMobile, provides a convenient way to pay for parking in Columbus, Ohio, using your mobile phone. Registering is free and takes less than two minutes to join. The ParkColumbus app takes the stress out of
bluejetty:00033578:ios.description:
The ParkColumbus app, powered by ParkMobile, provides a convenient way to pay for parking in Columbus, Ohio, using your mobile phone. Registering is free and takes less than two minutes to join. The ParkColumbus app takes the stress out of parking. No more searching for coins. No worries about an out-of-service parking meter. With the ParkColumbus app, starting your parking session takes just a few seconds.
Why Use the ParkColumbus app?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Track parking expenses and easily export for expense reimbursements
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the ParkColumbus app and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the ParkColumbus app
How It Works:
• Streets, Lots, and Garages: Enter the zone number on the posted signs in your area. Select the amount of time you want to park, and start your session. Extend time in the app if you are running late.
• Parking Reservations: Search for where you want to park and select the specific parking facility. Choose the date/time and complete your reservation. Follow the instructions in your confirmation to redeem at the parking facility.
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find your car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked

Taking your own notes by hand and spaced-repetition are the best way to learn new concepts, and with Feyn you can do just that. Open up a book on your iPad and co
bluejetty:00160422:ios.description:
Use flashcards, spaced-repetition, and your Apple Pencil to study with Feyn!
Taking your own notes by hand and spaced-repetition are the best way to learn new concepts, and with Feyn you can do just that. Open up a book on your iPad and comfortably draw your flashcards right there using your Apple Pencil in Feyn. The flashcards are phone-sized so that you can then take them on the go and comfortably review them on your iPhone! Their vertical shape also makes them easy to write while multi-tasking on your iPad, and perfect for learning languages written top to bottom like Japanese. If you don't feel like drawing, just type some text using your keyboard or drop images into your flashcards.
In this way, you *learn* on your iPad as you think of how to you summarize new concepts into flashcards, and *memorize* on your iPhone while you review them on the go!
Feyn is fully featured, you can share flashcard to study with your friends. Your flashcards will automatically synchronize between your devices using your iCloud drive. Feyn also supports iOS' Quick Note, Handoff, and keyboard input: type away on your iPad or on our macOS app!
Feyn uses spaced repetition to aid in learning. It will ask you to review flashcards depending on how well you recall them, flashcards you miss will be asked more often, and flashcards you get right less often. This way you minimize the total time you spend studying and maximize retention!
Feyn Pro ads some nice to have extra features like study charts, to see how well you're learning, and flashcard importing. All other features are free and unrestricted. We guarantee that you will always be able to have a complete study experience for free.

bluejetty:00120157:ios.name: GRE Calculator
bluejetty:00120157:ios.summary: GRE Calculator is for students preparing to give the GRE exam. The calculator offered here is one that's very similar to the one offered during a GRE exam's Quantitative section, because it follows the same operational restrictions. Other g
bluejetty:00120157:ios.description:
GRE Calculator is for students preparing to give the GRE exam. The calculator offered here is one that's very similar to the one offered during a GRE exam's Quantitative section, because it follows the same operational restrictions. Other generic calculators aren't tailored specifically for GRE exam practice, which is why using them for practice isn't recommended because it gives students unrealistic expectations of what to expect during an actual GRE exam.
Given below are *some* of the rules enforced by the on-screen calculator supplied during a GRE exam. GRE Calculator here follows these same rules, giving students a more realistic practice experience:
1) No exponent notations are used or allowed.
2) Use of parenthesis is allowed only to a single degree (i.e. nested parenthesis isn't allowed).
3) Any number with an absolute value larger than 99,999,999 is not displayed, and instead the phrase "Error" is displayed.
4) At any time, no more than 8 digits are shown on the screen. Rounding off is used where needed to meet this requirement.
5) Any computation performed that is mathematically undefined, results in the "Error" message being displayed.
6) Mathematical 'order of operations' is enforced. For example, if calculating 8 + 5 x 3 from left to right, the answer would be 23, not 39.
........... and there's still more!
GRE Calculator also offers a style called 'GRE Exam Style', which makes the calculator look strikingly similar to the calculator offered during an actual GRE exam. This offers an even more realistic practice experience for all those using GRE Calculator.
