bluejetty:00064250:ios.name: Tokaido™
bluejetty:00064250:ios.summary:
Discover the digital adaptation of Tokaido, the boardgame phenomenon that has already sold more than 350,000 copies worldwide, and has been translated into 16 languages!
// A magnificent voyage --------------------------------------------
bluejetty:00064250:ios.description:
Discover the digital adaptation of Tokaido, the boardgame phenomenon that has already sold more than 350,000 copies worldwide, and has been translated into 16 languages!
// A magnificent voyage --------------------------------------------
You are a traveler, in the heart of ancient Japan, walking the legendary East Sea road from Kyoto to Edo, trying to make the trek as fulfilling as possible. Discover the most magnificent landscapes, taste numerous culinary specialties, acquire rare and precious souvenirs, bathe in hot springs, visit the temples, and meet other travelers…. Tokaido is a rite of passage for the heart, walking in serenity and contemplation.
But do not be fooled by the peaceful appearance of the voyage, because you will have to demonstrate stronger strategy than your opponents if you want to win!
Whether you sneak along as a messenger, a geisha, or even a ronin, you must discover as many hidden marvels as you can along the road, so your journey is the most satisfying of all!
// Unique ambience --------------------------------------------
Discover characters and scenery in a new light!
Developed by Funforge, original publisher of the boardgame, the video game offers an entirely new graphical experience! Whether you are a first-time fan, in love with Japan, or merely a curious newbie, the digital version allows each player to discover the celebrated Tokaido road in a new form.
While Tokaido retains the famous clean graphic design of the boardgame, it offers unprecedented immersive 3D, realtime graphics, all accompanied by a superb and unprecedented soundtrack, composed specifically for the game.
// Play anywhere, solo, with two, or with the whole world --------------------------------------------
Available for smartphones and tablets, Tokaido offers several play modes for infinite replayability:
- Solo against the AI
- Pass & play
- Online multijoueur
Languages supported: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Chinese.
// A worldwide success --------------------------------------------
** Tokaido, nominated for People's Choice Award, at the 14th International Mobile Gaming Awards 2018
** Tokaido, nominated for Game Artist Award, at the 14th International Mobile Gaming Awards 2018
** Tokaido, nominated for the Hra roku, in 2014
** Tokaido, nominated for the Golden Geek Best Board Game Artwork, in 2013
** Tokaido, nominated for the Golden Geek Best Family Board Game Nominee, in 2013
** Tokaido, nominated for the Gioco dell’Anno, in 2013
// In the press --------------------------------------------
** The Dice Tower: "That’s a gorgeous looking game."
** Gameosity: "The animations are gorgeous, the gameplay is smooth."
** Dageeks: "…the app looks like it’s going to break the tradition of just bringing the digital experience of playing a board game."
** Gameblog: "Everything has been polished: the UI has been completely redesigned for a video game experience."
** TechArtGeek: "It's beautiful, it flows, it's poetic. To make it short this digital version perfectly completes and honors the board game."
** Ludovox: "Graphically speaking, you have to admit that it's gorgeous, giving credit and honor to the original board game edition."
** Tric Trac: "To me Tokaido is therefore a game that invites to travel, and that is perfectly adapted to be played quietly in family."
** Kiss My Geek: "Everything has been carefully modeled in 3D, the UI is flawless and each feedback goes through well designed ergonomics."
// Find us on social networks and the web--------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/Funforge/
https://twitter.com/Funforge
https://www.instagram.com/funforge/
https://www.funforge.fr/

bluejetty:00179367:ios.description:
S2 (Superior Self) is your ultimate workout companion, allowing you to track and visualize your workout progress. Whether you want to lose weight or gain muscle mass, S2 is an excellent tool to help you with progressive overload and beat the yesterday you.
- Premium, beautiful workout app
- No account registration is required
- Fast and intuitive. No load times
- View your muscle fatigue on a body heat map
- Create unlimited workout routines
- Encourages progressive overload
- 1000+ exercises
- Improved insights over time
How does it work?
Start by creating your workout routines in S2. Your first workout for any given routine will act as a baseline for the next workout, encouraging you to do more work by moving more mass. The technical term for this is called progressive overload, and it's the core principle behind any successful strength training.
Between workouts (or during an ongoing workout) you can review your past performance by easily accessing your workout history.
S2 integrates with HealthKit to register your workouts.

bluejetty:00096510:android.name: The Fog mod Minecraft PE
bluejetty:00096510:android.summary: The Fog Mod for Minecraft PE is a chilling and immersive addon that transforms the familiar world of Minecraft into a true survival horror experience. At the center of the mod stands The Man from the Fog, a mysterious entity lurking in the
bluejetty:00096510:android.description:
The Fog Mod for Minecraft PE is a chilling and immersive addon that transforms the familiar world of Minecraft into a true survival horror experience. At the center of the mod stands The Man from the Fog, a mysterious entity lurking in the dense mist. He appears at night, watches the player from afar, and moves closer when you least expect it. Staring directly at him might make him vanish — or attack without warning.
As the fog thickens, the game world fills with eerie sounds, terrifying monsters, and dangerous underground creatures. Players will face unique bosses, craft new armor and weapons from rare materials, and fight to survive each night. Every encounter demands awareness and strategy — danger can strike at any moment.
The mod also introduces new biomes, mysterious structures, and enhanced visual effects that make the game even more atmospheric. The application includes a collection of themed skins and an easy-to-use interface for installing addons. Everything is optimized for the latest versions of Minecraft PE and updated regularly.
The Fog was created for players who crave fear, tension, and the thrill of survival in a world where darkness and mist come alive.

bluejetty:00182680:ios.name: Race Dash for Sim Games
bluejetty:00182680:ios.summary: A companion dashboard app for the F1 25: 26 season, F1 25, F1 24, F1 23, F1 22, F1 2021-16, Gran Turismo 7, Gran Turismo Sport, Forza Motorsport (2023), Forza Motorsport 7, Forza Horizon 6, Forza Horizon 5, Forza Horizon 4, Project CARS 2,
bluejetty:00182680:ios.description:
A companion dashboard app for the F1 25: 26 season, F1 25, F1 24, F1 23, F1 22, F1 2021-16, Gran Turismo 7, Gran Turismo Sport, Forza Motorsport (2023), Forza Motorsport 7, Forza Horizon 6, Forza Horizon 5, Forza Horizon 4, Project CARS 2, Project CARS and Assetto Corsa games which recreates a race car dash and displays live telemetry data from the game to add depth and realism to your sim racing. This second-screen app adds to your immersion in the game.
Display key data such as speed, gear, RPM, fuel level, ERS, laptime and lap delta. The RPM lights are customisable to suit your preference and the whole display can flash at the gear shift point.
A simple dashboard is included with numerous other layouts and styles available as add-ons. Please note that some add-on dashboards are only suitable for certain games. Customisation options includes 'backlight' colour, and speed, pressure, temperature units.
Add up to 10 dashboards to your sequence at any one time (per game) and quickly swipe between them for fast access. Each game can have 3 sequences for Race, Qualifying etc. Some games allow for the dashboard switching to be done from the controller/steering wheel.
The relevant games are required on PC/PlayStation/Xbox depending on platform and telemetry feature availability. This app requires the UDP telemetry mode to be enabled in each game - instructions for enabling this are provided.

A simple dashboard is included with numerous other layouts and styles available as add-ons. Please note that some add-on dashboards are only suitable for certain games. Customisation options includes 'backlight' colour, and speed, pressure, temperature units.

Add up to 10 dashboards to your sequence at any one time (per game) and quickly swipe between them for fast access. Each game can have 3 sequences for Race, Qualifying etc. Some games allow for the dashboard switching to be done from the controller/steering wheel.

If a player in your entry doesn't play, that pick is removed and your entry is recalculated, not lost.

NFL SURVIVOR

MORE TO PLAY
12 sports: NFL, NBA, college football, college basketball, NHL, MLB, WNBA, soccer, tennis, MMA, golf and CS2, plus alt lines and live picks. Between games, try Decks: quick casino-style games like Blackjack and 21 or Bust.

bluejetty:00026143:ios.description:
Welcome to PlantMe - an accurate and reliable plant identifier! Get ready to discover and learn about new plant species, precisely recognize & treat plant diseases and to become a pro at plant care.
You noticed a new unusual plant in you garden and want to know exactly what it is? Your plant hasn’t been doing well and you need a quick diagnosis and clear treatment steps? You’ve been gifted a plant and want to know how to properly take care of it? PlantMe will make these troubles and worries disappear.
PlantMe is all about instant result, useful advice and new planting & treatment knowledge. Let’s hop on the journey of discovering and unraveling nature!
Don’t know when to fertilize, unsure how to repot, don’t know exactly what kind of plant you have or suspect a disease? PlantMe will make all these troubles and worries disappear. 
PlantMe is all about connecting with nature and finding balance, creating a sense of belonging and sharing knowledge. Let us guide you on your journey to becoming a more mindful and savvy plant enthusiast! 
FEATURES
 • Plant identifications 
A picture is all our AI needs for a specific recognition. Do you have 10+ plants in your garden or do you often get plants as presents and don’t really know what they are or have time to care for them? Now you can id your plant in 1 step, add it to your virtual garden and allow us to look after it! 
 • Disease treatment
Our team of botanists + experienced professors = efficient treatment plan. Snap a picture of your plant and get an instant diagnosis. Or get a health-checker and learn how to prevent diseases before it’s too late.
 • Broad-ranging reminders
You can finally free your head from watering, misting, repotting and fertilizing schedules. Yes, all of them! Repeated reminders will take over this responsibility. 
 • Global community
Share your achievements, ask for advice, help out other plant-lovers. A strong and supportive community - that’s what we’re here for!
 • More to come!
Stay tuned for new updates and features.

Bé Học Chữ Cái Tiếng Việt - Vkids
Bé Học Chữ Cái Tiếng Việt - Vkids là ứng dụng giúp trẻ làm quen bảng chữ cái tiếng Việt, học phát âm, đánh vần, tập tô và mở rộng vốn từ thông qua các trò chơi giáo dục sinh động. Ứng dụng phù hợp cho trẻ mầm non, mẫu giáo và các bé đang chuẩn bị vào lớp 1, giúp bé học mà chơi, chơi mà học một cách tự nhiên và hiệu quả.
1. Học Chữ Cái Tiếng Việt
Ứng dụng giúp bé làm quen với 29 chữ cái tiếng Việt thông qua hình ảnh minh họa sinh động, hoạt hình vui nhộn và giọng đọc chuẩn tiếng Việt.
- Học bảng chữ cái tiếng Việt đầy đủ.
- Nhận biết mặt chữ nhanh chóng.
- Học phát âm chuẩn.
- Mở rộng vốn từ theo từng chữ cái.
2. Tập Tô Và Tập Viết
- Bé được hướng dẫn tập tô chữ cái theo đúng thứ tự nét, giúp làm quen với cách viết trước khi vào lớp 1.
- Hướng dẫn từng nét chữ.
- Tập viết chữ cái tiếng Việt.
- Hình ảnh minh họa xuất hiện sau khi hoàn thành.
- Rèn luyện khả năng ghi nhớ mặt chữ.
3. Học Qua Trò Chơi
Mỗi bài học đều được thiết kế dưới dạng trò chơi giúp bé luôn hứng thú.
- Hoạt hình đáng yêu.
- Âm thanh sinh động.
- Tương tác trực quan.
- Sticker vui nhộn.
- Bài thơ minh họa theo từng chữ cái.
4. Phát Triển Ngôn Ngữ
Ứng dụng giúp trẻ:
- Học tiếng Việt.
- Học từ vựng.
- Học phát âm.
- Học đánh vần.
- Phát triển khả năng nhận biết sự vật.
- Ghi nhớ từ mới thông qua hình ảnh.
5. Ứng dụng phù hợp với:
- Trẻ mầm non.
- Trẻ mẫu giáo.
- Bé 3–6 tuổi.
- Bé chuẩn bị vào lớp 1.
- Phụ huynh muốn dạy bé học chữ cái tiếng Việt tại nhà.
Vì sao phụ huynh lựa chọn Vkids?
- Nội dung chuẩn tiếng Việt.
- Thiết kế thân thiện với trẻ nhỏ.
- Hoạt hình và âm thanh hấp dẫn.
- Học mà chơi, chơi mà học.
- Không gây áp lực cho trẻ.

bluejetty:00040454:ios.description:
Passport Health clients now have quick and easy access to vaccines received in our network of travel clinics, booster reminders, travel itineraries and much more. Features include:
--Medical History: Easily fill out or review your medical history before your appointment.
--Medical Records: See which vaccines you've received, when you may need boosters and update any relevant medical records on-the-go through our secure app, designed with you in mind.
--Travel Itineraries: Whether you're going to one destination or five, your personalized travel itineraries can be viewed through the Passport Health app. Want to have the itinerary with you as you travel? View it through the app or download it on your device to see it where internet may not be available.
--Appointment Management: See when and where your appointments are, create new appointments and more through our convenient app interface.
--Yellow Fever Stamp: Many countries, especially in South America and Africa, require proof of yellow fever immunization. While the yellow card is the preferred method for many countries, have some extra peace of mind with yellow fever stamp information available a few taps away through the Passport Health app.

bluejetty:00017447:ios.description:
Check into your Homecourt.
The WNBA App is your home for unmatched WNBA coverage and exclusive access. There's no easier way to keep up with what you love most about the Women's Basketball Association. 
With the free WNBA App, fans get access to:
- Full season schedule and details on where to watch every WNBA game
- Real-time scores, stats, and standings for every game
- Personalized updates on your teams and players with WNBA ID
- Latest WNBA basketball news, highlights, game previews and recaps
- Exclusive behind the scenes access with original content from the league, the teams, and the players
Want even more? Press play on the WNBA with a WNBA League Pass subscription.
WNBA League Pass subscribers get access to:
- Stream live games*
- Full-length replays of every game the next day
- Hundreds of classic games from the archives
- Live DVR
- Ability to watch on up to 3 devices at once
* Blackouts and restrictions apply in the U.S. and Canada.
Fans can download the WNBA App, then sign in with WNBA ID to either access their existing WNBA League Pass account or purchase WNBA League Pass.
WNBA ID makes it easier to be a fan. Sign in and save preferences across platforms, receive personalized content, and access VIP benefits.
Purchase WNBA League Pass and you will be automatically billed every 30 days (monthly packages) or every 365 days (annual packages) until you cancel your subscription.
Get the best free WNBA coverage all season long, including WNBA Draft, preseason games, Commissioner's Cup games and Championship, All-Star Weekend, Playoff games, and Finals. The official WNBA app features action from the Atlanta Dream, Chicago Sky, Connecticut Sun, Indiana Fever, New York Liberty, Washington Mystics, Dallas Wings, Golden State Valkyries, Las Vegas Aces, Los Angeles Sparks, Minnesota Lynx, Phoenix Mercury, Portland Fire, Seattle Storm, and Toronto Tempo.
Please visit support.wnba.com to contact the support team if you are experiencing any issues.
Terms of Use: https://www.wnba.com/terms-of-use
League Pass Terms of Use: https://www.wnba.com/leaguepass/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00121705:ios.description:
Saddle up for adventure with Twilight Sparkle & friends!
After being locked away in the moon for centuries, Nightmare Moon is set free and spreading night across Ponyville! Only Twilight Sparkle and her friends can free Ponyville from her grasp and bring light and friendship back to the land. Help them rebuild the town and reach their dreams in exciting quests!
* Your favorite ponies are here: Rainbow Dash, Fluttershy, Applejack and more!
* Make your Ponyville the most magical place in Equestria and explore Sweet Apple Acres, the Crystal Empire, Klugetown, the Changeling Kingdom, Everfree Forest, and Canterlot.
* Play fun mini-games with your ponies: Ball Bounce, Apple-Picking, Magic Wings, Telescope, Crystal Mine and the Equestria Girls dance game!
* Enjoy official TV show voice talents featured in the game!
_____________________________________________
You can download and play this game for free. Please be informed that it also allows you to play using virtual currency, which can be acquired as you progress through the game, or by deciding to watch certain advertisements, or by paying with real money. Purchases of virtual currency using real money are performed using a credit card, or other form of payment associated with your account, when you input your iTunes account password. You will not be asked to re-enter your credit card number or PIN. Once your iTunes account password is entered, your account will allow in-app purchases for 15 minutes. To restrict or disable in-app purchases, you can change the settings on your device.
This game contains advertising for Gameloft’s products or some third parties that will redirect you to a third-party site. You can disable your device’s ad identifier being used for interest-based advertising in the settings menu of your device. This option can be found in Settings -> Privacy -> Advertising.
Certain aspects of this game will require the player to connect to the Internet.

Instagram: https://gmlft.co/MLP-Instagram-Official
YouTube: https://gmlft.co/MLP-YouTube

Alhamdulillah
Experience the complete Qur’an recitation by Sheikh Noreen Siddiq (رحمه الله), combined with essential Islamic tools to support your daily worship.

• Offline listening with small size
• High-quality streaming
• Selective downloads
All combined with prayer reminders, adhkar, and a faster, cleaner design.
Whether you are listening, memorizing, or reflecting, this app helps you stay connected to the Qur’an every day.

Shop LC is now mobile! Enjoy all the features you love, now on the go!
Enjoy everything you love about Shop LC, now available on your phone and tablet! Browse and buy your favorite exclusive Shop LC brands and stay trendy while on the go. Shop live with your favorite hosts, browse hundreds of listings through our online catalog, or bid, win, and save on hundreds of online auctions. bluejetty:00191857:android.name: Smart Sudoku - Number Puzzle
bluejetty:00191857:android.summary: Sudoku is a logic-based,combinatorial number-placement puzzle. The objective is to fill a 9×9 grid with digits so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3×3 subgrids that compose the grid (also called "boxes", "blocks", or "region
bluejetty:00191857:android.description:
Sudoku is a logic-based,combinatorial number-placement puzzle. The objective is to fill a 9×9 grid with digits so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3×3 subgrids that compose the grid (also called "boxes", "blocks", or "regions") contains all of the digits from 1 to 9. The puzzle setter provides a partially completed grid, which for a well-posed puzzle has a single solution.
Completed games are always a type of Latin square with an additional constraint on the contents of individual regions. For example, the same single integer may not appear twice in the same row, column, or any of the nine 3×3 subregions of the 9x9 playing board.
Choose any difficulty you like.Playing with easier difficulty can exercise your brain, and trying expert-level difficulty can really exercise your mind. Our classic sudoku puzzles game has some features that make the game easier: tips, automatic checks, and duplicate highlights. You can use these features, and you can complete the challenge without any help - everything is up to you! In addition, in our sudoku puzzles game, there is a solution for each topic. Whether you are playing sudoku puzzles for the first time or have reached expert level, you can find everything you need.
feature
1.It has three grids of 6x6, 9x9, and 12x12. It is divided into Easy, Moderate, Hard and Challenge in each grid.
2. Challenge yourself, find errors or enable automatic checking, see your mistakes while playing the game
3. Turn on the pencil mode for recording, just like on paper. Your notes are automatically updated each time you fill out a cell!
4. Highlight duplicates to avoid duplicate numbers in rows, columns, or squares
5. Tips can provide guidance when you are in trouble
6. Count your game history and analyze your best time and other achievements
7. Unlimited withdrawal
8. If you leave Sudoku when not finished, it will be saved automatically. Feel free to go back to the game
9. Highlight the rows, columns, and boxes associated with the selected cell
10. Erase. Eliminate all errors
Train your brain with Sudoku and get involved wherever you are!

bluejetty:00027593:ios.description:
Scan Pokémon cards in milliseconds, check Pokémon card prices and values, track graded slabs and sealed products, and watch your whole collection grow - 100% ad-free.
DittoDex is the all-in-one app for Pokémon TCG collectors, players, traders and investors. It's a card scanner, price checker, price tracker and Pokémon card tracker in one, so you always know what you own and what it's worth.
Lightning-Fast AI Card Scanner
Point your camera and the real-time AI scanner identifies your Pokémon cards instantly - holos, reverse holos, graded slabs, sleeved cards, any orientation, even partially covered. Scan a whole stack or import photos, and set condition, language and quantity as you go. No typing needed: the AI card identifier finds the exact card for you.
NEW: Binder Page Scanning
Scan a full 9-pocket binder page in one shot and add every card on it at once.
NEW: Graded Cards & Slab Prices
Track graded slabs and see graded card prices for every grade from PSA, BGS, CGC, SGC, TAG and ACE, PSA 10 and BGS 10 Black Label included. Analytics show which raw cards could be worth grading.
AI Pokémon Card Centering Tool
Grading a card? Check its centering first. DittoDex finds the edges and measures front and back centering (like 55/45). Fine-tune with a magnifier and export results with photos.
NEW: Pokémon Card Prices & Market Trends
How much are your Pokémon cards worth? DittoDex works as a card price scanner and value checker: scan a card and see its up-to-date TCGplayer market price, plus prices by condition from Near Mint to Damaged. A price history chart shows where each card's value is heading. Follow market movers and set value trends, see prices in your currency, and jump to eBay or TCGplayer listings.
NEW: Portfolio Value Tracker & Analytics

bluejetty:00070316:ios.name: Hokusai Audio Editor
bluejetty:00070316:ios.summary: Hokusai is your multitrack audio editor on-the-go. Record or import a track, and make it sound the way you want it to: not just trimming the ends, but full cut, copy, paste and delete, and a suite of filters and special effects available.
bluejetty:00070316:ios.description:
Hokusai is your multitrack audio editor on-the-go. Record or import a track, and make it sound the way you want it to: not just trimming the ends, but full cut, copy, paste and delete, and a suite of filters and special effects available.
"Beautiful clutter-free interface" — TouchProducer.com
"Hokusai will convince you that audio was meant to be edited with a touch screen — it's just so natural within this app that you’ll find yourself consistently coming back to it." — iOS Music And You
Edit many tracks side-by-side, mix them together, and export to popular audio formats — then transfer them to your computer, send them to another app on your device, or upload to cloud services.
Hokusai is streamlined to give you a clean, clear view of your tracks. Use the familiar pinch and swipe gestures to zoom right in and fiddle with fine detail, or step back to see the big picture. Select pieces of audio. Live "scrubbing" means you can hear the sound under your fingertip as you make your adjustments. And you needn't fear a bad edit with full undo/redo support — even after closing your project.
Hokusai includes a set of useful tools for free, such as fade in/out, normalise volume levels, reverse time, and basic synthesis. If you need more power, Hokusai 3 Pro adds more than 50 new tools and effects, including: Multi-microphone recording, per-track volume/panning, solo/mute, track and final mix level meters, time ruler markers and tempo-based time rulers, selecting across multiple tracks at once, presets and favourites, 48kHz project support, and additional export features — like creating MP3s, or splitting a project up by tracks or markers.
Effects include noise reduction, time-stretching, pitch-bending, echo, reverb, grain synthesis, modulation (AM & FM), resonance, distortion, grunge, vocal levelling, monster voice, high/low/band-pass/notch-cut filter, multi-band EQ and more — many of which can be previewed live. And you can sync your effect settings and favourites through iCloud for quick access from any of your devices.
Projects can also be synced through iCloud, and are compatible with Hokusai for Mac. Whether you want to take your Mac projects with you, or make field recordings as you travel, to be available on your computer at home, Hokusai has you covered.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.wooji-juice.com/privacy

bluejetty:00043093:ios.description:
Feet&Inches Fraction Calculator - Powerful, Exact Construction & Measurement Math
The ultimate feet-and-inches fractional calculator designed for carpenters, builders, architects, woodworkers, contractors, engineers, and DIY enthusiasts. Effortlessly perform exact rational calculations, fractional arithmetic, unit conversions, and area/volume/board-feet measurements in seconds!
Whether you're estimating materials on a job site, framing a house, reading blueprints, or making precise cuts in your workshop, Feet & Inches Calculator eliminates calculation errors and saves valuable time.
==============================================
KEY FEATURES & CAPABILITIES
==============================================
- EXACT FEET & INCHES FRACTION ARITHMETIC
 - Add, subtract, multiply, and divide feet, inches, and fractions directly.
 - Smart fraction display with selectable precision: 1/2", 1/4", 1/8", 1/16", 1/32", 1/64", or exact decimals.
 - Instant fractional rounding options with a single tap.
- COMPREHENSIVE IMPERIAL & METRIC CONVERSIONS
 - Lengths: Feet (ft), Inches (in), Yards (yd), Miles (mi), Nautical Miles (nmi), Meters (m), Centimeters (cm), Millimeters (mm), Kilometers (km).
 - Areas: Square Feet (sq ft), Square Inches (sq in), Square Yards (sq yd), Acres (acre), Square Meters (sq m), Square Centimeters (sq cm), Hectares (ha).
 - Volumes: Board Feet (BF), Cubic Feet (cu ft), Cubic Inches (cu in), Cubic Yards (cu yd), Cubic Meters (cu m), Liters (L), Gallons (gal), Quarts (qt).
 - Mass & Weight: Pounds (lb), Ounces (oz), Tons (ton), Kilograms (kg), Grams (g).
 - One-tap unit conversion: Calculate your result and instantly convert it to any other dimension or unit.
- BUILT-IN TRIGONOMETRY & ADVANCED MATH
 - Full scientific & trigonometric keys: Sin, Cos, Tan, Asin, Acos, Atan for pitch, slope, rise, and run calculations.
 - Advanced operations: Powers (x^y), Roots (y-root-x), Pi, Square Root, Remainder (rem), and inverse functions.
 - Quick circular measurements: Calculate circle area and circumference with ease.
- DIGITAL HISTORY TAPE & MEMORY RECALL
 - Automatic Tape Recording: Keep track of every calculation in an editable history tape.
 - Recall & Copy: Tap to recall past measurements back into the calculator display.
 - Star & Favorite: Star important entries for quick reference during complex builds.
 - Share Results: Easily share calculation logs with clients or crew members.
- INTUITIVE & EFFICIENT DESIGN
 - Dual-line clear display showing full input expressions and live results.
 - Quick backspace for painless typo corrections.
 - Swipeable function panels for fast access to advanced trigonometric and dimension tools.
 - Custom settings: Toggle button click sound feedback, precision levels, and calculation modes.
==============================================
PERFECT FOR:
==============================================
- Carpentry & Framing (Stairs, Rafters, Joists, Layouts)
- Woodworking & Cabinetry (Cut Lists, Joint Spacing, Board Feet Estimation)
- Construction & Contracting (Material Orders, Concrete Yards, Flooring Area)
- Architecture & Drafting (Blueprint Scaling, Plan Verification)
- Roofing, Masonry, Drywall & Plumbing Projects
- DIY Home Improvement & Renovation Enthusiasts
Download Feet&Inches Calculator today for accurate, hassle-free measurement calculations on every project!

bluejetty:00127717:ios.description:
The sophisticated app enables you to create disposable email addresses for free just by activating it.
Your account simultaneously maintains multiple email addresses, which you can utilize for different purposes.
As the service does not have an expiry date, the addresses can be used permanently.
--------------------
- “There is a website requiring email authentication to sign up, but I don’t want to receive spam messages and newsletters…”
- “Someone I’m not very close asked for my email address…”
- “I need a dedicated contact email address and web form for our event”
- “There are people I’m not that close but want to keep in touch”
The app perfectly caters for all these needs!
-------------------
The app’s features are as follows:
* You can simultaneously own as many email addresses as you like!
You can create additional email addresses anytime you like in just a second without making any changes to the existing address. 
You can either use characters of your choice for the address or have the app to generate short addresses. The app, enhanced with our proprietary technology, is also able to automatically generate easily memorable addresses.
* You can communicate with the address (write new messages, reply, forward, and share)! 
You can send out messages from the created address and attach files.
The addresses also support latest features, such as SPF, DKIM (sender authentication), encrypted delivery, etc.
* Push notification is available!
The app notifies the arrival of new messages even when the app is turned off. It can also send out notifications to other smartphones and PCs.
You can turn the push notification off or turn it on only for specified addresses.
* Permanent email addresses!
The addresses you create will function permanently unless you delete them.
Even if you change your mobile or delete the app, the addresses remain intact and can be restored as soon as you sign in!
Although sent and received messages are automatically deleted after a month, you can permanently save them by selecting protection mode for them.
* You can sync with PC and other smartphones!
You can use the same address on PC and other smartphones sync messages.
No difficult setup is required! You only have to sign in with the automatically generated ID and password.
* App supports HTML mails and mail attachments!
The app accepts messages in any formats in any languages. You can also receive emoji and Deco-mails.
You can send and receive mail attachments, while the system blocks malware attachments.
* Perfectly functionable mailer!
You no longer need other email apps, as all functions, e.g. inbox, sent box, filter, mail blocking function, etc. come as a package! 
You can open the service as a regular mailer from a browser, etc.
* Full of original features not available in other mailer apps!
You can share messages with friends as a website with a URL, assign email addresses to other people, and create web forms.
More users are using the app to create dedicated contact email address for campaigns and events.
[Premium Subscription Plan]
You can upgrade to a premium subscription plan as an in-app purchase.
You will receive the following benefits:
- Hide Ads
- Address creation using a premium domain.
- POP3/SMTP access
- Custom domain support
Subscriptions start at $1.49/month or $7.99/year in the US, and can vary by region.
Storage subscriptions purchased from the app will be charged to your iTunes Account, and automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://aquapal.net/privacy.php
Terms of Use: https://aquapal.net/rule.php

bluejetty:00082200:ios.description:
Calling all Championship Manager and Football Manager fans – the ultimate retro classic is back! After the overwhelming success of Retro Football Management, we're excited to present RFM 2027 Football Manager, now with even more content and features to elevate your football management experience.
Key Features:
 - Over 200 Seasons: Dive into over 200+ seasons, many with multiple divisions, and relive football history.
 - Choose Your Club: Now you can manage the club you support and lead them to glory.
 - Leaderboards: Compete with other managers on individual and club leaderboards to see find the worlds best football managers.
 - Enhanced Transfers: Experience a better transfer system with more real players than ever before.
Highlights:
 - Quick Gameplay: Complete a season faster than your daily commute. Perfect for on-the-go soccer management.
 - Multiple Divisions: This version includes top leagues and divisions from various countries, including the latest 2027 season. Can you outmanoeuvre Pep Guardiola and take your team to the Premier League title?
European Competitions: Compete in three major European tournaments: Champions League, EUROPA League, and Conference League.
 - Historical Eras: Pick any era, manage legendary teams and players, and lead your club to victory. Transform underdog teams into champions with our improved tactical options and in-game controls.
 - Player Transfers: Sign the players you love and sell the ones you don't. Your club's past mediocrity won't stop you from signing world-class players.
 - Football Manager Profile: Build your reputation and abilities by winning trophies and completing challenges. Unlock historical seasons for free as you progress.
 - Multiple Game Slots: Enjoy up to five concurrent game slots. Mix and match legendary players from different eras. Bring Totti to Leeds in 2000, Maradona to Munich in 1990, or Messi to Manchester from Miami.
Why Wait?
Download RFM 2027 Football Manager now and embark on a nostalgic journey through the annals of football history. Whether you're a fan of Football Manager, Soccer Manager, or Champ Manager, this retro football management game is sure to captivate you.
Join the community and follow us on Twitter to stay updated on new content, features and prizes.
Relive the golden age of football management and prove your managerial prowess. Can you rise from your sofa to become a legend in football management? Download RFM 2027 Football Manager for free today!

bluejetty:00094939:ios.name: Stocks
bluejetty:00094939:ios.summary: Stocks makes it easy to follow the daily performance of your stocks and the market. Track groups of stocks, indexes, mutual funds, ETFs, and currencies through watchlists. Dive into tickers to get the latest quotes and track movements throu
bluejetty:00094939:ios.description:
Stocks makes it easy to follow the daily performance of your stocks and the market. Track groups of stocks, indexes, mutual funds, ETFs, and currencies through watchlists. Dive into tickers to get the latest quotes and track movements through interactive charts. Stay on top of the latest business news from top publications around the world. With iCloud you can track your stocks across your Mac, your iPad, your Apple Watch, your Apple Vision Pro, or on your iPhone. 
Features
Watchlists
• Group stocks, indexes, mutual funds, ETFs, currencies into one or more watchlists.
• Track performance of tickers in each watchlist at a glance through color-coded spark-lines, price quotes, as well as price change, percentage change, and market capitalization.
• Organize tickers within watchlists manually, by name, by price change, by percentage change, or by market capitalization.
Ticker Details
• Explore specific tickers in your watchlist through interactive price charts for day, week, month, and multi-month periods. Compare prices at different times.
• For any ticker view key details including after-hours price, trading volume, EPS, and more.
• Add the date for a company’s upcoming earnings report to your calendar.
Business News
• Read and watch stories specific to the companies you follow from top-rated business publications powered by Apple News*.
• Apple News+ subscribers can see Apple News+ stories right in Stocks.
More ways to view Stocks
• Use the Stocks app on your iPhone, your iPad, your Apple Watch, your Mac, and your Apple Vision Pro.
• Add Stocks widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen to see price quotes at a glance.
• Ask Siri questions such as “How is the Nikkei doing?” or “What is Apple’s stock price?”
*Top Stories and Apple News stories are available in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia; news stories in other countries are provided by Yahoo.

bluejetty:00157621:ios.description:
CaloriMate — AI Calorie Counter & Meal Planner
CaloriMate is an AI-powered calorie counter and meal planner designed to make calorie tracking fast, accurate, and effortless. Whether you want to lose weight, gain muscle, or simply eat smarter, CaloriMate helps you understand your food with the power of AI nutrition.
No more guessing. No more manual searching. Just smart calorie tracking that fits real life.
** Key Features **
* AI Meal Analysis
Simply describe what you ate and CaloriMate instantly breaks it down into ingredients with accurate calories, macros, and nutrition information. One of the fastest ways to track meals using AI.
* Image & Barcode Scanning
Snap a photo of your meal or scan product barcodes to estimate calories using advanced AI food recognition — perfect for eating out or packaged foods.
* Daily Reports & Insights
Track daily calories, average macros, trends, and patterns to better understand your eating habits and progress.
* AI Meal Planner & Smart Suggestions
Get personalized meal ideas, portion recommendations, and healthier alternatives based on your goals — weight loss, muscle gain, or maintenance.
* Plan Progress Tracking
Visualize your calorie intake, macro balance, and diet progress with clear charts and goal-focused tracking.
* Meal History with Smart Filters
Search, review, and reuse past meals to track faster and stay consistent over time.
* Flexible Meal Logging
Log meals and steps your way: AI chat, manual entry, barcode scanning, or food photos — CaloriMate adapts to your routine.
* Health App Integration
Sync with Apple Health or Google Health Connect to include steps and burned calories for a complete daily energy balance.
* PDF Export
Export your calorie logs and nutrition reports as clean PDFs — ideal for coaches, dietitians, or personal records.
* Custom Instructions & Settings
Control how meals are saved, how AI responds, and how tracking works — fully customizable to your preferences.
* Why Choose CaloriMate?
CaloriMate combines a powerful AI calorie counter, AI meal planner, and nutrition tracker into one clean, easy-to-use app.
- Faster than traditional calorie tracking apps
- Smarter than basic food calorie counters
- Flexible for beginners and advanced users
- Designed for real meals, not perfect ones
Whether you’re counting calories, tracking macros, planning meals, or improving food awareness, CaloriMate makes nutrition tracking simple and sustainable.
Download CaloriMate today and transform the way you track calories, plan meals, and eat smarter with AI.
* Privacy Policy & Terms of Use
https://calorimate.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00098649:ios.description:
Welcome to Thread Away, where clever screw puzzles meet the soothing art of wool pixel coloring!
Immerse yourself in Thread Away, a one-of-a-kind puzzle game that merges the tactile satisfaction of unscrewing pins with the creativity of colorful wool-based pixel art. If you're drawn to hands-on logic challenges or artistic games, Thread Away offers the best of both worlds—turning every level into a rewarding blend of strategy and artistic flair.
How to Play:
- Navigate through screw-pin puzzles that gradually bring pixel art images to life.
- Free tangled threads by removing pins in the correct order.
- Match three same-colored strands to enhance your wool coloring progress.
- Clear each level by sorting out every thread and completing your pixel masterpiece.
- Each puzzle refines your sense of logic and color coordination in a relaxing, creative setting.
Game Highlights:
- A thoughtful combination of screw-pin mechanics and wool art design
- Directly influence wool pixel creations with smart thread-sorting strategy
- Hundreds of varied levels with evolving artistic designs
- A peaceful yet engaging gameplay experience for both puzzle lovers and creatives
Download Thread Away today and start your colorful unraveling adventure. With every pin removed, watch your wool pixel art come to life in vibrant threads!

First available on PC and consoles, the horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is available on mobile!

Reconnect with your inner child to unleash your imagination and find the way out!

Sneak your way out of the Maw’s dreary maze and run from its corrupted inhabitants to escape your childhood fears.

- Tiptoe your way through a dark and thrilling adventure
- Rediscover your childhood fears inside a haunting vessel and escape its eerie inhabitants

- Immerse yourself in the Maw through its creepy sound design

- Revamped interface
- Game Center achievements
- Compatible with MFi controllers
If you run into a problem, please contact us at https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/12-playdigious/ with as much information as possible on the issue.

bluejetty:00149137:ios.name: TenantCloud Pro
bluejetty:00149137:ios.summary: TenantCloud is a comprehensive end-to-end property management system for landlords, property managers, tenants, and service providers to conveniently access and manage essential property-related information such as property details, units,
bluejetty:00149137:ios.description:
TenantCloud is a comprehensive end-to-end property management system for landlords, property managers, tenants, and service providers to conveniently access and manage essential property-related information such as property details, units, leases, accounting, and maintenance requests on their phones and desktops.
Landlord Account Features:
- Unlimited units, listings, and properties.
- Connect with tenants, owners, service professionals, and team members.
- Get a customizable marketing website for your vacancies.
- Get leads for your vacancies.
- Set up an application fee and receive rental applications from your prospects.
- Run background and credit checks right from an application.
- Collect rent online.
- Set up leases with the built-in document builder.
- E-sign the lease and send it to your tenants to e-sign.
- Automatic rent invoices, late fees, and receipts are delivered to tenants.
- Store all transactions, receipts, and invoices in one place and categorize them according to your needs.
- Receive, manage, and send maintenance requests to your service pros.
- Build financial and rental reports in seconds and track your success.
- Generate a 1099 Tax Form and send digital copies to recipients.
- Sync with Google Calendar and QuickBooks.
- TC Messenger for communication with tenants, service professionals, and team members.
- Unlimited support.
Property Manager Account Features:
- Assign a team member to every specific property.
- Set their permissions for every part of the system, such as properties, listings, etc.
- Keep track of all the actions of a team member saved in chronological order with the Activity History.
- Connect with Owners and assign various properties to various owners under the same account.
- Send Owners maintenance requests to approve repair costs.
- Regulate your relationships with the agreements that can be generated within the system.
- Set all the management fees, which will be calculated automatically and shown in the Accounting section.
- Set up your own lease template with our Template Builder.
- Communicate via TC Messenger.
Tenant Account Features:
- Connect with your landlord and have a signed lease agreement ready in seconds.
- Process rent payments easily using ACH, credit, and debit cards.
- Enable Auto Pay to pay automatically on or before the due date.
- Report your rent payments to the credit bureaus to build your credit score.
- Maintain control over all your expenses, including rent, utilities, fees, and deposits.
- Submit maintenance requests to get them fixed immediately.
- Access your rental history by having all your current and past leases consolidated in one place.
- Track renters insurance expiration.
- Create a Renter Profile and apply online for listings.
- Receive invites from landlords to view their listings based on your matching search criteria.
- Keep in touch with your landlord 24/7 with the TC Messenger.
Service Pro Account Features:
- Create a Business Profile to attract new clients.
- Customize a marketing website to showcase your services.
- Get notifications about new maintenance requests that appear in your area.
- Make bids and get selected for the job.
- Connect with the landlord and receive maintenance requests.
- Manage all the maintenance requests in the app, set up your schedule, and keep track of all the work done.
- Change statuses, add the materials used, and create invoices.
- Manually add other maintenance requests to keep track of all orders in one place.
- Get paid with ACH debit and credit cards within your TenantCloud account.
- Store receipts and keep track of your payment activity all in one place.
- Sync with Google Calendar.
Owner Account Features:
- Connect with your property managers and keep track of your properties.
- Get the property reports.
- Fees and distribution tools to pay property managers online.
- Keep track of maintenance.
- Approve maintenance request bids.
- Use TC Messenger for communication.

bluejetty:00070399:ios.name: Bass Tuner BT1
bluejetty:00070399:ios.summary: Bass Tuner BT1 is a chromatic tuner, offering precision tuning for low-frequency instruments like bass guitar, double bass, cello, bassoon, bass clarinet, bass trombone, bass saxophone, and more. This tuner is specifically built to handle t
bluejetty:00070399:ios.description:
Bass Tuner BT1 is a chromatic tuner, offering precision tuning for low-frequency instruments like bass guitar, double bass, cello, bassoon, bass clarinet, bass trombone, bass saxophone, and more. This tuner is specifically built to handle the unique challenges of accurately detecting low-pitched notes. Bass Tuner BT1 combines a powerful tuning algorithm with an intuitive interface, delivering the ultimate tuning experience for bass-range musical instruments.
Key Features:
• Low-Frequency Optimization: Unlike standard tuners, Bass Tuner BT1 is designed to detect deep bass frequencies as low as A0 (27.5 Hz), making it ideal for tuning any bass instrument, from 4-string and 5-string bass guitars to wind and orchestral instruments.
• Extreme Accuracy: Tune with confidence! Bass Tuner BT1 provides precision tuning with an accuracy of ±0.1 cents, making it a perfect tool for professional musicians who need their instruments to be perfectly in tune for studio recordings, live performances, and practice sessions.
• Real-Time Pitch Detection: As you play, Bass Tuner BT1 instantly displays the current note, its frequency, and its deviation from the target pitch. This real-time feedback ensures you can tune to perfection every time.
• Visual Pitch Graph: Gain a deeper understanding of your tuning stability with the live pitch graph, which visualizes your pitch over time, showing fluctuations and helping you achieve consistent, accurate tuning.
• Tone Generator: Bass Tuner BT1 includes a tone generator that produces reference tones across a 3-octave range, perfect for those who prefer tuning by ear or need a reference pitch for tuning multiple instruments.
• Custom A₄ Frequency: Set a custom A₄ frequency to suit your needs, whether you're playing baroque music or experimenting with alternate tunings. Bass Tuner BT1 allows you to tune to non-standard pitch values with ease.
Why Bass Tuner BT1?
Most standard tuners are designed for mid-range instruments, leaving bass musicians with inaccurate readings when trying to tune low-pitched notes. Bass Tuner BT1 solves this problem by focusing specifically on low frequencies, offering unmatched accuracy for bass instruments. Whether you’re a professional performer, a student, or a casual player, Bass Tuner BT1 makes it easier than ever to get your instrument perfectly in tune.
Bass Tuner BT1 is extremely helpful in:
• Live Performances: Quickly tune on stage with real-time feedback and extreme accuracy.
• Studio Recording: Achieve pitch-perfect results with the high-precision tuning algorithm.
• Practice: Visualize your pitch stability and improve your tuning accuracy using the pitch graph.
Get the Best Tuning Experience:
With a user-friendly interface and responsive design, Bass Tuner BT1 ensures you spend less time tuning and more time playing. Whether you’re tuning at home, in the studio, or on stage, this tuner provides the tools you need for fast, reliable tuning in any environment.
Download Bass Tuner BT1 now and experience the difference!

bluejetty:00140141:ios.summary:
Icon Maker - Your Gateway to Personalized Icons and a Custom Home Screen
Transform your device with a unique home screen theme and icons that match your personal style—easily apply a new home screen theme and icons in just a few taps. Use
bluejetty:00140141:ios.description:
Icon Maker - Your Gateway to Personalized Icons and a Custom Home Screen
Transform your device with a unique home screen theme and icons that match your personal style—easily apply a new home screen theme and icons in just a few taps. Use the app to customize home screen elements like app icons, backgrounds, and layouts—it's never been easier to customize home screen settings your way. Enjoy the power of a full home screen customizer that lets you create a look you love—this home screen customizer gives you full creative control to personalize your device.
Make your home screen stand out with Icon Maker! Whether you're a minimalist, a creative enthusiast, or someone who loves to experiment, this app is your go-to tool for designing gorgeous icons effortlessly. With Icon Maker, personalizing your phone is fun and incredibly simple. Let your home screen reflect your unique style with a whole new level of customization!
Why Choose Icon Maker?
With Icon Maker, you can easily create professional-grade, App Store-quality icons that are pixel-perfect and seamlessly integrate with the “Open App” action of shortcuts. It provides a creative playground for users who want to personalize their device's home screen like never before. From everyday essentials to your favorite apps, you can bring your aesthetic vision to life in a few taps.
Unleash Your Creativity: Key Features
Turn Emojis & Letters into Icons:
Transform any emoji or letter into a custom icon that represents your personality. Choose the symbols that speak to you and make them a part of your daily experience.
Access to Over 2000 System Glyphs:
With over 2000 built-in system glyphs, you’ll never run out of options. From minimalistic designs to intricate symbols, there’s a glyph for every mood and function.
Hundreds of Stunning Colors:
Dive into a world of color! Pick from a broad palette of vibrant and sophisticated shades to make your icons pop. Express yourself through every hue imaginable.
Add Photos to Your Icons:
Want your favorite photos on your home screen? Now you can! Add personal images to your icons for an even more customized look.
Fully Customizable Gradients:
Love gradients? Icon Maker allows you to design breathtaking gradient backgrounds for your icons. Combine colors, play with shades, and watch your icons come to life.
Organize with Icon Stacks:
Tired of clutter? Organize your custom icons into stacks for a clean, streamlined home screen. This feature helps you keep your apps neatly grouped while maintaining your aesthetic.
Create Seamless Themes with Matching Wallpapers
With Icon Maker, you can go beyond icons. Take your personalization a step further by generating solid color wallpapers that perfectly coordinate with your icons. Whether you prefer minimalist themes or bold color statements, your home screen will feel cohesive, fresh, and stylish.
Simple to Use, Fun to Explore
You don’t need to be a graphic designer to enjoy Icon Maker! The intuitive interface ensures that everyone can enjoy creating icons, from beginners to experienced designers. Just dive in and start experimenting. With the vast array of customization options, your phone will soon reflect your personal style.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/iconmakerios/privacy/
Terms: https://zipoapps.com/iconmakerios/terms

bluejetty:00165152:ios.summary: Welcome to Rest Stop Tycoon, the most immersive and exciting idle empire-building game on the market! Are you ready to transform a deserted roadside into a bustling empire that dominates the highway? As the owner and manager of your very ow
bluejetty:00165152:ios.description:
Welcome to Rest Stop Tycoon, the most immersive and exciting idle empire-building game on the market! Are you ready to transform a deserted roadside into a bustling empire that dominates the highway? As the owner and manager of your very own rest stop, you have the opportunity to build a highway haven that caters to travelers and truckers alike. 
Your journey begins with an empty plot of land and a single truck pulling in, eager for your services. Your goal is to create the ultimate Travel Center, a rest stop that not only meets but exceeds the needs of every visitor. 
**Building an Empire:**
Start by constructing essential facilities that will attract both truckers and travelers. Build a state-of-the-art **Fuel Station**, ensuring that vehicles of all sizes can refuel and get back on the road swiftly. The fuel station is the lifeblood of your business, and as you upgrade it, you'll see revenue soar. 
Next, provide a diverse range of services to keep your customers happy and spending. Construct a fully-stocked **Supermarket** where travelers can grab snacks and necessities for their journey. Create a cozy **Restaurant** with mouthwatering dishes that satisfy even the most discerning tastes. 
No traveler should ever be inconvenienced, so ensure there are clean and well-maintained **Rest Rooms**, a rejuvenating **Bathhouse**, and a convenient **Laundry** facility. For those in need of rest, offer comfortable **Resting Pods** where travelers can recharge and refresh. 
**Beyond the Basics:**
As your empire grows, you'll unlock even more ways to cater to your customers. Install a **Carwash** and **Repair Shop** that accommodates both cars and trucks. This will not only increase your revenue but also make your rest stop indispensable to all road travelers. 
**Strategic Upgrades:**
In Rest Stop Tycoon, success lies in strategic planning and wise investments. Customize your Rest stop with a wide range of upgrades, including **Revenue Boosters**, **Service Time Reductions**, **Capacity Expansions**, and **Tips Increasers**. Balance these upgrades to maximize efficiency and customer satisfaction.
As you progress, unlock new facilities and expand your empire to cater to different types of travelers. You'll find yourself managing a bustling highway hub with multiple buildings, all contributing to your billionaire tycoon dreams. 
**Idle Supermarket Tycoon Meets Truck and Car Tycoon:**
This game is the perfect blend of **Idle Supermarket Tycoon** and **Truck Tycoon** and **Car Tycoon** games, offering you the unique experience of managing not only a rest stop but also vehicle-related services. Your Rest stop will become the go-to destination for travelers and truckers, and your strategic decisions will determine your path to becoming a billionaire.
**Endless Expansion:**
With each level and milestone, you'll unlock new buildings, services, and customization options. Your Rest stop will evolve and adapt to the changing needs of travelers and truckers. Whether it's a new building, a fresh upgrade, or a decorative touch, there's always something exciting happening at your highway haven.
**Join the Billionaire Tycoon Club:**
Your empire awaits! Are you up for the challenge, Tycoon? Can you build the most successful Rest Stop empire and achieve total **monopoly** over the roadside business? It's time to hit the road, build your fortune, and become the ultimate billionaire tycoon in Rest Stop Tycoon.
Join millions of players who have embarked on this epic journey of empire building. Download Rest Stop Tycoon now and prove your mettle as the reigning highway tycoon! Welcome to the empire of endless possibilities.

bluejetty:00016321:ios.summary:
Snare drum, Tenors, Basses, Cymbals, Xylophone, Marimba, Vibraphone, Write Notation, Charts, Drum Major, Metronomes, Drumhead Tuner, and Challenges!!! In your pocket for the cost of a drum key.
This app isn't for people who like drums or a
bluejetty:00016321:ios.description:
Snare drum, Tenors, Basses, Cymbals, Xylophone, Marimba, Vibraphone, Write Notation, Charts, Drum Major, Metronomes, Drumhead Tuner, and Challenges!!! In your pocket for the cost of a drum key.
This app isn't for people who like drums or are drum-curious. This app is for those who can't stop drumming on anything and everything around them to the point where they are considered "disruptive" to their family, friends, and neighbors.
Honored by Apple as "New & Noteworthy" in the Music apps category.
This isn't some free tap app with canned sound effects and busted graphics. We're bringing the world's best drumming hardware to your fingertips. We've partnered with Dynasty USA Drums, Pro-Mark Drumsticks, Evans Drumheads, and Sabian Cymbals to deliver an optimized marching experience directly to your iPhone and iPad.
And now you can write it, play it, and march it. Are you kidding?!
WRITE NOTATION
That thing you've been tapping on every available surface? Write it down. Build snare, tenor, bass, and cymbal parts with accents, diddles, flams, sticking, dynamics, and tuplets. Go from mf to f with a crescendo. Hit play and hear your battery bring it back. Save and share editable .perc scores, or export PDF and PNG sheet music.
CHARTS
A whole drill book, right here. Place performers, build sets, choose the counts, add your music, and watch the transitions in 3D. Check the drill from overhead, orbit, judges, or a performer's view. Basketball courts, WGI floors, custom spaces, and .drillbook sharing. Yes, we're moving feet now too.
DRUM MAJOR
Somebody's got to keep this thing together. Build a conducting program with different tempos, meters, dynamics, and count-ins. Set a countdown so you can put your device down, then play to the hands. That tempo change isn't going to practice itself.
If you're reading this you're late. 1000s of drummers before you downloaded this app:
• Battery samples professionally recorded by DCI DVD sound engineer Jamie Vanadia at NoiseFloor Ltd. in Chicago.
• Front ensemble samples courtesy of the University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (MIS) project. You guys rock!
• In Snare: toggle between dynamics and standard modes.
• In Basses and Tenors: switch between Pro-Mark nylon and soft mallets.
• In Cymbals: crashes, chokes, taps, sizzles, sizzle chokes, hi-hats, and zings.
• Full and split keyboard layouts for xylophone, marimba, and vibes. Foot pedal on vibes, too.
• Color themes to match your drumline.
THE HARDWARE
Snare: Dynasty MS-XD14 Marching Snare Drum.
Tenors: Dynasty MT-680234, five- and six-drum configurations.
Basses: Dynasty MB-18 through MB-26, 18", 20", 22", 24", 26".
Cymbals: Sabian Synergy HHX, 18" and 20".
METRONOMES
30–300 BPM in wood block, metal, or duts. Quarter, eighth, sixteenth, and triplet subdivisions. Offbeats and all that sweetness you need. Save your presets for the next rep.
DRUMHEAD TUNER
Do the impossible: tune your tenors or basses. Hit-and-hold pitch detection, Low/Standard/High tuning targets, and smart harmonic correction. No piano tuner nonsense, just drums.
CHALLENGES
Test your phrasing memory on snare, tenors, or basses. Put your BPM senses to the test in Line Leader. Grab your practice pad and find out how many single strokes you can play in 30 seconds in Speed Test. Drumline captains, this will put your titles to the test!
It's a whole drumline in your pocket for less than a drum key. Get all this when you buy now! Like no tricks. Buy once. No subscription. No in-app purchases.
Learn more: https://drumlineapp.com
Join the line: https://facebook.com/drumlineapp
Or X: https://twitter.com/drumlineapp
Yo! Don't use real drumsticks on your device... you'll crack your screen and your friends will point and laugh at you! Let's try not to make this the bad, 1985. :)

Understand yourself deeper, sleep better, and move through each day with clarity.
Soulloop is the astrology and meditation app that connects your birth chart to personalized daily guidance for rest, focus, and personal growth.
Whether you feel overwhelmed by stress, seek better sleep, or wish to understand how planetary transits shape your energy, Soulloop offers practical tools grounded in astrology and mindfulness.
◉ Sleep Meditation & Relaxation:
Fall asleep with guided meditations designed for deep rest. Soulloop offers sleep meditations crafted by experts, including hypnotic sleep sessions thousands of users access every night. Combine your meditation practice with daily transit insights to know when to rest, recharge, and restore your energy.
◉ Birth Chart & Personalized Astrology:
Your birth chart is more than a snapshot of the sky at the moment you were born. It is a map of your strengths, challenges, relationships, and purpose. Soulloop reads your natal chart and delivers personalized insights every day, showing how current planetary transits interact with your unique blueprint.
◉ Daily Transits & Astrology Insights:
Each day brings new cosmic weather. Soulloop tracks planetary transits in real time and translates them into clear, actionable guidance for your day. Practical astrology that navigates love, career, health, and personal decisions with confidence.
◉ AskPRI – Your AI Astrology Assistant:
Have a question about your chart, a transit, or how astrology applies to your life right now? AskPRI is your personal AI assistant, trained in astrology and wellness, ready to answer in real time. Personalized answers based on your birth chart.
◉ Guided Meditations for Every Moment:
Beyond sleep, Soulloop offers guided meditations for anxiety, stress relief, focus, and emotional balance. Each meditation complements your astrological profile, so your mindfulness practice aligns with your cosmic rhythm.
◉ What Makes Soulloop Different:
Soulloop blends karmic astrology, AI, and transformative wellness practices into one app. Your daily transit reading informs your meditation. Your birth chart shapes your wellness journey. Everything works together for growth from the inside out.

• Real-time planetary transit tracking and guidance

bluejetty:00044130:ios.description:
Fancy text, cursive fonts, kaomoji and stylish bios, typed right from your keyboard. No copy-paste.
Fonts Keyboard is a real keyboard, not a copy-paste generator. Pick a style, open Instagram or WhatsApp, and just type.
FEATURED STYLES
Cute, Gothic, Aesthetic, Bio, Love, Funny, plus seasonal looks for Halloween, Christmas and New Year. Each style is a ready mix of font, symbols and decoration. Tap it on Home or in the keyboard's Aa panel.
TYPE WHERE YOU ALREADY CHAT
Works in Instagram, WhatsApp, Snapchat, TikTok, iMessage and anywhere else you type.
LINES AND KAOMOJI
- Lines: ready-to-send captions and replies in packs like Rizz, Sweet, Replies and Comebacks. Each pack comes in its own matching font, sent in one tap
- Mine: save lines you reuse and send them from the keyboard
- Kaomoji: cute text faces sorted by mood, with new ones for the holidays
CREATE YOUR OWN
- Create Font: turn a look you like into a font you can type
- Create Effect: stack marks above, below and through your words
Mix them, save them, and use them from the keyboard.
ONLY ON THIS KEYBOARD
- Repeat Mode: echo, triple or repeat a message to make typing a game
- Encrypted Chat: scramble a message so only someone else using Fonts Keyboard can read it back. A fun private note between you two, not a replacement for a messenger
- Dark Mode: the keyboard follows the system look, easy on the eyes at night
ALSO HANDY
- Clipboard: paste what you just copied without leaving the keyboard
- Symbols: extra characters when a style needs them
HOW TO START
1. Open Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards
2. Add Fonts Keyboard
3. Turn on Allow Full Access
Allow Full Access lets the keyboard use styles, fonts, lines and extras. We don't collect what you type.
New seasonal styles arrive for the holidays. Make every message look like you.

bluejetty:00040114:ios.description:
Welcome to SleepTracker, use this app to know your sleep and improve your sleep quality.
How to use:
- Nature sound and white noise
Sleep soundly with music. Natural sounds, such as rain, ocean waves, wind, and birdsong, as well as white noise, like the rustling of writing or the book turning sound, can all help with relaxation and sleep.
- Meditation
Some research suggests that meditation and mindfulness practices may affect the functioning or structure of the brain, help you balance, calm and build resilience. Choose from daily meditations to reduce stress and manage anxiety.
- Sleep sound recording
We help you recognize your sleep sound and record it. We can help you check how much you’re snoring, and record other sound when you're sleeping.
- Stats, Charts, Analysis
Watch your sleep quality and improvement with our daily, weekly and monthly data statistics.
App Working Requirements
- Keep your phone near your pillow or bed.
- Sleep alone to minimize interference.
- Ensure your phone is charged or has sufficient battery.
Language Support
We currently support: English, Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Filipino, Malay, Turkish and Russian.
Get started with SleepTracker: Record & Improve tonight. Hope you sleep like a baby!
DISCLAIMER:
+ When using the sleep tracker, you will need to grant your phone's foreground service permission. This feature requires a certain amount of battery power, so it is recommended that you charge your device while using it.
+ Don’t use meditation or mindfulness to replace conventional care or as a reason to postpone seeing a health care provider about a medical problem.
+ SleepTracker: Record & Improve is not intended for medical use, but rather to improve general fitness and well-being, especially in terms of better sleep. 
Privacy Policy: https://mybptracker.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service: https://mybptracker.com/service.html

bluejetty:00035379:ios.name: ADHD Schedule Planner: Weel
bluejetty:00035379:ios.summary: Time is a slippery thing—but with the Weel ADHD planner, it's all under control. Weel transforms your daily schedule into a clear, single image, using an intuitive 24-hour analog watchface that provides a full-circle view of your time. This
bluejetty:00035379:ios.description:
Time is a slippery thing—but with the Weel ADHD planner, it's all under control. Weel transforms your daily schedule into a clear, single image, using an intuitive 24-hour analog watchface that provides a full-circle view of your time. This unique feature is especially helpful for people with ADHD, dyscalculia, or time blindness. Even if you're neurotypical, the Weel ADHD planner offers a refreshing, visual way to manage time effectively!
Whether you’re juggling tasks, working across time zones, or avoiding last-minute scrambles, Weel’s design helps everyone stay organized and on track.
Key Features of Weel ADHD Planner:
• Stay on top of your schedule: The 24-hour analog watchface allows you to see your entire day at a glance, helping you focus on upcoming tasks and avoid losing track of time before important events.
• Plan ahead: Attach notes or checklists to events so you remember exactly what to prepare for meetings or appointments.
• Factor in travel time: The Weel ADHD planner helps you account for travel between events, so you avoid scheduling conflicts and always arrive on time.
• Manage time zones easily: Simplify scheduling for international meetings or travel plans without the confusion.
• Customizable for your needs: Weel is highly configurable, allowing you to tailor the app to your own preferences and organize your day your way.
• Widgets & Apple Watch compatibility: With customizable widgets and Apple Watch integration, Weel helps you visualize your entire day with the power of its unique 24-hour watchface.
Looking for More? Try Weel+ ADHD Planner
Weel+ enhances your scheduling with advanced tools for even smoother time management. Try a free 7-day trial to unlock features like additional calendars, recurring events, and more.
With Weel+ ADHD planner, you can:
• Add multiple calendars: Keep personal, work, and family schedules separate but accessible in one app.
• Create repeating events: Set daily, weekly, or custom recurring events to never miss commitments.
• Apply travel time to recurring events: Keep your schedule running smoothly throughout the day.
• Get priority support: By subscribing to Weel+, you help support our team and receive priority assistance.
Weel+ ADHD Planner Subscription Information:
• Available in Monthly and Yearly options.
• Your iTunes account will be charged at the end of your free trial if you choose to continue.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings on the App Store.
Why Weel ADHD Planner is Different:
Weel ADHD planner is more than a calendar—it's a comprehensive time-management tool designed for inclusivity. Traditional apps give a linear view of time, but Weel uses a 24-hour analog watchface to visually structure your day. This circular design makes it easier for people with ADHD or neurodivergent needs to understand and manage their time.
Weel makes your schedule tangible and easy to grasp, offering a clearer picture of your responsibilities. And, while it's great for ADHD, it’s also powerful for anyone who wants a smarter way to manage their time.
Perfect for Everyone:
Whether you’re a professional juggling meetings, a parent managing your family’s activities, or a student balancing school and social life, Weel ADHD planner makes time management simpler. Its visual approach helps anyone manage their time better. Available on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, Weel ensures you’re always connected to your schedule.
Stay Organized with Weel ADHD Planner:
Weel is your all-in-one solution for time management. Its 24-hour analog watchface and flexible customization make it a fresh, visual, and easy-to-use app. Upgrade to Weel+ for advanced scheduling features and support our development team.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://weelplanner.app/privacy-policy/

--- HIIT & Tabata – Train anytime, anywhere ---
This app will empower you to do your HIIT workout better than before, track your time, sets, and cycles.
Work out at the beach, during your lunch breaks, at the gym, in parks, or even at home.
Make every second count with workouts prepared by our team of professionals. Exercise anytime, anywhere.
Crush your fitness goals with HIIT & Tabata, combining boxing games, run tracker, and run games. Train anywhere with fun boxing games, track every move using the run tracker, and boost cardio through exciting run games. Boxing games keep you challenged, the run tracker monitors progress, and run games add variety. Make workouts engaging with boxing games, stay on target with the run tracker, and enjoy the thrill of run games every day.
HIIT & Tabata help you take your workouts anywhere. Choose from professionally designed routines or create your custom intervals. Track time, sets, and cycles with a precise, easy-to-read timer. 
--- Fast, effective workouts in your pocket ---
Train at home, in the gym, at the park, or even during a quick break at work. Follow guided instructions and video classes for proper form and better results. Adjust work and rest periods to suit your fitness level. 
Sync your progress with Apple Health for a complete view of your activity. Suitable for beginners and experienced athletes, it supports building strength, boosting endurance, and staying motivated. Each workout is structured to maximize your time, allowing you to focus on performance and achieve measurable results. 
*** Your HIIT training partner ***
HIIT & Tabata is simple to use, delivers powerful results, and is always ready to support your training whenever you need it.
We also offer the option to record your workouts on the Apple Health App if you allow us to do so by using HealthKit.
------------------------------

Your iTunes account will be charged for each new term within 24 hours prior to the expiration of the current subscription. The current term of In-App subscriptions cannot be canceled. You can disable the automatic renewal via the iTunes account settings at any time.

bluejetty:00145361:ios.description:
Would you like to increase your productivity, create good habits and reach your goals? The Flynow app will help you!
Flynow Productivity is the essential app to help you be more productive, reach your goals and become the best version. Organize your daily tasks, create positive habits and efficiently set goals, all in one place. With an intuitive interface and powerful features, Flynow is your trusted companion to maximize your efficiency and motivate your progress. Import and Sync your calendar events with Flynow.
Main Resources:
# Task and Time Management:
Organize your tasks using the Triad of Time method. Prioritize, set task frequency, and receive notifications to ensure you never miss an important deadline. Create checklists for your tasks. Categorize your tasks according to the Wheel of Life. Use the Timer to carry out tasks with focus and have 10 different modes of viewing your activities at hand: To-Do, Timeline, List and Agenda in variations of 1 day, 3 days, Week and Month.
# Creating and Tracking Habits:
Create lasting habits using the Habit Loop. Set timely reminders to stay on track. Track your progress with weekly, monthly and yearly history and statistics of your habits. Possibility to set a daily goal for your habit.
# Goals and objectives:
Set goals efficiently with the SMART method. Associate tasks and habits with your goal and see statistics on your goal-related activities. Choose the best way to measure goal progress: Manual, Checklist or relate to achieving a habit. Use timer, timer to work focused on your goal. Add daily notes to your goals.
# Use statistics to your advantage:
Gain valuable insights into your performance. Track statistics about each habit and task, view the percentage of activities performed, graphs referring to your Triad of Time and Wheel of Life. In addition, access complete reports in different periods: daily, weekly, monthly and yearly.
# Gamification: Have fun in the process
Our app uses gamification to motivate you to follow your defined routine. By carrying out your activities, you add points and participate in the weekly, monthly and annual rankings. By acquiring points, you reach higher levels. Also, get rewards for completing your goals, and performing habits for a certain consecutive sequence.
# Timer and Stopwatch
Use the Timer & Stopwatch to stay focused on your tasks, habits and goals and measure the time spent on each activity. Plus, see weekly, monthly, and yearly graphs of time spent on each activity.
# Daily notes
Add notes for each instance of your tasks, habits, and goals. You can write what you did each day, what difficulties you had, how you felt and etc...
# Web Platform & Chrome Extension
Access the app's features from your computer and manage your habits, goals and tasks with the Web Platform and Google Chrome extension.
# widgets
With the Widget, you can view your activities for the day and complete them from your cell phone's home screen, without having to open the application.
In the face of all these benefits, you won't let this chance pass you by, will you? Install the Flynow App today, be more productive and become the best version of yourself!
