bluejetty:00040683:ios.description:
Seep - Sweep Cards Game is one of those exciting card games in which the total value of the cards is 100 points.
If you are looking for card battle games online or “Taash Ke Patte” Wala game to play with your friends in leisure, try this Seeping card game. Seep card game is also known as sweep or shiv and it is one of the most popular card games in India and Canada. We have brought you seep games online that you can play from anywhere in the world. It’s a highly challenging game where the player has to collect as many points as possible. The real challenge is to remember cards as much as possible. This Indian classic Taash game can be played by 2 or four players.
How to play:
If you are searching for a card game to play with 2 or more friends, try this fantastic card multiplayer. The 2 players can play with each other and when it comes to 4 players, they can form groups of two and sit in the opposite side to play. There is total 100 points in the game and they are distributed as follows:
1. Each Spade card has a point corresponding to its number.
2. Joker, Queen and King of spades will have 11, 12 and 13 points respectively.
3. Each Ace has 1 point.
4. 10 of diamond has 6 points.
So, in total we have hundred points. Team picking more points will win the game. 
Initially first player will get 4 cards. From the he has to bid a value equal or more than 9. Then he has to either create a house equal to that value.
You can create up to 2 houses on the table with the value of 9 or more. You should have that card in your hand of which you are creating the house. There are different strategies of creating a house which you will learn while playing the game. To pick a house you have to throw the card of same value and you will get all the points which are inside that house. 
If a player picks all the card from the table, then it will be counted as SEEP and that player (or team) will get 50 points. 
You can either play a Single match or you choose to play Bazzi mode. In Bazzi mode, you will have series of 5 matches. The team scoring most, or reaching to 100 points first will win the Bazzi.
We also offer you to play seep online. You can challenge your FB friends and have a blast. This seep app also allows you to analyse your performance with detailed statistics. 
If you are searching for Teen-patti multiplayer games or card strategy games, then this sweep/seep online game is your right choice.
Key Features:
Fun Gameplay:
Whether you are looking for card’s online games with friends or card battle games to play in your leisure, try this seep game with fun gameplay. You can play it also with online friends on Facebook. The easy user interface and rules will allow you to have ultimate fun of playing a card game. Only 17 cards contain value and if you gather more points before other players do, you become the winner!
For Everyone:
We have designed this PVP card game for everyone around the world. No matter if you are in the USA, Canada or India, play this “Taash ke patte wala” game anywhere in the world. Our multiplayer games online will keep you delighted for hours.
Free and Online:
Are you searching for a card game online and free? Or, card battle online games multiplayer with friends? Try our one of the best free & easy online games without thinking twice. This sweep card game is absolutely free of cost and you can play with strangers all over the world.
So, if you are looking for Teen-patti online games or Tash games or online card games free of cost, then this seep card game is your right choice. Pick up the cards with values, score more before other players, try your luck and have limitless fun. You can also check out the detailed results of the match effortlessly.
Install Seep - Sweep Cards Game on your mobile device, play with your friends or strangers around the world and enjoy playing the most amazing card game ever!

bluejetty:00184489:ios.description:
***** (5/5) "Word Wow is an explosion of thought-provoking, perplexing, and thrilling fun for almost all ages." - AppAdvice
Word Wow is a word game where you make words to dig deeper into the ground. As you dig down, Worm will follow until you can guide him to the bottom before time runs out. You need to be able to make words quickly to string together bonuses, as well as just to clear the path.
If you find Worm to be stuck and you can't come up with any words, you can use a bomb to clear some of the tiles. You have a limited number of bombs, but you can earn more as you make more words. As Worm moves down the board, more letters become available.
Some levels have a hidden gem behind one of the tiles, and if you can find all the gems in all the levels of a world, a bonus level is opened where you can really rack up the points!
The bigger the words that you can make the more points you'll earn. Try and make enough points each level to earn all three stars.
Word Wow will sharpen your brain as well as your reflexes. Help a worm out! 
Features: 
* Fast action 
* 2350+ Levels and 69 distinct worlds 
* Bonus level for each Ruby, Emerald, Diamond, Amethyst and Quartz world
* Lots of replay value as you try to compete with others in Game Center

bluejetty:00182801:ios.description:
LOWERLANDER is the sequel to Flat Black's 2015 somewhat-acclaimed retro-rpg, Lowlander! 
"Lowlander II is a great game, possibly the most enjoyable, largest and best produced game of its type available that’s not got the Ultima name attached to it. " - My Boxed Universe
**** 1/2 stars from TouchArcade!
Yarak means business. She ain't got time for you! Get that armor on- there's adventuring to be done! 
Generations after the mighty LOWLANDER vanquished the nefarious Azamon, a new villain has arisen. The evil enchantress, YARAK! The realm needs a new hero -- will you be the one? 
Styled after the early Ultima games from Richard Garriott, Lowerlander will make your iPhone 7 Plus feel like an Apple II+. That's a good thing! Plus, Lowlander's new sibling packs the same one-handed portrait-style gameplay that sensible people prefer! 
TouchArcade had this to say about the first one’s shameless imitation of Ultima II: “4.5 stars ... Lowlander is an interesting case, because it's not often that a game paying direct homage to a classic is actually better than said classic.” Unquestionably undeserved, but that’s high praise!
FEATURES
- glorious one handed, portrait-style, retro-RPG action
- over 16 hours of minimalist adventure
- explore a huge world, gain experience and rise in power
- delve into dark dungeons for loot and riches
- three save-game slots
- save games to the cloud and download them later or to another device
- no in-app purchases. buy once, own forever
- special spell and environmental effects
- OVER 8 colors
- realistic moving water and lava

bluejetty:00146434:ios.description:
The Depression Inventory Depression Test is a psychological self-assessment tool used worldwide. This digital adaptation provides a convenient way to track your mental well-being through regular self-assessment.
Key Features:
• Complete privacy - all assessment data stays on your device
• Structured questionnaire with 21 carefully designed categories
• Comprehensive results showing your depression severity level
• Easy-to-understand scoring system
• Reminder system to help track your mental health over time
• Clean, intuitive interface designed for minimal stress
• Regular assessment recommendations for better mental health monitoring
This depression test helps evaluate multiple aspects of mental health including:
• Mood and emotional state
• Energy levels and fatigue
• Sleep patterns
• Appetite changes
• Concentration abilities
• Social engagement
• Physical well-being
• Daily activity levels
• Self-perception
• Future outlook
Based on an internationally recognized depression assessment framework, this mental health test provides insights into your emotional well-being. Whether you're experiencing mild mood changes or seeking to understand your mental health better, regular assessment can help track your psychological state over time.
The test includes a thorough evaluation of various symptoms associated with mood and anxiety, offering a comprehensive self-assessment experience. Each question is carefully presented to ensure a comfortable experience.
Features Coming Soon:
• Detailed progress tracking
• Extended result history
• Comprehensive trend analysis
• Customizable reminder schedules
Privacy and Security:
We understand the sensitive nature of mental health assessment. Your privacy is our priority - all test responses and results are stored locally on your device.
Recommended Use:
For the most effective monitoring of your mental well-being:
• Take the assessment regularly
• Complete all questions honestly
• Use the reminder system
• Track changes in your scores over time
• Share results with a qualified professional if needed
This application offers a respectful, private way to conduct regular mental health check-ins using a structured assessment framework. Whether you're monitoring your well-being or seeking general insights, this tool provides a simple approach to reflecting on your psychological state.
IMPORTANT MEDICAL DISCLAIMER:
This app is for self-assessment purposes only and should not be used to diagnose or treat depression or any other condition. The app is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding your health. Never disregard professional advice or delay seeking it because of information provided by this app.

bluejetty:00169844:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Buffalo area with the 93.7 WBLK app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from 93.7 WBLK Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the 93.7 WBLK app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the 93.7 WBLK app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00159407:ios.description:
NutriScan is your AI calorie tracker and food journal: snap a photo of your meal, scan calories, track macros and carbs, and stay on your diet. 150k+ downloads, 4.6 stars.
How NutriScan helps:
1. Calorie counting from a photo
• Snap your plate and get calories, protein, carbs, fat, and portion cues in seconds. Every meal lands in your food diary on its own, no typing.
2. A diet plan built for your goal
• NutriScan builds a personalized 28-day meal plan for weight loss, muscle gain, diabetes, PCOS, or pregnancy. The meal planner keeps your calorie goal, calorie deficit, and macros matched to your real day.
3. Monika, your AI nutrition coach
• Monika reviews your logged meals, spots patterns, shows what fuels your energy or hurts your sleep, and keeps your goals in front of you. Think of her as an AI dietitian in your pocket.
Calorie counter, macro tracker, and food scanner in one app:
• AI meal scanner: the app recognizes dishes, estimates portions, and turns each plate into calories, protein, carbs, fat, and other nutrients.
• Food tracker without the typing: photos, voice notes, templates, repeat meals, and AI suggestions make logging meals quick.
• Macro counter and carb tracker: set your own protein, carb, and fat targets for low carb, keto, high protein, or a balanced diet.
• Meal planning for real life: copy meals, schedule repeats, and adjust nutrient goals so the plan still works on busy days.
• Intermittent fasting built in: 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, or a custom window. The timer, streaks, and NutriBites tie fasting hours back to your macros.
• Water tracking: one tap adds a glass from the home screen, with a daily goal set from your weight and a weekly average.
• Weight tracker and trends: calories, macros, water, and weight over time, next to steps and sleep from Apple Health.
• Meal reminders on your schedule: meals, water, and supplements from breakfast to bedtime, at the interval you pick.
Free mode keeps reminders, basic summaries, and the meal log active, so you can try calorie tracking before unlocking more.
What makes NutriScan different:
NutriScan brings the photo scanner, calorie counter, food diary, meal planner, and AI coaching into one simple daily flow. You do not just see numbers. You learn why a meal fits your goal or does not.
The method:
Logging meals by photo takes less effort than manual entry, so the food journal actually lasts. NutriScan draws on 2M+ dishes for faster estimates and clearer advice.
Who NutriScan is for:
• Weight loss: hold your calorie deficit, track your weight, and follow a diet built on the meals you actually eat, not on tables.
• Muscle gain: protein and calories under control, with a meal plan shaped around your training.
• Diabetes: carb counting, every meal logged, trends that are easy to read.
• PCOS and pregnancy: plans that account for nutrients, fullness, and your routine.
Start with a 7-day free trial. It includes AI coaching, meal features, and micronutrient tracking.

bluejetty:00121085:ios.name: Dot-a-Pix: Connect the Dots
bluejetty:00121085:ios.summary: Connect all dots to reveal a beautiful color picture! Each puzzle consists of a collection of color dots with clues next to each dot. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by connecting the dots in ascending order and according to their
bluejetty:00121085:ios.description:
Connect all dots to reveal a beautiful color picture! Each puzzle consists of a collection of color dots with clues next to each dot. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by connecting the dots in ascending order and according to their color starting with 1 and ending with the highest number.
Dot-a-Pix are an advanced adaptation of the classic dot-to-dot puzzles which provide high quality color pictures when solved. Starting with dozens and going up to several hundreds of dots, Dot-a-Pix puzzles create beautiful detailed pictures and provide the satisfaction as if you drew them yourself.
The game features a Bring to Focus button to help locate the active dot, and an option to instantly move the active dot to any number for faster solving. 
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Dot-a-Pix includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 56 free Dot-a-Pix puzzles in color
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually created by artists, top quality puzzles
• Up to 1200 dots per puzzle
• Hours of creativity and fun
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Zoom, reduce, move puzzle for easy viewing
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Bring to Focus button to help locate active dot
• Moving active dot to any number for faster solving
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Dark Mode support
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Dot-a-Pix have also become popular under other names such as Picture Dots, Dot-to-Dot, Join the Dots and Connect the Dots. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00186731:ios.description:
Express yourself as you break boundaries and explore the many wondrous adventures Dr. Panda Town has to offer! Play and learn at your own pace in an open world full of fun!
Create your own adventures with Dr. Panda Town – where everything is up to you! Explore your house and take a walk around Town. Visit the mall and go on a shopping spree in tons of different stores. Take a Vacation on the cruise of a lifetime and visit more than 6 exotic islands. Plan a trip to Pet World, a pet-themed amusement park and town. Experience real-life things in a world without consequences!
Make your own characters in the character creator! Customize characters to show off your style. Choose from dozens of hairstyles, noses, eyes and more - there are thousands of combinations. Play with dozens of unique and diverse characters that are ready for the next adventure.
Create stories and roleplay using the Dr. Panda Town app! Express yourself and use imagination to make up scenarios in over 40 unique and different places! Tell your stories in any setting you can think of!
DR PANDA TOWN FEATURES:
Explore Over 40 Locations!
- Choose to visit the Town, Mall or Pet World Amusement Park 
- Explore locations and learn at your own pace as you interact with familiar real-life places
- Roleplay through experiences and learn without the consequences
- Play in the arcade, hatch dragon eggs at a cafe and explore ancient ruins
- Discover dozens of hidden secrets!
Create Characters to Play With!
- Play with unique, diverse characters or create your own
- Customize your character’s hair, facial features and more
- Show off your style!
Make Your Own Stories!
- Roleplay and create stories to play out
- Will you be a police officer that fights crime or be the world’s greatest vet?
- The only limit is your imagination!
*All screen recordings in Video Maker mode are saved locally on the device and never shared by the app itself.
Subscription details:
•Subscribe to unlock more areas to play in in Dr. Panda Town
•Subscriptions of Dr. Panda Town can be purchased on either a monthly or yearly basis, whichever suits you best. On confirmation of your purchase, payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
•Your subscription will auto-renew unless you switch off auto-renew at least 24 hours before your current subscription period ends. If you don’t wish to auto-renew, you can switch it off at any time via your Account Settings. 
•Use your Dr. Panda Town subscription on multiple devices registered with the same Apple ID. This method is not compatible with Apple’s Family Sharing feature. 
•If you start a free trial, your account will be charged at the end of your trial period for the monthly or annual subscription term chosen. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to Dr. Panda Town, where applicable. 
Need to get in touch? There’s always someone from the Dr. Panda team on standby ready to help, drop us an email: support@drpanda.com 
Privacy Policy 
We know how important privacy is to you and your family. We work hard to keep anyone playing our game safe and secure. Please get in touch with us if you have any questions.
Learn more about this in privacy policy: https://drpanda.com/privacy/index.html  
Terms of Service: https://drpanda.com/terms/index.html
About Dr. Panda
Dr. Panda is a developer of games for kids. We develop games with educational values that help kids learn about the world. All of our games are safe and do not contain inappropriate content.
If you’d like to know more about us and how we design apps for your kids, or just to say hi, visit us at www.drpanda.com or get in touch at support@drpanda.com or on Facebook (www.facebook.com/drpandagames), Twitter (www.twitter.com/drpandagames) or Instagram (www.instagram.com/drpandagames ).

bluejetty:00031665:ios.description:
"RouteHistory" is a GPS Tracker Application.
It specializes in showing you the route you have traveled and can show you all your past GPS logs at once.
It can be used in a variety of situations such as driving, traveling, and running.
Output to GPX files is supported by default.
Once you've started logging, you can use another app or even lock the screen to log.
Function
- Record GPS logs
- Set waypoints to log
- Suspend Records
- Additions to the existing log
- View Log
- Tag function
- Output to a GPX file
- Importing GPX files
- View all logs at once
- Batch display of logs for specified conditions
- Deleting the log
- Syncing data with iCloud
- Recording while displaying the past log
- Corresponds to units of km and mi
- Backup Function
- Log join function (requires viewing of reward ads)
- Delete log location (requires viewing of reward ads)
The iCloud sync feature is available by enabling the settings.
The iCloud sync feature is also available on iOS 13 and above.
The GPX file that can be imported is basically a GPX file output from this application, but it is also possible to import a GPX file created by another application, etc., if it is a GPX file with the same configuration as this application.
Premium Add-on
1. Select and display multiple logs
 - You can select and display multiple logs.
 - You can change the color displayed for each selected log.
2. Playback of recorded routes
 - Detailed information such as time of day, distance, and elapsed time of a location recorded at a certain point can be displayed.
3. Display a portion fo the log in a specified range.
 - Output a specified range to a GPX file.
4. Displaying route color settings for each group
 - All log display screens can be set to display the route color for each group.
5. Hide Ads
You can purchase Premium Add-on from the settings screen.
Unlimited use with a single purchase.
*Please note that prices are subject to change without notice.
RouteHistoryPlus function (cloud function)
1.Personal folders in the cloud can be used.
 - Logs can be saved in the cloud.
2.Group folders can be created in the cloud.
 - Share logs with multiple users.
3.Share location information
 - Share your location with other users on the logging screen.
* Some functions are available for free.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q. GPX files cannot be loaded in some applications
A. Please try it with the file that you selected [GPX Export] when you output GPX file.
Note
Since it uses the iPhone's built-in GPS for logging, power consumption is high during logging.
Depending on the reception of the GPS signal, it may not be possible to record the position correctly.
(When it is difficult or impossible to receive a GPS signal, such as in a building or tunnel)
Please do not operate the vehicle while walking or driving, as it is very dangerous.
The developer assumes no responsibility for any damage caused by the use of this application.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00146720:ios.name: 1 Hotels
bluejetty:00146720:ios.summary: The 1 Hotels app allows you to tap into your personal device to seamlessly guide your journey at 1 Hotels. Check in, check out, book a stay, manage your existing reservations, experience keyless entry and in-room controls, communicate with
bluejetty:00146720:ios.description:
The 1 Hotels app allows you to tap into your personal device to seamlessly guide your journey at 1 Hotels. Check in, check out, book a stay, manage your existing reservations, experience keyless entry and in-room controls, communicate with our team¬ from in or outside of the hotel, order in-room dining and more.
HERE TO HELP – 1 to 1 team messaging, to answer your questions and assist with your requests
From your personal device, whether you’re near or far, communicate with our team for everything you need. Let us know if you’re on your way or arriving later than planned, request reservations at your favorite restaurant or set your wake-up call for that early morning meeting. Whatever you need, we’re just a message away. 
ARRIVE BEFORE YOU ARRIVE – Pre check-in for a seamless arrival
We want to set the tone of your stay with us before you even arrive. With the 1 Hotels app, you can check in to your stay before you’ve landed from a flight, set any preferences we should know in advance, order in-room dining from your cab so it’s in your room waiting for you, and start chatting with the 1 Team so we are ready to welcome you home.
THE KEY TO YOUR STAY – Keyless entry to get you settled faster
Skip the Front Desk if you choose and head straight to your room. Once checked in on your 1 Hotels app, you’ll have your room number and everything you need to access your home away from home. No need to carry around a room key wherever you go during your stay either. With our new keyless entry, your personal device is all you need.
GETTING YOU ON YOUR WAY – Check-out with the tap of a button
While it’s always sad to see you go, we want to make check-out a seamless experience for you. Skip the extra stop along your way by viewing your folio and checking out of your room directly from your personal device.
ROOT YOURSELF AT 1 – Stay in touch and up-to-date
In-between your stays with us get the latest on programming and events at your favorite 1 Hotels properties; access sustainability information from The Field Guide, our online blog; learn about new 1 Hotels locations; take advantage of our best offers, deals and experiences; book upcoming stays; and stay up-to-date on everything we’re doing at 1.
SEE, DO & EXPLORE – Recommendations from our Concierge Team
Our Concierge Teams are always happy to help with recommendations and reservations face-to-face, but we have worked with them to curate suggestions for dining, shopping, theater, outdoor excursions and more so everything you need to plan your trip is right at your fingertips. Send us a 1 to 1 message to help with any reservations, before you arrive or throughout your stay, to make sure you don’t miss out on all that our local communities have to offer. 
WATCH & LISTEN – Smart technology to connect you to your room’s devices
Remotes are over. Use the 1 Hotels app on your personal device to change the channel and adjust the volume on your in-room television.

bluejetty:00024850:ios.description:
Get a loud wake up sound with smart alarm settings, weather settings, morning missions, math alarms and more, all from this single full-featured alarm clock app!
Alarm Clock is a smart and powerful tool that can help even the heaviest sleepers get up in the morning. Create multiple alarms, each with loud ring tone sounds and alerts, then customize each one with features that help you wake up on time. Need a talking alarm clock with sleep timer? How about a shake-to-wake alarm? A wake-up app with puzzles and math problems that make it harder to hit the snooze button? Alarm Clock has all of these, and much more!
If you find it difficult getting up in the morning and need a good puzzle alarm to get you out of bed, Alarm Clock is the app for you. There are six unique wake-up motivational challenges that keep you from turning the alarm off without being fully awake. It's perfect for heavy sleepers!
Wake-up missions and alarm types:
• Simple - Easy one-tap to dismiss the alarm.
• Shake - Shake your device to stop the alarm.
• Math - Solve a math problem to turn off the alarm sound.
• Text - Unscramble the randomly generated text.
• Walk - Get up and take a few steps to switch off the alarm.
• Hold - Press & hold the button to terminate the alarm.
Alarm Clock has all the features you need from a loud smart alarm app. It includes the wake-up missions and alerts described above, plus the ability to create multiple repeating alarms, quick-set non-recurring alarms, customize tons of settings, and more. 
The best features in Alarm Clock:
• Create multiple alarms for a variety of uses.
• Customize the number of times you can hit the snooze button.
• Set the snooze time longer or shorter.
• Display weather and temperature next to your alarm clock.
• Smoothly increase or decrease the volume for a gentle wake-up.
• Quick alarm to set a time limit for power naps and other short tasks.
• Set a custom theme or photo as your clock background.
• Add notes or a to-do list as wakeup reminders.
• Lots of free music and loud sounds for an alarm ringtone.
• Never oversleep when you use these smart alarm features!
A simple but attractive interface makes Alarm Clock pleasing to use, even when you're staring at it through sleepy eyes! Use it to help you or people in your family get up in the morning, even if they're heavy sleepers. 
Alarm Clock is definitely not your ordinary alarm app. It's better!
Alarm Clock offers premium subscription which is available on a yearly tier, auto-renewable. The yearly subscription is priced at 14.99 USD (or local equivalent) per year. Subscribe to the premium program to get access to alarm sounds, wake-up tasks, wallpapers and more...
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. An account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period. Unused portions of free trials, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchase of a subscription. 
Links to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service:
Privacy Policy: http://www.rvappstudios.com/app-privacy-policy.html#privacy/
Terms of Use: http://www.rvappstudios.com/app-privacy-policy.html#terms/

bluejetty:00013891:ios.description:

- Create maintenance requests and receive update notifications in real time
- Pay your rent online by credit card, debit card or bank account
- Receive important notices from the management team, rent payment reminders and more

They can communicate with tenants and send real-time e-mail, SMS, phone call or push notifications. Portfolio vacancy rates and listing performance reports are only a few taps away.
- Accept online rent payments
- Find new tenants easily thanks to our automated listing process
- Manage your employees’ access to information and features of the platform

- Exchange messages with your tenants and employees
- Share important documents and information with your tenants
- View the location of your team members on a map
App support: If you experience any problems with the Building Stack app, please e-mail us at info@buildingstack.com.

bluejetty:00023364:ios.description:
For some inexplicable reason, you're added to a mysterious group chat with 7 others you don't know. 
While you're figuring out what the group is all about, Dr. Crow – a scary stranger with a plague doctor mask – suddenly appears! 
At first you take the situation casually, until suddenly shocking symbols randomly appear at your house that make your blood run cold. You receive creepy video calls and mysterious clues.
What dark secret connects the group members?
Who is behind the scary plague doctor mask?
And who isn't who they pretend to be?!
Now it's up to you! Follow the leads and clues, solve exciting puzzles and uncover secrets! Only you can stop the evil! 
 YOU DECIDE ON CHAT MESSAGES AND INFLUENCE THE STORY!
"The Healing" is YOUR story.
Your decisions affect the course and ending of this interactive horror thriller. You alone decide how the story and your relationships with the various characters develop. 
In order to make the game experience even more realistic, you'll be able to personalize the user profile with your name, gender and orientation. This will allow you to completely immerse yourself in the story. 
In addition, The Healing features exclusive content such as voice messages, video calls and images from a great cast of actors. 
All content of "The Healing" is in English and can be played for free!

bluejetty:00161351:ios.description:
Introducing Islami Bank CellFin: Your “All-in-One Mobile App for Digital Services”.
Islami Bank CellFin is your go-to mobile app for all your digital needs, whether you're already a bank customer or not. If you have a mobile phone with a number and a Smartphone, you're good to go!
Non transactional features:
1. No Bank Visit Needed: You don't have to visit the bank or deal with any paperwork. Simply download the app on your smartphone, and you're ready to roll.
2. Instant Digital Wallet: Once you've got the app, you can instantly create your own Digital Wallet. No need to wait for the bank – it's all automated for your convenience.
3. Virtual Card Included: We've got you covered with a virtual card – either VISA or MasterCard – assigned to your Digital Wallet. It's like having a card in your phone, and it makes all your transactions a breeze.
4. Account Integration: You can link Islami bank existing Khidmah credit card, prepaid card, CBS account, agent banking account, mCash account with this Digital Wallet for all kinds of transactional and non-transactional services.
5. Balance check: Conveniently check Bank, mCash and CellFin account balance at no cost without the need to visit a branch.
6. Complain management: Swiftly file and receive a complaint ticket number for any disputes directly through the app, eliminating the need to visit a branch.
7. Bank account opening: Easily open various accounts, such as Mudaraba Savings, Mudaraba Special Savings, Mudaraba Monthly Profit Deposit, Mudaraba Student Savings, Mudaraba Industrial Employee Savings, Payroll, Hajj Savings, and Muhor Savings accounts, all from the convenience of our app – no need to visit a bank branch.
8. Location service: Effortlessly find branch locations, sub-branches, ATMs, and agent outlets using the app's built-in locator feature.
9. Cheque book requisition: Order a cheque book right from our app with ease. 
10. Notification: Stay in the loop with exclusive offers and exciting promotions through our app's notifications.
11. Overseas registration: Bangladeshi citizens can use CellFin with all the features from 26 countries over the world.
Transactional Features:
1. Add Money: Easily add funds to your CellFin from various sources, including other bank cards, IBBPLC accounts, mCash, and IBBPLC debit and credit cards.
2. Send Money (Transfer): Effortlessly transfer funds, whether it's within IBBL or to other banks (IBBPLC to other banks) through EFT&NPSB, Binimoy, and also make transfers to mobile financial services such as mCash, bKash, Nagad, and other MFS providers.
3. Receive and Add Foreign Remittance: Receive and add foreign remittances to your account 24/7 through our app – no need to visit a bank branch.
4. Cardless Cash withdraw and deposut from ATM/CRM : Deposit and withdraw cash from your CellFin account, and even withdraw cash from your bank account, all without the need for a card, and it's absolutely free of charge.
5. QR based POS Purchase: You can use CellFin Quick Pay with ease, whether it's through Bangla QR or IBBL QR. Debit funds from your Bank account, CellFin account, mCash or IBBL Khidmah credit card hassle-free.
6. Ecommerce Transaction: You can shop hassle-free on thousands of e-commerce sites 24/7, making payments conveniently through CellFin.
7. Bill & other types of Payments: With CellFin, you can easily manage your bills for electricity, gas, telephone, internet, WASA (water supply), educational fees, admission fees, and more. Pay your bills conveniently and stay on top of your expenses all in one place.
8. Mobile Top-up: Top up your mobile balance or settle postpaid mobile bills in a flash with CellFin. We offer convenient shortcuts for major mobile network operators like Robi, Airtel, Banglalink, Grameenphone, and Teletalk, ensuring swift and hassle-free transactions.
9. Request Money: You can request money to another CellFin user at any time when you need.

bluejetty:00147083:ios.summary:
Taxim is a new taxi ordering service. The best way to appreciate our service is to download our app and order a car at a low price.
Taxim helps you manage your rides on your smartphone. Our selection of rates and ample features will make y
bluejetty:00147083:ios.description:
Taxim is a new taxi ordering service. The best way to appreciate our service is to download our app and order a car at a low price.
Taxim helps you manage your rides on your smartphone. Our selection of rates and ample features will make your ride comfortable and streamline the ordering process.
Create an order
Start entering an address and the app will display autocomplete suggestions. An even faster alternative is to mark the required address on the map. Add, swap or delete an unlimited number of addresses before the ride or even en route. The app will remember the route, so you can just select it from the list next time you need a ride.
Choose a rate
Order a car, a compact MPV for several people, or a moving truck. If you need a cheap taxi, choose our Economy rate. If you value comfort, opt for the Comfort rate. If you want your driver to be a woman, choose the For women rate.
Specify additional requests
Indicate whether you are riding with a child and/or transporting a pet or luggage in just a few taps. Order a taxi for a friend — all the relevant order notifications will be sent to his or her phone. If your loved ones are worried about you, there is a special feature to share your location. This lets your loved ones track your taxi in real time.
Track the driver's location
The app has an online map that displays nearby drivers who are ready to accept your order. When your order is accepted, you can track your driver's location on this map in real time. Use the in-app chat or call the driver to specify the pick-up address. At the end of the ride, tap the thumb-up/down button to give positive or negative feedback.
We hope you'll enjoy riding with us!

bluejetty:00029752:ios.description:
Afraid of losing your important chats? Chats matter a lot in this era!
What's Included?
iCloud Chats Backup for Keeping Chats Saved
Remove Duplicate Photos to freeup space
Backup my Chats & Photos allows you backup your conversations, images, videos, audio and voice notes. You can easily migrate from device and restore your backup in your new device. 
Features:
- The backup is compressed and synchronized with your account.
- Always keep safe their messages and data, if you lose or change your phone you can restore your conversations on your new device
- Backup my Chats & Photos is here to keep your important chats & media safe. 
- You can easily access & manage your chats backup from this application. 
- Backup my Chats & Photos also provides you access to keep your chat media safe & backed up.
- Backup my Chats & Photos lets you find any specific chat backup with the help of a search option where you can simply type a name or number to find any specific chat.
- Backup my Chats & Photos also gives you a direct option to open your chats & take a backup.
- Using Backup my Chats & Photos is really simple & easy.
Other Features -
- Backup chats with Media
- Search & Find a specific chat
- Options to Share to Delete any backup - iCloud Backup
New Feature
Duplicate Photo Cleaner
This app comes with a powerful duplicate file remover feature. It lets you easily search and remove the duplicate photos on your iPhone and iPad. Nowadays, with so much storage space in iPhones, users usually dump whatever we can until the storage fills up to its brim. And the next step most of us will do is try to delete useless files. But we often don't check out to duplicate photos. On an average, about 10% of any physical device is filled with duplicate photos. This app lets you easily search and remove the duplicate files on your iOS mobile phone and tablet.
Nowadays, with so much storage space in iOS devices, we usually dump whatever we can until the storage fills up to its brim. And the next step most of us will do is try to delete useless files. But we often throw a blind eye to duplicate photos. On an average, about 10% of any physical device is filled with duplicate photos. This app will help you to delete these photos and free up space on your iOS device.
How it works?
- Go to "Chat" Section
- Swipe the chat to left & select "More"
- Tap on "Export Chat" to take a backup
- Select "Attach Media" option to take media backup
- Find & Select "Backup My Chats & Photos" from the list
- iCloud Backup Possible, backup chats on iCloud with ease.
Premium plans

- Subscription automatically renews at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The user's account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.

- People who thrive on social motivation and encouragement
- Health enthusiasts wanting to track comprehensive wellness data

==APP介绍==
 ”你好呀~我是YoYo，我可以陪着你一起打卡习惯、在线自习、充实每个小日常。
给你介绍下我的好朋友：小狐狸和玫瑰花。我们会一直陪着你变得更好，希望你在每一个平凡的日常里不会孤单乏味。小狐狸会时刻监督、鼓励、提醒你，千万不要嫌弃他啰嗦哦~
玫瑰花是对你努力的奖励，一定要好好保存！
最后，常来看看我吧 ~ 希望我们能成为好朋友。”
 --YoYo留
 ==APP功能==
1、打卡：把你的目标几句话告诉小狐狸，千万不要嫌弃小狐狸太啰嗦哦~建好的目标一定要坚持打卡。
2、自习号：穿梭宇宙，着陆心仪的星球，与Yo友们一起自习专注吧，别忘了给Yo友一个大大的鼓励哦~
3、日常：待办清单、番茄专注、计时器、心情日记、课程表，你的日常琐事，YoYo全部放在心上呢~
4、打卡组：约上三五好友一起打卡吧。可以是学习，可是是运动...加了小组，你们才是一条船上的人！
5、日记式心情记录：我把你的记录写在了日记本里，记得经常来翻翻，这样你就会发现，你的进步有多惊人啊！
6、YoYo装扮：爱美不是你的特权，YoYo也一样。快来给你YoYo换上可爱的装扮吧！
7、惊喜贩卖机：每天打卡和专注都能获得玫瑰花奖励，收获的玫瑰花价值斐然哦~可用来换取精美明信片和yoyo的小礼物呢~
8、YoYo商店：店铺开业，全场包邮。YoYo的交易货币是玫瑰花，记得多积累玫瑰来购买商品吧！
9、数据统计：你的蜕变看得见，点点滴滴为你呈现。Emmm~进步后也不能骄傲呀！
 【HealthKit】
 支持连接至「HealthKit」，将您每次专注时长，写入“健康”APP的“正念训练”->“正念分钟数”。
 【会员连续订阅说明】
 - 付款：“连续包月/年”商品为自动续订商品，确认购买后，会从您的苹果iTunes账户扣费。

 - 订阅可以由用户管理，并且可以在购买后，在用户的账户设置里关闭自动续订。
 - 免费试用期的任何未使用部分（如果提供），将在用户购买该商品时被回收。

bluejetty:00187965:ios.description:
Sales tracking and customer management for small businesses that don't want to wrestle with QuickBooks or a spreadsheet.
Built for the people who actually run the shop: resellers and flippers, auto detailers and landscapers, tattoo artists and photographers, salon owners, makers, and boutique apparel sellers. No accounting degree required.
CORE FEATURES
TRACK SALES
Record every sale across every channel, marketplace, or storefront you sell through. Search, filter, and sort by date, customer, product, or sale source.
MANAGE CUSTOMERS
Store complete profiles with full purchase histories. Identify your repeat buyers, and the ones you haven't heard from in a while.
ORGANIZE PRODUCTS & SERVICES
Group items into categories with custom attributes like size, color, and material. Premium adds full inventory tracking with stock-level alerts.
TRACK EXPENSES
Log expenses by vendor and category. Attach receipt photos. See where the money actually goes. (Premium)
FOLLOW YOUR REFERRAL SOURCES
Tag every sale with where it came from: an Instagram DM, a flyer, a referral, an ad campaign. Know which sources earn their keep.
WORK YOUR LEADS
Track prospective sales separately from real ones, then convert them when they close. Color-code by likelihood. Reuse leads as templates for recurring customers. (Premium)
SEE THE BIG PICTURE
Visual dashboard charts and clean reports show how your business is performing month over month. Export your data as PDF, CSV, or Excel anytime.
WORK ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Native on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your data syncs in real time, so you pick up exactly where you left off.
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Information is securely stored in the cloud. If you lose your phone or delete the app, your business data is safe.
PRICING
- Basic (Free Forever): Unlimited customers and products. Up to 5 sales a month, 3 sale sources.
- Premium: Unlimited everything, plus inventory tracking, leads, custom sale statuses, and expense tracking.
- Lifetime: All Premium features. One-time purchase, no recurring subscription.
Upgrade anytime via in-app purchase. Local pricing shown above.

bluejetty:00123953:ios.description:
LET LOOSE YOUR PASSION FOR HORSES! 
More than 60 million players have already tried Howrse, so what are you waiting for? Join this community of horse lovers today!
- BREED the horse of your dreams
Choose your horse from over 50 breeds (purebred Arabian, Fjord, French Riding Pony, Shetland…) with 17 different coats. You can even choose ponies, donkeys or unicorns.
- TAKE CARE of your new friend
Feed it so they'll be healthy, and make sure their energy level stays high.
Keep an eye on their morale, and don't hesitate to give them treats or stroke them if their morale drops. 
- RUN your own equestrian center
Create your own equestrian center, develop your horse boarding business, and organize competitions to increase your prestige (Only available on the web version).
- TRAIN your horses
When your horse is 3 years old, choose a specialty of either classical riding (speed, cross-country, show-jumping, or dressage competitions) or western riding (barrel racing, cutting, reining, western pleasure or trail class competitions), then start training them to enhance their skills.
Select the best tack (saddle, saddle cloth, bridle, etc.) to increase your champion's performance.
Join Grand Prix events and win prestigious trophies.
- CREATE your horse breeding farm
Develop the genetic potential of your future foals by choosing the best stallions for your mare and increase their innate skills. 
Analyze the parents' innate skills and BLUP to make the best decisions. 
- BECOME the best Breeder
Challenge your friends and the community to reach the top of the leaderboards in the different categories (General ranking, best breeders, best horses, best equestrian centers....). 
- PLAY in teams to climb the rankings
Form teams of up to 20 players to improve a breed together and reach the top spots in one of the four available rankings (best genetic potential, number of horses, number of rosettes won, or ranking in the Top 1,000 for Grand Prix competitions). 
- CREATE your own illustrations and SHARE them with the community: 
Create your own coats and landscapes. Submit them to the community to win prizes. 
You can also personalize your horse and landscape with thousands of artworks made by the community. 
- SHARE your passion
Join the forums to talk about your techniques to play and breed horses, run your equestrian center or just chat about your passion. Your new horse club awaits with new friends. 
- PLAY MANY GREAT GAMES
From maze to blast, enjoy a new game every month to win prizes. 
Join the community !

Instagram https://www.instagram.com/howrse_official/
Twitter https://twitter.com/howrse

bluejetty:00027124:ios.description:
Speak. Transcribe. Translate — instantly.
Turn your voice into text, transcribe audio and video (even YouTube!), and translate speech in real time — all with just your voice. Save time, type less, and stay productive across all your Apple devices.
Key Features:
Smart Voice Dictation
• Dictate in real time instead of typing—perfect for writing, notes, journaling, and messaging
• Configure three independent language zones for multilingual projects
• Supports more than 40 dictation languages
AI-Powered Transcription
• Convert voice memos, audio recordings, videos, and YouTube links into accurate text
• Uses advanced AI speech recognition for fast, high-quality results
• Supports over 100 transcription languages
Built-In Translation
• Instantly translate spoken or written text into over 40 languages
• Easily share translations across your favorite apps
Powerful File Handling and Sync
• Save and access audio and text files via the Apple Files app
• Organize, store, or export your dictation as text files or PDFs
• Seamlessly sync across iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch with iCloud
Quick Export and Sharing Options
• Share transcripts and translations via Mail, WhatsApp, Facebook, X, and more
• Use one-tap export to streamline your workflow
Accessibility Support
• Fully compatible with VoiceOver for visually impaired users
• Customize font sizes and button layout for better readability and ease of use
Additional Features:
• Apple Shortcuts support
• Undo manager for text edits
• Custom user dictionary
• Audio replay of recorded dictations
• Apple Watch integration
• Built-in backup tools
• Adjustable text sizes
• Optional dictation privacy mode (depending on device capabilities)

bluejetty:00082634:ios.summary:
Subtitles: Captions For Video - the easiest and quickest tool for adding captions. With just a few taps, you can have a video with custom subtitles.
Subtitles: Captions For Video allows you to customize captions to your liking. Choose font
bluejetty:00082634:ios.description:
Subtitles: Captions For Video - the easiest and quickest tool for adding captions. With just a few taps, you can have a video with custom subtitles.
Subtitles: Captions For Video allows you to customize captions to your liking. Choose fonts, colors, corner radius, background, padding, and more. Merge captions based on word count.
Why are video subtitles so important?
Video captions display the text spoken in the video. Open and closed captions or subtitles are intended for audiences who cannot hear the audio due to hearing loss or because the viewer cannot play sound. For this reason, captions complement the speech with additional information relevant to the story or important for it. It can include non-verbal sounds and, for example, help differentiate different dynamics. Closed captions can be turned on or off, while open captions cannot. Subtitles in videos on social media are typically accessible captions to make the content as inclusive as possible.
With fast and accurate transcriptions, Subtitles: Captions For Video saves time by eliminating the need to transcribe and upload captions manually. Ready-made captions from Subtitles: Captions For Video can be edited, adjusted, or combined, speeding up post-production and reducing costs.
Subscriptions
We currently offer the following auto-renewing subscription options for the Premium version:
- $9.99/month
- $39.99/year
Purchased through the application subscription "Subtitles: Captions For Video" is updated every month. To ensure that the subscription is not renewed, you need to disable automatic updating at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription. Auto-update can be turned off at any time in your iTunes account settings.
Subscription is automatically renewed if auto-renewal is not disabled no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscription will be renewed automatically within 24 hours before the end of the current period for a period similar to the previous one. You can manage your subscriptions after purchase and disable auto-renewal in your account settings. Subscription is paid from your iTunes account.

bluejetty:00072918:ios.description:
Ring Sizer is designed to make the process of finding the perfect ring size for your wedding or engagement ring easier than ever before! Our app allows you to measure your finger size and ring size accurately and quickly, from the comfort of your own home.
Using the latest technology, our app takes into account a range of factors such as the width of the band and the shape of your finger to give you the most precise measurement possible. Whether you are looking to purchase a ring online or in-store, our app will ensure that you get the perfect fit every time.
To get started, simply download the app onto your smartphone or tablet and follow the easy step-by-step instructions. Our app provides clear visuals and user-friendly prompts, making it accessible to everyone. You can measure your ring size by placing your finger on the screen and matching it with the on-screen ring size chart, or by using a paper ring sizer that you can print out directly from the app.
Our app is perfect for couples who want to ensure that their engagement or wedding rings fit comfortably and securely. It's also a great tool for anyone who wants to purchase rings as a gift for someone else, but is unsure of their ring size.

bluejetty:00126805:ios.description:

Touch and learn the names of the animals, fruits, vegetables, planets, vehicles and much more. Play a guessing game to recognise real world-objects.

bluejetty:00185092:ios.description:
Have you always wanted to be a princess and be in your fairy tale dream house? Then your wish has come true! Now you can be a princess in your very own doll house. Explore the huge castle and play pretend! It's a fantasy world where there's no limit to creativity and fun. 
- Play Princess Games
You can create your very own original princess story in this unique castle. You can even dress up every little princess in this game. Choose cute dresses and show off your fashion sense in these princess games.
- Princess Throne Room
Make the characters sit on shiny thrones and have a royal discussion! Eat yummy food and talk about the happenings of the town. Explore every corner of this room to find and hidden secrets!
- Princess Kitchen
Whenever your princess is hungry, just head over to the kitchen and get some munchies. Feed yummy food to the characters and prepare some more food for later! There are lots of usable items here. There's always something cooking in this royal kitchen!
- Princess Bedroom
Develop your storytelling skills by playing pretend. In the princess bedroom, you can check out the wonderfully designed room filled with awesome items. Help your princess get ready in your doll house.
- Princess Airport
Fly high & go meet your royal friends. Explore every corner of the airport and get ready to travel for your vacation! Show off your creativity through storytelling and role-play. 
- Monster House
Meet the new neighbors of princess. Some naughty little princesses & princes sneak into their garden & play. Explore more in the Monster House. 
Key Features:
* 9 exciting rooms to explore.
* 15 new characters including princesses, princes, kings, queens and soldiers.
* Various royal items to play with!
* Touch, drag and explore every object and see what happens!
* Made for kids of ages 6-8, but everyone will enjoy playing in this doll house.
Be a princess right away and start ruling your kingdom from your castle. Download now!

bluejetty:00146353:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00146353:ios.description:
Glow is the easiest way to get started on Solana. Set up your wallet in seconds to manage your assets, browse coins and collectibles, and transact effortlessly.
** Securely Store Your SOL, Tokens, and Collectibles **
- View detailed information about your coins including historical prices, market data and past activity.
- Secure your wallet with Touch ID or Face ID.
- Store your keys securely with Keychain and back them up to iCloud. Never worry about losing your recovery phrase.
- Stake SOL to contribute to the network and earn rewards.
- Import multiple private keys and recovery phrases to use multiple different accounts.
** Hardware Wallet Support **
- Connect your Ledger Nano X over BLE to securely sign transactions
- Create additional wallets for your Ledger
** Powerful Collectibles Support **
- Mint your own collectibles by uploading a photo
- Mint your own collectible with Stable Diffusion AI
- Follow along with popular and trending collectibles.
- Search for collectibles and filter by trait and price.
- View price history along with recent marketplace transactions.
** Safely Transact on Solana **
- Swap coins with zero fees.
- Burn unwanted or spam tokens to earn SOL and clean out your wallet.
- See and understand your past activity including actions taken on other wallets.
- Sync your wallets with the Glow Desktop Extension so that you can use your wallets across desktop and mobile.
- Send tokens to your friends and include a note. Receive a push notification when someone sends you something.
- Glow simulates all transactions before you submit them to check for any malicious activity and will automatically block suspicious requests.
** Connect to Solana sites with the Safari Extension **
Enable the Safari Extension to interact with Solana sites such as Magic Eden, Jupiter, OpenSea, Raydium, Exchange Art, Formfunction, and more without leaving Safari.
** And More **
- iPad support
- Widget support

bluejetty:00018767:ios.summary:
Recipe Keeper is the easy to use, all-in-one recipe organizer, shopping list and meal planner available across all of your devices.
ADD RECIPES QUICKLY AND EASILY
Enter your recipes with as much or as little information as you like. Copy a
bluejetty:00018767:ios.description:
Recipe Keeper is the easy to use, all-in-one recipe organizer, shopping list and meal planner available across all of your devices.
ADD RECIPES QUICKLY AND EASILY
Enter your recipes with as much or as little information as you like. Copy and paste recipes from your existing documents or apps. Categorize your recipes by course and category. Add photos, rate your recipes and flag your favorites.
IMPORT RECIPES FROM WEBSITES
Search for recipes on the web and add them straight to your collection. Hundreds of popular recipe websites supported. Customize imported recipes to suit your needs.
SCAN FROM COOKBOOKS, MAGAZINES AND HANDWRITTEN RECIPES
Scan recipes using your phone's camera or from your existing photos and PDF files. OCR technology automatically converts images to text. Keep all your favorite family recipes safe forever.
FIND ANY RECIPE INSTANTLY
Quickly lookup your recipes by name, ingredient or directions or simply browse your recipes by course, category and rating. Got leftovers in the fridge? Search for a recipe to use them up. Cook more of your favorite meals and rediscover those long-forgotten recipes to make mealtimes interesting again.
SHARE RECIPES WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Share your recipes by email and to your favorite social networks. Create a shared family recipe collection. Add recipes from other Recipe Keeper users with a single tap.
CREATE BEAUTIFUL COOKBOOKS
Create cookbooks from your recipes for printing or sharing as a PDF with cover page, table of contents, custom layouts and more.
UNEXPECTED GUESTS?
Adjust a recipe serving size up or down and let Recipe Keeper automatically recalculate your ingredients for you.
PLAN AHEAD AND STAY IN CONTROL
Integrated weekly and monthly meal planner allows you to plan your meals in advance. Add all your meals to your shopping list in one step. Recipe Keeper can even create a random meal plan for you based on your hints and suggestions. Get rid of that "what should I cook tonight?" feeling.
MAKE SHOPPING SIMPLER
Fully featured shopping list that automatically groups your items by aisle. Save money by only buying what you need. No more trips back to the store for that one thing you forgot.
AVAILABLE ACROSS ALL OF YOUR DEVICES
Share your recipes, shopping lists and meal planner across all your iPhones, iPads, Macs, PCs and other mobile and tablet devices (separate purchase required for other platforms).
"ALEXA, ASK RECIPE KEEPER FOR COOKIE RECIPES."
Search your recipes, cook hands-free with step-by-step instructions and add items to your shopping list using the Recipe Keeper skill for Amazon Alexa, (English language only).
TRANSFER YOUR EXISTING RECIPES
Transfer your recipes from other apps such as Living Cookbook, MasterCook, MacGourmet, BigOven, Cook'n, My Cookbook, My Recipe Book, Paprika Recipe Manager, Pepperplate, OrganizEat, Recipe Box and many more.
AND MORE!
• Choose from 25 different color schemes, light & dark modes
• Format recipes using bold and italics
• Customizable recipe collections, courses and categories
• Add nutrition information and search for recipes by nutritional amounts
• Check off ingredients while cooking, highlight the current direction
• Adjustable text size when viewing recipes - great for reading recipes across the kitchen
• Convert recipes between US/Imperial and Metric units
• Link related recipes together
• Add links to online videos
• Pin your favorite recipes to the home screen for quick access
• Works offline - take your recipes with you wherever you go
• Bulk update multiple recipes at once
• Screen lock disabled while viewing recipes - no more messy fingers on screen trying to wake your device
• Available in 15 languages
GREAT SUPPORT
We love hearing from you! If you need any help, have a question, or want to suggest a new feature, please email us at support@tudorspan.com
Cook more. Eat healthier. Shop smarter. Try Recipe Keeper free today!

bluejetty:00087353:ios.name: Snooper - Earn money
bluejetty:00087353:ios.summary:

With Snooper, you get paid in cash to complete easy missions in stores arounds you: take a few photos of products on shelves, find a promotional display, play the role of a mystery shop
bluejetty:00087353:ios.description:
Snooper is much more than just a Mystery Shopper app.
With Snooper, you get paid in cash to complete easy missions in stores arounds you: take a few photos of products on shelves, find a promotional display, play the role of a mystery shopper, provide product feedback and much more.
Making money in your free time or while shopping has never been so easy.
We analyse the images and feedbacks you provide so brands and retailers can get real-time visibility on their execution in-store.
HOW IT WORKS
Nothing easier...
- Use the map to find a mission in a store nearby.
- Read the briefing and accept it.
- Follow the instructions to complete your mission.
- Submit your mission for review and get paid as soon as it gets approved.
The more missions you complete the more experience points you accumulate and the more money opportunities you unlock!
OUR MISSIONS
There are many different types of missions on the app, making it a fun way to earn money. In most cases you will only be asked to take a few photos and our system will analyse them so you don't have to spend too much time in store answering questions.
- Store checks: report on product availability and visibility on shelf, check pricing and promotion etc. 
- Mystery shopper: follow a script and interact with a staff member then share your experience.
- Product testimonial: purchase a product (we will reimburse you), test it at home and share your feedback.
- At home surveys: answer a few easy questions about your consumer behaviour right from your couch.
GET PAID IN CASH
That's right... for each mission completed successfully you get paid in cash straight to your bank account.
No need to provide your credit card details, we pay you on your nominated bank account via our secured international payment system.
AVAILABILITY AND SUPPORT
The App is available in several countries and the team is working super hard to add more to the list. You can choose your preferred language (currently English or Spanish).
Our lovely team of community managers are always there to help you if you need help, have a feedback or even in cases where you wouldn't be too happy with us (sorry about that, it happens sometimes but we always do our best to fix things).
We love our community and will do everything we can to create as many revenue opportunities for you while ensuring you have the best experience possible

bluejetty:00128906:ios.summary: Classic sudoku game now can be played on your phone and tablet. Sudoku is a logic number-placement puzzle game. To win a sudoku game, you need to fill the 9×9 grid with numbers so that there will be no repetitive number in each row, each co
bluejetty:00128906:ios.description:
Classic sudoku game now can be played on your phone and tablet. Sudoku is a logic number-placement puzzle game. To win a sudoku game, you need to fill the 9×9 grid with numbers so that there will be no repetitive number in each row, each column and each 3×3 sub-grid, namely numbers 1-9 will only appear once in each row, column or sub-grid. Also, it is a relaxing causal game, but it requires your focus to figure out the solution. Therefore, sudoku will help you exercise your brain and memory because you need to think and utilize your logic when you are playing sudoku.
Our sudoku is committed to improve your game experience. It has 4 levels of difficulty for players with different capabilities of sudoku, from beginners to masters on sudoku. Also, it has various functions to help you win the game, such as Hint, Undo/Redo, Take Notes, etc. Moreover, you can practice your skills and challenge yourself by playing Daily Challenge and My Challenge. We are sure you can have great fun and better game experience when you are playing our sudoku.
Now, download Aged Sudoku and start figuring out solutions to every puzzle!
Features:
- Daily Challenge & My Challenge: you can challenge every day to practice your skills of playing sudoku
- 4 levels of difficulty
- Highlighting: selected number, row, column, sub-grid and other same numbers will be highlighted when one of the cells is selected
- Hint: when there is a single solution in the game, you can click Hint and then it will automatically fill the cell with answer
- Intelligent hint: when you select the last empty cell in a row, column or sub-grid, you will be reminded of the answer
- Error Cap: turn on/off mistake limit
- The quantity of remaining numbers is provided
- Hide numbers which have used up
- Unlimited chances of Undo/Redo
- Automatic Error-Checking: when you fill with a wrong answer, it will automatically undo your answer
- Autosave incomplete game
- Multiple background and appearance styles you can choose
- Multiple language choices
[Auto Renewable Ads Removal Subscription]
▸ Subscription Service: Remove the ads + Unlimited Hints
▸ Subscription Payment: Once you confirm the payment, you can find the record in your iTunes Account
▸ Subscription Cancelation: Go to “Setting” -> “iTunes Store and App Store” -> “Apple Id”-> ”View Apple Id”-> “Account Setting” -> “Subscription” 
You have to cancel the subscription 24 hours before the end of previous subscription
▸ Term of Use:
https://sudoku.club/terms-of-use
▸ Privacy Policy:
https://sudoku.club/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00092332:ios.description:
New to Together Loans?
We're building a new type of loan company. One based on trust.
We offer personal loans, but these loans are a little different. Most lenders look at your credit history to decide whether you can borrow from them, based on how you've previously handled your money. We don't do that - our loans are based on trust*.
If you're trustworthy and can afford the monthly payments but have been turned down for other loans, Together Loans could be for you. We offer a fair, simple and transparent loan based on trust - not just your financial history.
With the Together Loans app you can: 
- Apply for a loan right here in the app
- View you loan like never before
- Quickly access your statement
- Make payments simply and securely
- Get help with your loan in real time
- Top Up and Borrow More
To learn more about Together Loans and how we offer a fresh approach on lending visit our website at togetherloans.com.
Representative Example: Borrowing $3,000.00 over 24 months, repaying $177.13 per month, total repayable $4,251.12. Interest Rate 35.99% APR. Minimum term 24 months. Maximum term 60 months. Maximum APR 35.99%. There are no added fees. All Loans are subject to credit and underwriting approval. The full range of available loan amounts and rates varies by State.
*All loans are subject to identity verification and underwriting approval. Borrowers cannot be actively bankrupt, and must provide a cosigner that meets our credit criteria. Your credit history may be considered if you share finances with the cosigner.
Personal loans through the Together Loans branded Loan Program are subject to approval and are issued by one of the following lending partners: Medallion Bank, Member FDIC; Transform Credit Inc. (NMLS ID: 1905055); or TL Financial Services LLC (NMLS ID: 2766355).
Transform Credit Inc. (NMLS ID: 1905055) and TL Financial Services LLC (NMLS ID: 2766355) conduct business as the Together Loans brand. See our licenses and DBAs for more details (https://togetherloans.com/licenses).
Together Loans is a financial technology company, not a bank.

bluejetty:00021310:ios.description:
TouchNet Mobile is your single point of access to campus life, combining student ID functionality with electronic payment processing and access control to enhance the whole student experience.
TouchNet Mobile is a unique, mobile-based technology from TouchNet that enables campus administrators to offer students a single point of access to campus life. It serves as a secure payment system for campus services, goods and activities, as a virtual ID card, and gives students access to events, buildings, libraries, and other campus facilities using pin codes, passwords and geo-fencing.
Students can also manage their OneCard account with features such as deactivating their card, checking their balance, report on transaction history and more. With configurable icons, campus information such as athletic events, dining menus, bus schedules and more are readily available within TouchNet Mobile.
Participating TouchNet Mobile terminals can include vending machines, photocopiers, laundry controllers, print stations, financial terminals, dining point of sale terminals, event, activity, access terminals and more.

Students can also manage their OneCard account with features such as deactivating their card, checking their balance, report on transaction history and more. With configurable icons, campus information such as athletic events, dining menus, bus schedules and more are readily available within TouchNet Mobile.

Participating TouchNet Mobile terminals can include vending machines, photocopiers, laundry controllers, print stations, financial terminals, dining point of sale terminals, event, activity, access terminals and more.

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

PATTERNS CRAFTED SPECIALLY FOR MOBILE
The new way patterns are crafted and optimised specially for mobile devices. Lowers the bar on users who can craft projects, increasing an audience that can be reached. Crochet app team finds best amigurumi patterns and makes crafts with the best crocheters, adds them to yarn free app.
YARN APP, STASH MANAGER AND SHOPPING LIST
Gathered best yarn collections from best manufacturers: YarnArt, Drops, Alize, Schachenmayr, DMC, etc.
Allows to control stock of items for crocheting, yarn stash, crochet hooks and other tools. Helps creators to make sure stash and yarns are always full and ready.
NEW STANDARDS FOR EASY CROCHET PATTERNS
PDF’s that are currently published by creators are not optimised for mobile devices. Not user friendly on mobile devices, no search, no progress, no interaction. New format solves it all, as well as expands the possibilities for crocheters on what they can create. Easy crafts and amigurumi, clothes and accessories, instructions, even bought from other stores, like etsy, stashes, row counter and stitches counts are synchronised with cloud and will be present on the account with premium features.
FEATURES & TOOLS:
- Project preview & instructions
- Row counter & counting app
- Yarn list & existing yarns
- Rows, project & part timer
- Modern amigurumi recipes
- Video / Photo in patterns app
- Project completion time planner
- Basic Crochet & knitting tutorials
- Hook size chart
- Knitting needles size charts
- Completed projects
- PDF import & notes
- Free multiple row counter
- Yarn marketplace
EASY TO GET PATTERN
No need to trust each seller individually. Guarantee of a purchase, refund and quality assurance from the Crochetapp platform. Users don’t need to adjust to payment methods provided by creators, just purchase with their Apple pay. Also, there are more than 15 free crochet & knitting projects in the app already available, for the apps craft.
PDF INSTRUCTIONS IN CLOUD
Many instructions are stored in different places, devices and ways. As payments happen from various sources and creators, it will allow users to keep their instructions 
forever.
SINGLE FORMAT FOR CRAFTED PROJECTS
Every creator has their own style and format of crafted toys or items, product is built to give the best possible experience and format for the end user. It is a completely new approach to visual information, abbreviations and style of description. Explanations, tips and instructions available, as well as needed materials and yarn warehouse

bluejetty:00118919:ios.description:
What is Crait?
Crait is where secure communication and collaboration happens. It is a secure messaging tool designed to make working life easier and more productive for work-groups.
Why Crait?
The simple answer is: Businesses need to protect their digital assets. Businesses are targets and will be targets of cyber hacking because they have information valuable to would-be criminals. 
No sector of corporate America is excluded from the threat of cyber hacking. This is why at Crait, we believe that business communication deserves a security upgrade.
What Crait provides
- Secure one-on-one or group calls and can support chats with up to 1000 people.
- Messages that self-destruct after the messages are read.
- End-to-end encryption between the sender’s device and the recipient such that the encryption key never leaves the device; no party in the middle.
- Secure chat, voice, as well as file-sharing capabilities to work-groups.
- Secure email for Crait-to-Crait users.
Pro edition service
- Length of subscription: one month
- Price: $2.99 per month
- Payment: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Turned off: Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Auto-renewal: Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Account management: Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Privacy policy: https://www.craitapp.com/useragreement.php
- Payment terms of use: https://www.craitapp.com/permission/index.html#/agreement
- Auto-renewal terms of use: https://www.craitapp.com/permission/index.html#/renewagreement

One card to change your entire perspective - get started now.

bluejetty:00175776:ios.description:
Mother Jones is a nonprofit news outlet that delivers bold and original award-winning reporting on the urgent issues of our day, from politics and climate change to education and the food we eat. We investigate stories that are in the public and the nation's interest. From revelatory scoops to deep-dive investigations, Mother Jones journalism is storytelling that informs and inspires 9 million monthly readers. 
We are headquartered in San Francisco and have bureaus in Washington, DC, and New York City. Mother Jones has been nominated for more than 30 National Magazine Awards and has won seven times, including for General Excellence in 2001, 2008, and 2010. In addition, Mother Jones has been recognized repeatedly with top industry honors, including two National Press Club Awards, three Online News Association Awards, and the Society of Professional Journalists Sigma Delta Chi Award two years in a row. Mother Jones has also been named a finalist for eight Data Journalism Awards.

No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
