bluejetty:00015366:ios.name: LAMP Words For Life
bluejetty:00015366:ios.summary: LAMP Words For Life® is a robust augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app that combines the power of Minspeak, the Unity® language system and Language Acquisition through Motor Planning (LAMP™) principles and strategies. LAMP is
bluejetty:00015366:ios.description:
LAMP Words For Life® is a robust augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app that combines the power of Minspeak, the Unity® language system and Language Acquisition through Motor Planning (LAMP™) principles and strategies. LAMP is a therapeutic approach based on neurological and motor learning principles that addresses the language development and communication needs of individuals with autism and other developmental disabilities. It provides a consistent motor pattern per word so that automaticity can develop. With thousands of frequently used words pre-stored and the ability to store customized vocabulary, the app allows for unlimited language growth opportunities. With the focus on access to individual words, the communicator can put words together to express their own thoughts in a manner consistent with normal language development. 
It is appropriate for anyone from beginning communicators who are just learning that they can affect those around them to skilled communicators with advanced language skills. Language development in typically developing children occurs through the combination of a consistent motor pattern, the sound that motor pattern produces, and the reaction they get from the environment. LAMP Words for Life presents vocabulary in the same manner so those language connections can be developed. 
LAMP Words for Life app is symbol based for those who are not yet literate; however, those symbols are paired with text to support literacy development. The vocabulary, structure, and teaching approach are based on research and clinical experience. 
What’s included?
*High-quality Acapela and Almagu voices, The VoiceKeeper unique voice 
*Pre-stored core and fringe words
*English (US), German, Spanish (Mexico), and French (Canada) vocabulary files
*Vocabulary Builder: Allows chosen words to be visible while the remaining vocabulary is hidden
*Word Finder: Helps the user find where words are stored
*Ability to store customized vocabulary and edit individual buttons
*Data Logging with ability to automatically sync with Realize Language™ for analysis
Two vocabulary levels within the app support language development from any skill level:
An introductory level features 83 core words that are only one touch away for immediate reinforcement. 
The full vocabulary file gives the device user access to verb conjugations and word endings. It includes 3,000+ words and allows for the customization of personalized vocabulary such as names, favorite foods, and favorite places. 
Visit www.lampwflapp.com for more information on the app and for more information and training on the LAMP approach visit www.aacandautism.com. 
PRC-Saltillo (formerly known as Prentke Romich Company) is a pioneer in the field of assistive technology and AAC.

bluejetty:00083951:ios.description:
Train smarter, row stronger, and connect with a global community of rowers.
WATERROWER Connect turns your iOS device into a performance dashboard for your WaterRower. Whether you're rowing for fitness, training for competition, or exploring immersive workout experiences, this app is your perfect rowing companion.
Designed for indoor rowing, the app tracks every stroke, gives insights into your progress, and keeps you motivated with guided workouts, races, and virtual scenery.
Personalised Performance Tracking
- Multiple visualizations during workouts: force curve, split graphs, stroke rate, and more
- Real-time metrics: Distance Rowed, 500m Split Time, Time, Watts, and Stroke Rate
- Save and review workout history for comparison and improvement
Global Rowing Community
- Join the WaterRower community leaderboard
- Compare results with rowers around the world
- Tap on users in the leaderboard to preview their profile, achievements, and workout stats
Goal-Based Workout Modes
- Choose between: Just Row, Distance, Duration, Intervals
- Daily workouts to challenge and inspire you
- Guided coaching and structured training sessions
Immersive Experience
- Scenery videos and rowing classes to bring your workout to life
- In-session data overlays for a fully connected training experience
Data & Integrations
- Apple Health integration: Sync rowing workouts seamlessly
- Strava compatibility for tracking and sharing performance
Note: WATERROWER Connect is compatible with WaterRower models, SmartRow Power Pulley and SmartRow Power Handle and any generic FTMS device, including Concept 2.

bluejetty:00121839:ios.summary:

Find supplies, craft gears, complete various missions, upgrade
bluejetty:00121839:ios.description:
Sandbox Survival Game with Very High Degree of Freedom.
Classic arcade & retro-style, fun action and adventurous survival game.
The challenge is to survive as long as possible.
Find supplies, craft gears, complete various missions, upgrade items and earn rewards.
Upgrade or make better equipment, weapons, and tools.
Collect all resources, bring them back to craft, and fight hungry monsters to stay alive.
A little game to kill time, highly replayable.
Rich collection of gears and equipment.
Single or Multiplayer Co-op Survival Game.
Grow and fight stronger monsters.
Trade the equipment you need with other players.
Hardcore with good combat that requires intellect.
If you are afraid of being alone you can play online, add friends when you meet people who can chat, connect with people from other countries, and find someone to fight with.
Adventure, Many Maps and Quests to Explore.
Equip your character with many new accessories such as weapons, costumes, power-ups, and many enhanced skills.
Collects resources to make new tools, which can then be used to get better materials, which can then be used to make better tools and weapons.
Clear the level, fight the monsters in different dungeons.
Explore, defeat monsters, gather loot, harvest resources, build a base and survive!
If all you want to do is just KILL, then join the arena and face endless waves of monsters!
There will be different worlds to explore, monsters to defeat, loot to gather and traps to build for your survival!
Play alone or with up to 3 friends together online! 
Share resources, arsenals, and experience the fun together! 
Many secrets await you in Pixel Survival Game 2.
FEATUERS
- Online multiplayer up to 4 players (with friends list)
- Find monster eggs and hatch them into cool pets!
- over hundreds of items to discover
- craft mysterious items with secret combinations
- 3 different modes (Arena, Survival, Exploration)
- lots of traps to craft for your survival
- boss fights!
Tips:
The game is meant to be hard. You will need to figure a lot of things out but there are QUESTS that provides rewards that teaches you mechanics of the game. 
#1 - Complete book of survival quest
#2 - Complete Miffie's quest
#3 - Complete Green's quest
Chest Tips:
Silver Chest - Items, equal loot chance
Golden Chest - Equipments and cards, equal loot chance
Master Chest - Equipments and cards, equal loot chance
Combination Tips:
Combining different items together can create a whole new item. If there is a recipe, you will see the product item. If there is nothing to be made, it will say "Unknown". Every recipe will have a success combination rate. To increase the rate of success, you can add a scroll of combination (+35%) or combine from the Combination Books (+50%).
New recipes will be added to Combination Books from time to time.
Remember to quit / leave game with the in game buttons to properly save your items.
IGRS Rating 18+

bluejetty:00068205:ios.description:
Мой МТС — приложение, в котором удобно проверять баланс и расходы, настраивать тариф, подключать услуги для мобильных устройств, дома и не только, а также управлять сервисами МТС.
— Следите за расходами и остатком ГБ, минут и SMS
Следите за своими тратами и тратами близких, скачивайте детализацию, проверяйте остаток минут, SMS и ГБ интернета, анализируйте, сколько тратите — доступны данные за последние полгода.
— Загляните в Поддержку
Здесь можно найти ответ на свой вопрос, пройти диагностику связи онлайн, измерить скорость интернета или связаться с поддержкой.
— Пользуйтесь всеми возможностями «Защитника»
Сервис цифровой безопасности Защитник определит, с какого номера звонят и заблокирует мошеннические и спам-звонки. На нежелательные звонки с возможной рекламой ответит за вас, сделает запись звонков и пришлёт расшифровку. «Безопасный звонок» проанализирует разговор с помощью ИИ и предупредит во время разговора, если вы разговариваете с возможным мошенником. Защитник для своих пришлет уведомление, если близкий говорит с возможным мошенником. А если из-за мошенников вы потеряли деньги, «Страхование от мошенничества» позволит вернуть до 1,5 млн рублей.
Определитель номера покажет информацию о незнакомом номере: категорию, регион, оператора связи.Фильтр звонков и антиспам работают в фоновом режиме. Голосовой помощник может озвучить, кто звонит, и предупредить о потенциальной угрозе. «Анализ утечек персональных данных» ищет вашу конфиденциальную информацию в сети, а если находит — подсказывает, что делать дальше.
— Соберите Семейную группу
Создайте Семейную группу, чтобы экономить на связи вместе с близкими, быть в курсе местонахождения друг друга и совместно управлять номерами и настройками тарифов. Больше заботы о семье с расширенными опциями безопасности.
— Подключите МТС Секретарь
Если не можете ответить на звонок, его примет Секретарь. Поможет, когда неудобно взять трубку — на встрече, в театре или в шумном месте. Если вы не ответили в течение 20 секунд, Секретарь сделает это за вас, а потом пришлёт запись разговора и его расшифровку. Он также может перевести звонок в чат: слова собеседника придут вам сообщениями, а ваши ответы в реальном времени озвучит Секретарь.
— Используйте интеллектуальную запись звонков
В Мой МТС есть автоматическая запись звонков по мобильной сети и через приложение — как входящих, так и исходящих. Запись разговора сохраняется в аудиоформате и в виде текстовой расшифровки. При этом файлы хранятся в облаке: не занимают память телефона и всегда доступны в приложении. Запись телефонного разговора помогает вернуться к звонку и вспомнить важные детали.
— Получайте выгодные предложения
В разделе Игры на главном экране вы можете выиграть скидки на цифровые продукты и услуги связи, промокоды для полезных и развлекательных сервисов: МТС Музыки, онлайн-кинотеатра KION, Строк и других. Заглядывайте в Каталог, чтобы не пропустить персональные предложения.
При использовании Мой МТС трафик не расходуется. Установка, обновление приложения и переход по внешним ссылкам оплачиваются по условиям тарифа.
Если у вас есть вопрос или предложение — напишите нам на app@mts.ru

bluejetty:00147022:ios.description:
Introducing Hyperflyer, a remarkable instant delivery service that covers all scenarios and is accessible to everyone.
With a vast network of over 3 million delivery drivers across 800+ cities in the US, we ensure swift deliveries to any location within the same city or nearby cities. Expect an average delivery time of approximately 45 minutes for distances within 5 miles, and around 2 hours for distances of 50 miles.
Our comprehensive range of deliverable categories includes food & perishables, flowers, documents, electronics, home furnishings, and more.
Scheduling a delivery is effortless. Simply provide the pickup location, drop-off location, pickup time, and package details. Our system instantly generates the delivery price. Once your order is placed, a driver from our network will handle pickup and delivery.
Stay informed about your delivery orders with real-time status updates and track the driver's location on the map. Enjoy the convenience of 24/7 live chat support for any delivery-related queries.
Key Features:
- Streamlined delivery creation process
- Instant display of delivery price
- Competitive distance-based pricing
- Real-time tracking on the map
- Notifications for status updates
- 24/7 in-app live chat customer support
- Address book for easy location input
- E-gift cards for sending to loved ones
- Hyperflyer credits for added funds and rewards
INNOVATIVE DELIVERY NETWORK
Our innovative delivery network utilizes cutting-edge technology to provide reliable and swift service. Our automated and data-driven system selects the best option from our delivery partners, ensuring the best price and instant delivery speed for each order.
THE MOST ETHICAL FOOD DELIVERY APP
We are constantly seeking ways to better support the community. Our efforts to assist local restaurants during COVID-19 were recognized by Eater SF in 2021, naming us “the most ethical food delivery service.”

bluejetty:00131961:ios.description:
Evaluate your risk of social anxiety disorder with a 24 question screening test. 
This app presents the Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale, a validated screening questionnaire that aims to measure the severity of Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD), also known as Social Phobia. The LSAS-SR is a 24 question self-rating scale which covers fear, avoidance, and physical signs of social anxiety. 
This application is designed so that you can take the test every week and track your test scores over time. 
Disclaimer: This questionnaire cannot indicate a diagnosis of social anxiety disorder. Only a qualified professional can make this diagnosis. Please consult a physician if you are concerned about social anxiety disorder.

bluejetty:00184879:ios.summary:
Many incidents happen in Broomstown every day. Cats go missing, buildings need to be rebuilt, fires need to be put out and much more.
A new Port has been opened recently, and there's a typhoon there!
Become a brave rescuer and help Robocars
bluejetty:00184879:ios.description:
Many incidents happen in Broomstown every day. Cats go missing, buildings need to be rebuilt, fires need to be put out and much more.
A new Port has been opened recently, and there's a typhoon there!
Become a brave rescuer and help Robocars to save Broomstown and its citizens.
ROBOCAR POLI
The game is based on an adventure cartoon with robocars called "Robocar Poli". 
They live in Broomstown, look after its citizens and help in emergencies!
COMPLETE MISSIONS
Follow the dispatcher as she will tell you about all the incidents that happen in town. React immediately, because it might be a fire or another difficult mission! You will have easier missions too: find a missing cat, fix cars and school buses, rebuild gas stations and others.
USE ROBOCARS
Robocars each have different, special skills that can really help you:
Poli is the fastest of all and he will be the first at the incident spot.
Roy is the strongest and can handle a lot.
Amber is the smartest and will find a solution to any problem.
Helly will cheer your mood at any time!
EXPLORE ALL TOWN SPOTS
You will respond to incidents on the City Road, on Bricks Bridge and other locations in game updates!
There are 10 incidents in every spot - solve them all and repeat again. When you complete a mission, you get an item for your city - a bench, a street lamp and others. 
Are you ready to save Broomstown? 
Robocars are ready! Download the game!

bluejetty:00062317:ios.description:
* FROM THE CREATORS OF PETTSON'S INVENTIONS DELUXE *
*** Winner of Parents' Choice Gold Award ***
BE CREATIVE!
In this game you can create your own crazy, fun inventions! With the help of the Inventioneers, our tiny helpers with unique characteristics, you can invent fun, creative and often quite weird inventions. A lot of inventions are included in the game, the more you solve the more parts you receive for your own inventions!
LEARN ABOUT PHYSICS!
Inventioneers is an outstanding tool for learning about realtime physics and the science behind different features like air, fire, magnetism and jumping bunnies. What you can do with the tool is virtually endless. 
SHARE WITH FRIENDS!
Invite friends to share their crazy inventions and you can share yours too! If you are a teacher you can set up the whole classroom as a user and share with other classes!
ONE TIME FEE TO BUY THE FULL VERSION
To make it easier for families to try the game before buying, we have implemented a one time fee to buy the full game. There are no recurring in app purchases or consumables. It is important for us to protect the integrity of the children. 
Features in the free version: 
• First chapter with 15 inventions
• The first Inventioneer - "Windy"
• Create! - A fully working tool to create your own inventions
• 50+ different objects to use in the inventions 
• Share up to 4 inventions with your friends!
The full version (purchase: one time fee):
• 7 more chapters with a total of 105 new inventions!
• 50+ new objects
• 18 characters that you can help 
• 7 more Inventioneers with unique features - "Blaze", "Bunny", "Sporty", "Zappy", "Magneta", "Freezy" and "Maggie"
Family Sharing
Note! You can't share IAPs with other members in your family. Please download the full version of Inventioneers instead.

bluejetty:00018775:ios.description:
The Essence Of Banh Mi
The taste of Banh Mi is like Vietnam itself: bold and unique. This flavorful sandwich had to capture the attention of the busy motorbikers driving by on the crowded streets of Vietnamese cities. Designed to be quick, convenient, and easy to carry, banh mi never lost one important characteristic: flavor. These sandwiches were so delicious and so popular that Vietnamese cities saw the rise of tiny tables and chairs alongside busy streets, where customers could sit and enjoy banh mi while taking in the iconic sites of Vietnam. 
The secret to a good banh mi sandwich is fresh ingredients that are free from trans fats. Inspired by the French Colonial period, when France occupied Vietnam, the banh mi began as a combination of locally found Vietnamese meats and vegetables stuffed into a French baguette. The resulting sandwich exploded in popularity. Since then, it has become the essence of the Vietnamese urban cuisine dining experience. Rooted in the simplicity and richness of the Vietnamese culture, banh mi continues to win new fans as demand for it spreads throughout the world.
Now you can browse our menu and securely place your order from your iPhone! Download and get started today!
You will be prompted to opt-in or opt-out of push notifications upon the first app start up after download from Apple App Store to an iOS device. Once a selection has been made, any changes to push notifications preferences have to come from your device operating system settings.

bluejetty:00013912:ios.name: Canon PRINT Business
bluejetty:00013912:ios.summary: Canon PRINT Business is a free application that enables you to use a Canon laser multi-function device or laser printer to print photographs and documents, read scanned data, and upload to cloud storage services, etc. from an iPhone or iPad
bluejetty:00013912:ios.description:
Canon PRINT Business is a free application that enables you to use a Canon laser multi-function device or laser printer to print photographs and documents, read scanned data, and upload to cloud storage services, etc. from an iPhone or iPad.
* Canon PRINT Business has been merged with Canon PRINT. Please use Canon PRINT in the future.
Main Features
- Print scanned data, images, documents, camera roll photos, and web pages.
- Read scanned data from a multi-function device.
- Image capture with a camera.
- Work with files in local or cloud storage.
- Automatically detect multi-function devices and/or printers on a network, or manually search for them by specifying an IP address or DNS.
- Search multi-function devices and/or printers with Bluetooth.
- Touch the mobile terminal to log in to the multi-function device and/or printer (Bluetooth installed machine).
- Register multi-function devices and/or printers with a QR code.
- Use the address book of a mobile terminal in place of the address book registered in a multi-function device.
- Check the condition of a multi-function device or printer in detail, such as device status etc., via its Remote UI.
- Support VoiceOver (some English and Japanese screens only)
- Use the Remote Operation function to display the control panel of the multi-function device and/or printer on a mobile terminal.
- Use the app to copy, send faxes, or scan and send by e-mail from a multi-function device or printer.
* Functions that can be used vary according to the device, the firmware version of the device, and device settings you are using.
Supported Devices
imageRUNNER ADVANCE series
Color imageRUNNER series
imageRUNNER series
Color imageCLASS series
imageCLASS series
i-SENSYS series
imagePRESS series
LBP series
Satera series
Laser Shot series
Business Inkjet series
- Some device models do not support Canon PRINT Business. Check the list of supported device models on the Canon PRINT Business support page of the Canon website.
- For printing with PIXMA series, MAXIFY series or SELPHY series devices, use Canon PRINT.
- For scanning with imageFORMULA series devices, use CaptureOnTouch Mobile.
Required Conditions
- Your iPhone or iPad must be connected to a wireless LAN access point.
- Your multi-function device and the access point must be connected by LAN or wireless LAN.
Items That Can Be Set with the Print Function
 Output Method, Department ID Management, User Authentication, Output Size, Copies, Print Range, Paper Source, Select Color, 2-Sided, Staple, 2 on 1, Image Quality
 - Items that can be set vary according to each printer model.
Items That Can Be Set With the Scan Function
 Color/Select Color, Resolution, Original Size/Scan Size, File Format, 2-Sided Original/2-Sided, Original Type, Density, Original Placement
 - Items that can be set vary according to each printer model.

bluejetty:00183904:ios.summary: Lock & Alert puts you in charge of who can access your Equifax credit report, with certain exceptions.¹ Lock or unlock your Equifax credit report with just a simple click or swipe, and we’ll alert you each time your Equifax credit report is
bluejetty:00183904:ios.description:
Lock & Alert puts you in charge of who can access your Equifax credit report, with certain exceptions.¹ Lock or unlock your Equifax credit report with just a simple click or swipe, and we’ll alert you each time your Equifax credit report is locked or unlocked.
Lock & Alert is free for U.S. consumers.
Lock your Equifax credit report to help better protect against identity theft.
Applying for credit? Open the app, and unlock with one simple swipe or click. Then simply swipe or click again to lock when you're done. 
We'll alert you each time your Equifax credit report is locked or unlocked.
Having trouble or need a quick answer while using the app? Visit the Support tab in the app to find the answers to frequently asked questions, or to contact customer service.
Sign in to the Lock & Alert app using Touch ID, Face ID, or enter your user name and password.
Note: Lock & Alert and myEquifax use separate accounts. Your Lock & Alert credentials would be different from your myEquifax username and password, unless you registered with the same username and password for both. If this is your first time using Lock & Alert, please choose “Sign up”.
¹ Locking your Equifax credit report will prevent access to it by certain third parties. Locking your Equifax credit report will not prevent access to your credit report at any other credit reporting agency. Entities that may still have access to your Equifax credit report include: companies like Equifax Consumer Services LLC, which provide you with access to your credit report or credit score, or monitor your credit report as part of a subscription or similar service; companies that provide you with a copy of your credit report or credit score, upon your request; federal, state and local government agencies and courts in certain circumstances; companies using the information in connection with the underwriting of insurance, or for employment, tenant or background screening purposes; companies that have a current account or relationship with you, and collection agencies acting on behalf of those whom you owe; companies that authenticate a consumer's identity for purposes other than granting credit, or for investigating or preventing actual or potential fraud; and companies that wish to make pre-approved offers of credit or insurance to you. To opt out of such pre-approved offers, visit www.optoutprescreen.com.

bluejetty:00015442:ios.name: Bubble Shooter Bunny Games
bluejetty:00015442:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00015442:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow.
Smarter, Inclusive Learning for Every Child
SKIDOS now supports kids with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dysgraphia & Dyscalculia. Built with accessibility guidelines, the experience is tailored to every child’s unique learning needs—making learning more personalized, inclusive, and enjoyable for neurodivergent learners too
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
RABBIT RESCUE - BUBBLE SHOOTER
Help rabbit mama to save her babies. 100+ levels of fun & addictive Bubble Shooter gameplay!
For each level, you will get a limited amount of bubbles to shoot, use them wisely!
Features: 
- 100+ challenges 
- use a lot of Power-ups and boosters 
- amazing graphics, cute rabbits! 
- play in wonderful world map
- the game for all ages
SKIDOS LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our unique approach is to engage kids in learning while they play games they love. We gathered a collection of 40+ fun games and incorporated interactive learning content into them. 4 million kids around the globe play & learn with SKIDOS!
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, etc. Tasks evolve as a child progresses. Interactive design and animation support learning - three cute little SKIDOS mascots help and encourage kids when they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybug will show a little learner how to trace with their finger while visuals and a voice-over will teach new words and counting.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Video content prompts children's curiosity in a fun and easy way. We created the right mix of entertainment & learning with our video catalog.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS apps do not show ads to kids, are COPPA & GDPR compliant, and ensure a safe online learning environment for kids.
Get your SKIDOS Pass today!
- SKIDOS offers monthly, quarterly, annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- 3 Day Free Trial! Payment will be charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The SKIDOS Pass may be managed by the user & auto-renewal for subscriptions may be turned off in the user’s device Account Settings
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a Pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

라디오보다 재미있는 팟캐스트, 귀로 듣는 오디오북, 그리고 명사들의 고품격 강연까지!

■ 팟빵 독점 콘텐츠, 오디오 매거진 서비스
김어준, 김혜리 등 최고의 오피니언 리더들이 만드는 월간 오디오 매거진을 만나보세요.
매월 업데이트되는 밀도 높은 오디오 콘텐츠는 물론, 사진과 일러스트 등 풍부한 볼거리까지! 
오직 팟빵에서만 경험할 수 있는 프리미엄 구독 서비스입니다.
■ 팟빵 자체제작 오리지널 콘텐츠
- [매불쇼] 압도적인 재미 최욱의 매불쇼
- [크라임] 대한민국 사회의 다양한 범죄 이야기
- [대안뉴스] 종합 시사, 정치, 데일리 방송
- [과장창] 모두에게 필요한 과학의 시간
■ 세상의 모든 지식과 재미의 오디오 라이브러리
예능, 시사, 경제, 어학, 스포츠 등 모든 장르를 총망라했습니다.
- [예능/유머] 출퇴근길 순삭! 지루할 틈 없는 레전드 예능 방송
- [시사/뉴스] 정치, 사회 이슈를 가장 빠르고 깊이 있게 분석하는 시사 팟캐스트
- [경제/재테크] 주식, 부동산, 부자 되는 습관 등 꼭 들어야 할 경제 인사이트
- [어학/공부] 영어, 일본어, 중국어 회화부터 문법까지 귀가 트이는 어학 공부
- [방송 다시듣기] KBS, SBS 지상파부터 종편까지 놓친 라디오/방송 하이라이트

bluejetty:00180708:ios.description:
Meet Cleaner Kit—the all-in-one iPhone cleaner trusted by 70M+ users to declutter photos, videos, emails, contacts, and more.
Running out of storage? Tired of scrolling through thousands of duplicate photos or a cluttered inbox? With this phone cleaner, you can free up gigabytes of space in seconds. Powered by AI, Cleaner Kit scans your device to detect duplicates, blurry shots, and junk files instantly. Simply tap to declutter and enjoy a perfectly organized iPhone.
WHY USE OUR IPHONE CLEANER?
►All-in-one iPhone cleaner: Declutter photos, videos, emails, and contacts in a single app.
►High-accuracy AI: Detect duplicates, blurry shots, and junk files with precision.
►Swipe-based sorting: Right to keep, left to delete—decluttering your iPhone has never been this fast.
►Private by design: All AI processing happens on your iPhone only. 
DUPLICATE PHOTO & VIDEO REMOVER 
Repeating shots, blurry photos, and useless screenshots—this iPhone cleaner finds them all. High-accuracy AI scans your gallery to detect duplicates and low-quality photos. Review and delete them individually, or remove them all with just one tap.
SORT PHOTOS WITH SWIPES
Decluttering your gallery should feel effortless. Our phone cleaner groups photos by time period, then lets you swipe right to keep your favorites or left to archive blurry and outdated shots. Review archived photos later or delete them immediately if you need space.
DECLUTTER EMAILS & CONTACTS
Take control of your inbox and contact list with this iPhone cleaner. 
• Group emails by date, sender, or size and delete in bulk. 
• Merge duplicate contacts and remove empty entries. 
Have your whole phone organized in seconds.
COMPRESS VIDEOS WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY 
Running low on storage, but can't part with your videos? This phone cleaner compresses large videos while preserving visual quality, saving space and keeping your memories intact.
PRIVACY & SECURITY 
Your data stays yours and yours alone—nothing is uploaded or shared. Our phone cleaner runs directly on your device with no internet connection required. Need extra protection? Store sensitive photos and contacts in a secret folder locked with Face ID or a passcode. This iPhone cleaner helps keep your private life private.
TRY IT FREE
Try this phone cleaner for free. Access essential cleanup tools at no cost, with optional upgrades available.
EXTRA OPTIONS 
Our phone cleaner offers even more: cleaning guides, charging animations, large fonts, and a high-contrast interface for users with vision impairments. You can even mark your favorite files to protect them from accidental deletion, keeping your most treasured memories safe.
Decluttering your iPhone has never been easier. Download Cleaner Kit now and enjoy a perfectly organized iPhone!
UNLIMITED ACCESS 
– Subscribe for full access to all iPhone cleaner features—billed weekly or annually. 
– Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the billing period ends. 
– Free trial includes all features, some with limited use. 
– Manage auto-renewal in your App Store Account Settings.
By using Cleaner Kit, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00026655:ios.name: FEED Mobile
bluejetty:00026655:ios.summary:
Now you can access FEED from anywhere. Instantly connect and enhance your associate experience to see your schedule, news, deals and links to applications you use every day, at your fingertips.
We are excited to bring you a new and improve
bluejetty:00026655:ios.description:
Now you can access FEED from anywhere. Instantly connect and enhance your associate experience to see your schedule, news, deals and links to applications you use every day, at your fingertips.
We are excited to bring you a new and improved FEED experience! The FEED Mobile App has all the great resources from desktop FEED but puts them directly at your fingertips on your mobile device.
• Access your schedule. 
• Keep updated on safety and associate resources.
• Read inspiring articles about associates and company news.
• Find daily news and notes.
• Access the tools you need for your job.
• And more! 
FEED Mobile App is intended to help improve your overall associate experience by giving you a more convenient way (an easier way) to engage with company content.
Scroll through breaking news articles on the home page or venture to the Schedule tab for hourly associates’ schedule. Check your paycheck stubs by accessing ExpressHR through your profile menu, the ExpressHR Quick Link or by using the navigation bar.
Learn about Kroger history and our programs in the ‘About Kroger’ page off the main menu. The ‘Zero Hunger | Zero Waste’ page features the progress we are making on our overall goal to reduce waste and hunger by 2025. Let your voice be heard on the ‘Your Feedback’ page. 
Access Associate Deals off the main menu where you can find all the great benefits our company offers. 
The ‘Company News’ page gives you a glimpse into the news and happenings at the Kroger Family of Companies. CEO and Chairman Rodney McMullen regularly gives updates on the company. Learn about programs and read inspiring stories from fellow associates. Be inspired to try new innovative food items and recipes by engaging in foodie stories posted to FEED. 
Additionally, associates can use the mobile app to easily access the tools they need to do their job by selecting their department page off the main menu.
All divisions are accessible and have their own destinations on FEED as well.

bluejetty:00118813:ios.summary:

Collect reviews, convert leads, run surveys, text customers, get referrals and much more -- all in one place.
It’s time for a single-stack approach to b
bluejetty:00118813:ios.description:
Birdeye is the place for multi-location businesses to acquire customers on autopilot.
Collect reviews, convert leads, run surveys, text customers, get referrals and much more -- all in one place.
It’s time for a single-stack approach to business growth. Birdeye delivers winning experiences for every step of your customer journey. From search to sold, and repeat at scale with the all-in-one Experience Marketing platform.
Connect with your customers at every touchpoint, whether you have 10 or 10,000 locations. The intuitive Birdeye app is your on-the-go means to leverage the convenience of sending new review requests, responding to messages from different channels and being available for all your customers. With effortless navigation and design along with instant notifications, the app ensures your customers are always a priority.
* Send text or email review requests to your customers, making it effortless to get new reviews on Google, Facebook or 200+ other review sources supported by Birdeye.
* Respond to all your reviews from one place and ensure your customers feel valued. Promote authentic reviews across the web to reach more prospective customers and drive more traffic.
* Use Birdeye Unified Inbox to view and respond to messages from customers through Webchat, text messages and Facebook Messenger -- from a single place.
* Add internal notes, then assign messages within a team to better collaborate and get the best answer for the customer, easier & faster.
* Analyze reports, gain actionable insights to make significant improvements where it counts.
* Receive instant alerts and stay connected to your customers.
About Birdeye:
Birdeye is an all-in-one Experience Marketing platform for multi-location businesses. More than 60,000 businesses of all sizes use Birdeye every day to be found online and chosen through listings, reviews and referrals; be connected with leads and customers on the channels of their choice, and deliver the best customer experience with survey, ticketing and insights tools.
Any questions? Please contact support@birdeye.com.

bluejetty:00088723:ios.description:
The best at home workout app for pregnant and postpartum moms is waiting for you. All the workouts you need are waiting for you inside the Expecting and Empowered app! 
Expertly created by a women's health physical therapist and a personal trainer, Expecting and Empowered has safe and effective workouts to take the guesswork out of your fitness routine in motherhood. Whether you're trying to conceive, pregnant, or postpartum - we have programs for you!
With easy to follow workout plans that will take you week by week through your pregnancy or postpartum journey, you can find manageable and efficient workouts you can do at home or the gym inside the app. Designed to be done in just 30 minutes or less with minimal equipment, moms love the Expecting and Empowered App. 
With built in accountability challenges, supportive community and moms just like you - you'll find encouragement like no other. 
Find workouts you'll love, including:
-Pregnancy Strength Training
-Postpartum Strength Training - both vaginal and C-section delivery
-Elevated + Empowered Advanced Postpartum Strength Training
-Postpartum Running Evaluation
-Return to Running Program
-Beginning, Intermediate, and Advanced Level Runs
-Core Strengthening Series
-Empower Your Core Programs - both vaginal and C-section delivery programs
-Yoga - both prenatal and postpartum
-Ability to Schedule Workouts 
STAY CONNECTED:
-The app offers a community feature- where women that are going through what you’re going through can connect, support, and encourage each other. 
PRELOAD CLASSES: 
-If you’ll be without wifi, you can pre-download the classes that you’re planning to take. 
EXPERTISE + EDUCATION:
Amy Kiefer is a registered nurse, doula, and personal trainer. Along with her co-founder and sister Krystle Howald who is a physical therapist, they offer educational posts that will help you navigate through pregnancy and postpartum. Whether you have a question about round ligament pain or about if working out will impact your milk supply- they have the answers in this section. 
Terms of use: https://www.expectingandempowered.com/app-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00162152:ios.description:
Paybis Crypto Wallet is an all-in-one crypto exchange and virtual wallet app. With a streamlined interface, strong security, and features that let you buy, sell, and store crypto, it's built to cover all your cryptocurrency needs. Trusted by 7 million people across 180+ countries.
Licensed & Regulated
Paybis operates under full financial licenses, not just registrations. In the EU, Paybis holds a MiCA CASP authorization and a Payment Institution (PI) license from the Bank of Latvia, passporting across all 27 EU member states. Paybis is also registered with FinCEN in the United States and FINTRAC in Canada. Client funds are held separately from company assets.
Universal Crypto Wallet and Exchange
Paybis Wallet gives you a built-in digital wallet to securely store, manage, and keep full control of your crypto. Buy from 90+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USD Coin (USDC), Binance Coin (BNB), Ripple (XRP), Litecoin (LTC), Polkadot (DOT), Chainlink (LINK), and more, all managed and monitored within a single app.
Buy & Send to Any Wallet
Your crypto, your control. Buy directly to your own external wallet, or send and receive crypto to any wallet address straight from the app. Paybis makes moving your assets simple, whether you are topping up, paying someone, or moving funds to cold storage.
Secure and Reliable
Paybis Wallet provides a secure environment for managing your digital assets. On iOS, sign in securely with passkeys, no password to remember or lose. Advanced encryption and robust security measures protect your funds and personal information. The app uses industry-standard security protocols, complies with AML/KYC regulations, and helps protect you from fraud and scams.
Pay with PayPal
Buy crypto instantly with PayPal. Available in the United States and across Europe, PayPal lets you fund your purchase in seconds using an account you already know, with no card details to enter.
Fast, Transparent Fees
No surprises at checkout. Every fee is shown in full before you confirm anything. The first time you buy each crypto with a card, Paybis takes nothing on top. Transactions start from just $5. Buy up to $1,000 with no verification, or verify in under 2 minutes to raise your limits.
International Reach
Join the crypto world from anywhere. Available in 180+ countries, Paybis Wallet works wherever you are. Buy, receive, and send crypto on the go.
Multilingual Support
The app supports 9 languages, so you can navigate and use the platform in your preferred language.
Wide Range of Currencies
Whether you use your local currency or popular pairs like USD to BTC or EUR to BTC, Paybis has you covered, from AED to ZAR.
User-Friendly Interface
Enjoy a smooth, intuitive experience. The streamlined interface works for both beginners and experienced users, making navigation effortless.
Powerful Tools
Get more from your crypto with Paybis Wallet's built-in tools. Use the crypto calculator for accurate, real-time pricing, and the price tracker to follow market movements across major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Polygon, BNB, and Polkadot.
24/7 Live Support
Get help any time. Paybis offers round-the-clock live chat with a typical response time of 1 to 2 minutes.
Payment Options
Fund your purchases your way. Paybis Wallet supports 22 payment methods, including credit/debit cards, bank transfers, PayPal, and alternative providers like Skrill, Neteller, and PaysafeCard. With the intuitive mobile interface, you can quickly buy Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USD Coin (USDC), Binance Coin (BNB), Polkadot (DOT), or any other supported asset.
Don’t invest unless you’re prepared to lose all the money you invest. This is a high‑risk investment and you should not expect to be protected if something goes wrong. Take 2 mins to learn more at: https://go.payb.is/FCA-Info

Draw Hero 3D is a new puzzle game where you need to rid the world of bandits and zombies. The main goal is to draw a suitable weapon and kick all the enemies off the level. Make the right decisions, choose the appropriate weapon's shape and smash 'em all. Train your brain and be ready to face the most cunning enemies!
How to play Draw Hero 3D?
Draw the appropriate weapon with your finger to get rid of the bad guys and save the world. Be careful – you don't have much space on the screen where you can draw shapes and weapons. Use the available space wisely.
All you need to be the leader in this puzzle game is to use your logic and brain & solve interesting quests. Draw cool weapons and defeat the bad guys to save all the victims as fast as possible!
Game features:
- Addictive gameplay
- Interesting puzzles
- Multiple levels
- Amazing 2D graphics, visuals & sounds
- Easy controls
Draw Hero 3D is a new era of stickman puzzle games! Save 'em all and become a hero!
Put your logic and creativity under the test! Click the install button and enjoy!

bluejetty:00033200:ios.description:
Take the Pittsburgh's Action News 4 app with you everywhere you go and be the first to know of breaking news happening in Pittsburgh and the surrounding area. Always stay up to date with the latest local news, national, sports, traffic, political, entertainment stories and much more. Download the Pittsburgh's Action News 4 app for free today.
Our Local News, Weather and Sports App Features Include:
- Pittsburgh breaking news alerts with push notifications
- Live streaming breaking news updates from our Pittsburgh's Action News 4 reporters when it happens, where it happens
- Local news submission area for breaking news, news tips and the ability to email your news photos and videos right to our newsroom to be featured on air
- Ability to share stories via email or your social media pages
- Up to date, current local weather conditions, hourly Pittsburgh weather updates, and 7 day forecasts
- An interactive radar that lets you zoom in and out to street level and watch storms as they approach. Move the map around to see major weather activity
- Pittsburgh weather alerts and updates, Pittsburgh's Action Weather 4 videocasts and more
Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

bluejetty:00161156:ios.description:
Real sweat. Real results. Fitness for real life 
LEAN with Lilly is your ultimate destination for structured, results driven fitness that goes far beyond the physical. Built on the science-based LEAN Method, this premium training experience blends at home Pilates, Strength and Cardio into powerful, full length programs that energise your body, focus your mind and build resilience from within.
This is not just a workout plan - it’s a lifestyle designed to help you step into your strongest, most confident and fearless self.
What makes the LEAN Method different?
Expert Led, Science-Based Programs
Every workout is designed with purpose, eliminating guesswork and maximising your time, energy and progress.
Hybrid Strength, Cardio and Pilates Methodology
A proven combination that supports sustainable transformation and delivers real, lasting results.
Full Length Structured Programs
Expertly curated Programs that balance challenge and progression with mobility and recovery to avoid burnout or injury.
More Than Just Physical Results
The LEAN Method is a holistic approach to fitness. You’ll feel stronger, more grounded and motivated from the inside out.
Inside the LEAN App you'll find:
New Workouts Weekly
Stay inspired with new content each week. Choose from purpose driven LEAN Studios: Strength, Cardio, Pilates & Sculpt, Yoga & Physio and Combat Conditioning, led by Lilly and our expert trainers.
Personalised Meal Plans
Reach your goals faster with nutrition plans tailored to your lifestyle. With hundreds of recipes and guidance from nutritionists, you’ll be fuelled to accelerate your results.
Physio Support
Train smarter and avoid injury with access to physiotherapy led tutorials and educational content.
Progress Tracking and Workout Calendar
All of your workouts, tracked in real time so you can look back on your progress with ease.
Journaling and Habit Tracking
Track your goals, reflect on your journey, and stay accountable with built-in tools to support consistency and mindset.
Train From Any Device
Take your workouts even further with full access to the LEAN Web platform: your workouts, your pace, on your preferred screen.
A global community. A personal transformation.
With millions of people worldwide using the App-exclusive LEAN Method, this is more than fitness, it’s a movement. Wherever you’re starting, the LEAN App will guide you through structure, challenge, and holistic transformation - both physical and mental.
Experience the shift. Join the LEAN Community today.
LEAN is free to download and offers the following subscription options:
 • 1 Month: £16.99 / $22.99
 • 3 Months: £39.99 / $52.99
 • 12 Months: £119.99 / $158.99
Your subscription will work across your devices and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings within iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, no refunds will be provided for any unused portion of the term.
By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Conditions, which can be found at: https://www.leanwithlilly.com/policies/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00017596:ios.description:
Con tu App BancoEstado todo es más fácil.
La app de BancoEstado te permite gestionar todas tus operaciones bancarias de forma rápida, segura y sin moverte de donde estés.
Principales funcionalidades de la app: 
• Pagos y compras con QR: Utiliza Compraquí QR para pagar en comercios escaneando el código con tu cuenta PagoRUT, o usa PagoRUT para pagar y cobrar de manera simple.
• Paga en línea: Escanea el QR en la web del comercio y autoriza el pago con tu clave BE Pass.
• Paga en el transporte público de Santiago: Con Pasaje QR RED, olvídate de las tarjetas y paga tu viaje en micro, metro y tren usando solo tu celular.
• Control total de tus tarjetas: Bloquea y desbloquea tu Tarjeta CuentaRUT, Cuenta Corriente o Chequera Electrónica. Cambia, recupera o activa la clave de tu tarjeta de débito para cajeros automáticos y compras en comercios.
• Gestión de pagos: Paga tus cuotas de Crédito de Consumo, Hipotecario o Tarjeta de Crédito desde la app. Además, realiza pagos de servicios como agua, luz, y teléfono de manera rápida y fácil.
• Transferencias instantáneas: Envía dinero rápidamente a los contactos en tu celular o a nuevos destinatarios.
• Tu saldo y suscripciones siempre bajo control: Consulta tu saldo las veces que quieras sin costo y revisa dónde tienes registradas tus tarjetas para gestionar tus suscripciones con facilidad.
• Inversiones y ahorro: Accede a productos de ahorro e inversión directamente desde la app para hacer crecer tu dinero.
• Giros y remesas desde la app: Realiza giros en Caja Vecina escaneando un QR, y envía remesas sin tener que ir a una sucursal.
• Compra tus pasajes de bus, tren y transfer: Organiza tus viajes por Chile comprando tus pasajes desde la app de forma rápida y sencilla.
•Autoriza tus operaciones con BE Pass o BE Face, sin usar la Tarjeta Clave de Transferencias. 
Descarga la app y realiza todas tus operaciones desde tu celular, sin preocuparte por horarios ni filas.

bluejetty:00124221:ios.description:
Drift around corners and dodge obstacles in the addictive game, Sling Drift! With easy controls, it's simple to play but hard to stop. Join the drift hunters flocking to the drifting car game for its addictive gameplay and challenging drift race courses. 
In the world of absolute drift, where mastering the art of car drift is key. Tap and hold to slide your sport car smoothly, collect gems for cool new rides, and tackle tougher levels. Love driving and drifting? This game's for you!
Drift car game's features:
– Easy one-tap controls
– Unlock a variety of sport cars
– Addictive gameplay
– Free to download

So, join the ranks of thumb drift champions and embark on your journey to become the ultimate drift master in Sling Drift!

This is an auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your iTunes account after purchase confirmation. Your subscription is renewed unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal as well. See the below links for more information.

bluejetty:00077359:ios.description:
Make your Home Screen uniquely yours.
Colorful Widget brings together widgets, themes, app icons, wallpapers, Lock Screen designs, and Dynamic Island experiences, giving you one place to personalize your phone from the Home Screen to the Lock Screen.
# Featured in the App Store in multiple regions #
[OS 27: A Bigger Home Screen, More Ways to Make It Yours]
Designed for the new OS 27 experience, extra-large vertical widgets open up more room for content and creative layouts. CarPlay adds new personalization options, extending your favorite style across more Apple experiences.
Extra-Large Vertical Widgets: Designed for the new widget size in OS 27, with support for more content and layout options to make your Home Screen richer and more expressive.
CarPlay Personalization: Add personalized widgets and custom welcome messages. In-car live TV is available only while parked and depends on vehicle, system, and platform support.
[Curated Themes: Create Your Home Screen Style in One Tap]
Over 300 professional designers have crafted complete theme sets with coordinated colors, layouts, app icons, widgets, and wallpapers. Choose from Instagram-inspired, minimalist, girly, starry-sky, astronaut, and many other styles.
Explore depth-effect wallpapers, Liquid Glass themes, custom animated covers, and a wide range of static and animated Lock Screen wallpapers to keep your screens in sync.
[Everyday Information Without Opening the App]
Weather, calendars, to-do lists, countdowns, digital clocks, and flip clocks keep your schedule and important dates on your Home Screen. With your permission, the health steps widget can periodically sync HealthKit data so you can check steps, calories, and walking distance at a glance.
Cat Battery, X-Panel, and other dashboard widgets bring storage, battery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and screen brightness into one view. Interactive to-do and task widgets let you take quick actions from the Home Screen, Lock Screen, or StandBy.
[From the Lock Screen to Dynamic Island]
Use Lock Screen shortcuts, animated wallpapers, and charging animations to give every wake-up a different mood. Dynamic Island effects, StandBy widgets, and Control Center customization keep useful information and personal style within easy reach.
[Bring Favorite Photos and Fan Energy to Your Home Screen]
Upload photos to create Home Screen widgets, app icons, and custom themes. Journal-style borders, film strips, movie-frame layouts, and animated Polaroid or fan photo-card templates help you create a personal fan-themed Home Screen and Lock Screen.
Download Colorful Widget now. Start with one widget you love and begin your Home Screen makeover.

bluejetty:00080930:ios.description:
Welcome to Summoners Kingdom, a thrilling fantasy card RPG adventure!
Dear Summoners, our kingdom needs your help! Dive into the mystical world of Summoners Kingdom and embark on an epic journey to save our realm from darkness. Rescue your beloved goddess and protect her from the clutches of evil as you fight to restore peace and harmony to our land.
Summon and Collect Heroes:
Gather over 100 unique and powerful heroes, each with their own special abilities and skills. From brave warriors to cunning mages, assemble your ultimate team of heroes and unleash their power in battle!
Strategic Card Battles:
Engage in strategic card battles where every decision counts! Use your collection of cards wisely to outsmart your opponents and claim victory in intense battles.
Explore the Realm:
Venture through various realms filled with mythical creatures, ancient ruins, and hidden treasures. Discover the secrets of Summoners Kingdom as you explore new lands and encounter legendary creatures.
Build Your Kingdom:
Construct and upgrade your kingdom to strengthen your heroes and unlock new abilities. Build alliances with other players, join guilds, and compete in epic guild battles for glory and rewards.
Master the Elements:
Harness the power of the elements to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Strategically use fire, water, earth, and wind elements to defeat your enemies and become the ultimate Summoner!
Gorgeous 3D Artwork:
Immerse yourself in stunning 3D graphics and exquisite artwork inspired by Norse mythology. Experience the beauty and danger of the Summoners Kingdom in breathtaking detail.
Strategic Placement:
Deploy your heroes strategically on the battlefield and watch them come to life in thrilling battles. Utilize placement tactics to maximize your team's potential and overcome any challenge.
Log in now and join the adventure in Summoners Kingdom, the idle RPG card game with beautiful heroines and epic battles inspired by Norse mythology!
Your early access data will be retained.

bluejetty:00088275:ios.description:
◘ The Ultimate Jim Wendler 5/3/1 Workout Calculator & Strength Logger
Stop managing spreadsheets! Highly rated 4.8 stars by over 5,000 lifters, the 5/3/1 Log: Wendler Workout Tracker is the essential app for planning, logging, and tracking your entire Jim Wendler 5/3/1, Beyond 5/3/1, and all custom 531 cycles. Trust the tracker that handles all the complex calculations so you can focus on hitting new PRs.
This app is designed for serious powerlifting and strength training progression, eliminating guesswork and ensuring you follow the principles of Progressive Overload.
◘ Master the Big Lifts & Lift with Structure
Think of this app as your personal coach giving you the structure and accountability you need. With our 5/3/1 calculator, there is no guesswork:
* Show Up, Open App, Lift: The workout structure is automatically laid out for you.
* Track and progress on all four main lifts: Squats, Deadlift, Bench Press, and Overhead Press (OHP).
* The app manages your 5/3/1 progression by automatically laying out the weights and reps for each workout day.
◘ Privacy-Focused & User-First
We built this app to be a clean, focused workout logger with maximum privacy:
* NO Subscription.
* NO Registration Required.
* NO Ads.
* NO Selling Your Data.
* NO Recurring or Hidden Costs.
◘ Intelligent 5/3/1 Calculator & Progression
* Automatic 5/3/1 Cycle Management: Enter your estimated 1 Rep Max (1RM / E1RM) once and let the app manage your entire 4-week cycle progression.
* Training Max Control: Easily configure your Training Max Percentage for precise weight calculation.
* Plates Calculator (Plate Math Solved): See exactly which weight plates to load for every set. Supports Kg/Lb and configurable bar weights for your main lifts.
* Progress Tracking: Visualize your gains with detailed progress charts for your current 1RM and tracked Bodyweight.
◘ All Major 5/3/1 Templates & Variations Supported
We support every popular template from the Beyond 5/3/1 book and community, giving you infinite customization to achieve your goals, whether building strength or muscle mass.
* Boring But Big (BBB) Sets: Full configuration of your percentages for your supplemental workThe Ultimate Jim Wendler 5/3/1 Workout Calculator & Strength Log

Trust the tracker that handles all the complex calculations so you can focus on hitting new PRs.
* This app is designed for serious powerlifting and strength training progression, eliminating guesswork and ensuring you follow the principles of Progressive Overload.
◘ Seamless Gym Experience
Warm-up Sets: Automatic calculation and logging of all required warm-up sets included.
Rest Timer: Built-in timer with configurable lengths to maintain workout intensity.
Apple Health Integration: Automatically push your completed workout data to Apple Health.
◘ Trial & Feature Unlock Information
The app includes a generous 3-week trial period with all features available. At the end of the trial, a one-time purchase is required to permanently unlock:
* "5/3/1 Pro" Feature: To continue logging the main 5/3/1 workouts.
* "Assistance Workouts" Feature: To continue logging your supplemental assistance exercises.
◘ Important Disclaimer
This app is an independent calculator and log. It is not affiliated with Mr. Jim Wendler (the creator of the 5/3/1 program). We highly recommend purchasing his official book(s) to fully understand the philosophy behind the program.

bluejetty:00175018:ios.description:
Change the way you explore Road to Hana with GyPSy Guide, the most loved and trusted app for the Road to Hana and beyond. Get 4 unforgettable routes (with 190+ stories) in one purchase:
1) Original Route: Follow the classic and recommended path with engaging stories as you journey forward on the Road to Hana.
2) Return Route: On your return journey, experience a completely different set of stories, offering new perspectives and enriching the overall adventure.
3) The Loop (Clockwise): Explore the full Road to Hana experience in a complete loop.
4) Backroad (Counterclockwise): Take the road less traveled and uncover hidden treasures.
With GyPSy Guide, you get more than just directions—you get an unforgettable journey with local insights, must-see stops, and the freedom to explore at your own pace. This original, classic guide makes the trip extraordinary — there’s nothing else like it. Experience breathtaking views of waterfalls, black sand beaches, bamboo forests, and lava rock formations, making every twist unforgettable.
Why choose GyPSy Guide?
‣ Road to Hana Experts: Your Local Guide to Paradise! Over half a million travelers trust us, the New York Times, and probably all of your friends who’ve been here before. We’re not just another app—we’re THE dedicated guide for the Road to Hana, offering deep, expert insights into every twist and turn of this iconic Hawaiian journey.
‣ GPS-Triggered Audio Play: Discover 200+ stops with seamless, automatic audio that plays as you drive. The audio guides you to the best sights, shares local legends, and offers tips to make the most of your journey.
‣ Expert Audio Guidance: Our self-guided audio tour offers professional advice on prioritizing “must-see” viewpoints, suggests side trips, and shares insider knowledge, ensuring you get the most out of your journey—on your terms.
‣ Offline Navigation: Aloha, No Signal? No Problem! Our tours work flawlessly offline, using free GPS—no data, network, or Wi-Fi needed.
GyPSy Guide: It’s Just Like Having a Tour Guide in Your Car.
What to Expect:
‣ Explore at Your Own Pace: With GyPSy Guide, your Road to Hana journey is in your hands. You set the pace, whether it's black sand beaches, the Pipiwai Bamboo Trail, or a stop for banana bread.
‣ Must-See Stops: Discover iconic spots like Ho’okipa, Rainbow Eucalyptus at Ke’anae Arboretum, Hamoa Beach, and the “Seven Sacred Pools” at Oheo.
‣ Top Highlights: With 8-12 hours of exploration ahead, we’ll ensure you hit the top must-see stops and give you insider tips to avoid time-wasters so you can enjoy the journey to the fullest.
‣ Cultural Narratives: As you return, we’ll bring Hawaii’s rich history and culture to life, making every mile as fascinating as the last.
What You’ll See:
Some of the highlights along the route include:
‣ Ho’okipa Beach Park
‣ Paia
‣ Ke’anae Peninsular
‣ Wai’anapanapa Park, Black Sand Beach
‣ Hana
‣ Hamoa Beach
‣ Wailua Falls
‣ Twin Falls
‣ Upper Waikanai Falls (3 Bears)
‣ Pools of O’heo (Seven Sacred Pools)
‣ Pipiwai Bamboo Trail
IMPORTANT NOTES:
Highway #31 Backside Route: This road is not recommended for driving. Rental car insurance is void, and the road can be closed due to repairs, mudslides, or flash floods.
Mandatory Reservations: Please note that reservations are now required to visit Wai’anapanapa State Park and Black Sand Beach.

NO EXPIRY: TOURS NEVER EXPIRE—REVISIT ANYTIME.
WHAT OUR OHANA IS SAYING:
“Gypsy Guide made our trip so much more memorable.”
“We felt like we had a local guiding us all the way.”

‣ iPad Compatibility: Use an iPad with GPS (WiFi + Cellular) for full functionality.
‣ Battery: GPS drains battery—bring a car charger.

fedora-packages:csdp/csdp.description: CSDP is a library of routines that implements a predictor corrector variant of the semidefinite programming algorithm of Helmberg, Rendl, Vanderbei, and Wolkowicz. apple-macos:1598838043.description:
오피스챗(OfficeChat)은 업무는 빠르게, 정보는 안전하게 연결하는 업무 메신저입니다. 
언제, 어디서나, 어떤 기기에서도 누구나 쉽게 사용 가능하며, 여러 툴을 오갈 필요 없이 협업이 바로 이루어집니다.
하나의 메신저로 대화, 회의, 정보 공유까지 연결된 협업 환경을 경험해보세요.
■ 고객 활용 사례
*교육 기관  
“강사 간 소통 속도가 빨라지고, 수업 자료 공유와 일정 전달이 한 곳에서 해결되어 업무 효율이 크게 향상되었습니다.”
*전문 서비스 기업  
“첨부 파일 미리보기와 메시지 기반 자료 공유로 업무 확인 속도가 빨라지고, 내부 정보 관리도 더 안전해졌습니다.”
*소규모 운영 사업장  
“ 업무 프로세스 정립부터 내부 피드백까지 하나의 메신저로 처리하면서 업무 흐름이 단순해지고 커뮤니케이션 실수가 줄었습니다.”
■ 오피스챗 설명
실시간 업무 소통
- 1:1 대화 & 그룹 채팅: 자료 공유, 피드백을 실시간 소통
- 채널: 프로젝트, 주제별 대화방을 통해 체계적인 소통
- 메시지: 보고 및 요청 등 공식 커뮤니케이션 지원
- 화상회의: 화면 공유 및 캔버스 제공, 시간 제약 없이 무제한 사용
업무에 바로 쓰는 기능
- 근무 상태 표시: 외근, 휴가 등 근무 상태를 표시해 업무 가능 여부 확인
- 서비스 알림: API 연동 지원하여 외부 시스템 알림까지 통합 확인
- 메모: 중요 업무 자료 및 아이디어 정리
- 보관함: 주고받은 파일, 링크 자동 정리 및 빠른 검색 가능
조직 기반 소통 환경
- 공지: 전사 중요 정보를 구성원에게 효과적으로 전달
- 캘린더: 팀, 전사 일정 통합 확인 및 관리
- 게시판: 사내 다양한 정보와 소식을 체계적 전달 및 관리
- 설문: 일정 조율 및 피드백 수집 시 사용

Cerebral’s national network of licensed and credentialed mental health care doctors and therapists offer one-on-one personalized professional mental health care that will get you feeling better. Working directly with your doctors and therapists can help you overcome your anxiety, depression, insomnia, and more, managing your care all in one place. Cerebral’s app allows you to select your treating doctor and/or therapist, schedule your visits, and have a direct one-on-one telehealth visit with your selected healthcare professional.
Here's how it works:
· Take a short online assessment to define your symptoms.
· Choose a plan that best fits your needs and addresses your symptoms.
· Review a panel of doctors and therapists who are licensed and credentialed in your state and available to provide care directly to you
· Choose a healthcare professional who best suits your needs
· Set up regular synchronous tele mental health care video visits or phone chats with your licensed/credentialed mental health care professional and care team

· Participate in your one-on-one telehealth visit through video or phone with your licensed/credentialed mental health care professional on your schedule
· Contact your care team with questions about scheduling, medications & more
· Track medication refills, if clinically indicated and prescribed
· Monitor your progress
· Access mindfulness, self-care, & CBT (cognitive behavioral therapy) exercises
 Cerebral’s national network of licensed, credentialed, trained, and experienced mental health care doctors and therapists make direct one-on-one high-quality mental health care accessible and affordable to anyone, anywhere. Our healthcare professionals offer a safe, non-judgmental space for you to be heard and get the professional care you need. To date, our licensed/credentialed tele mental health care professionals have helped over 250,000 patients through their mental health journey. Now it's your turn.

apple-macos:6826141205.description:
Proxya is a utility that connects your iPhone to SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies. Add a proxy and every app on the phone works through it: browsers, messengers and games, with UDP and QUIC when the proxy carries them.
Add any SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy by hand, by pasting a line or by scanning a QR code. Keep a list of proxies, check them and switch between them in one tap.
THE WHOLE PHONE THROUGH THE PROXY
- SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies, TCP, UDP and QUIC, IPv4 and IPv6
- DNS is answered inside the tunnel, so site names do not leak past the proxy
- Kill Switch and auto-connect after a network change or a restart
- Private DNS through the proxy: Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or AdGuard with ad blocking
MASKING
The handshake with the proxy and the site name go out in two parts with a short pause, which makes it harder for the network in between to see where you connect. On by default.
CHECKS
Ping and UDP for every proxy, your current IP address and country, and a full anonymity check one tap away.
WITH A PROXYA ACCOUNT
- Residential, ISP, datacenter and mobile proxies from your orders, ready in one tap
- Residential IP in any country: one IP for up to 16 hours or a rotating IP, with UDP
- ISP and datacenter: OS fingerprint control, IP allow list and a new password
- Mobile proxies: change the IP now or on a timer, IPv4 or IPv6, sign-in by IP
PRIVACY
The app does not log or share the sites you open. Traffic goes from your phone straight to the proxy you chose. Proxies you add stay on this phone, with passwords in the iOS Keychain.
Proxya is a free proxy client. Use any SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy you already have, or the proxies from your Proxya account.

fedora-packages:prometheus-exporter-expo.name: prometheus-exporter-exporter
fedora-packages:prometheus-exporter-expo.summary: A reverse proxy designed for Prometheus exporters
fedora-packages:prometheus-exporter-expo.description: exporter_exporter provides a simple reverse proxy for Prometheus exporters. It is intended as a single binary alternative to Nginx or Apache for use in environments where opening multiple TCP ports to all servers might be difficult due to firewalls or policy constraints. The advantages are: * A single port can be used to query multiple exporters (to ease firewall configuration concerns). * Can provide TLS with optional client certificate authentication. * Provides verification that the target is serving prometheus metrics. * Can be used to execute scripts that produce prometheus metrics. * up behavior is the same as for querying individual collectors. * Small code size, minimal external dependencies, easily auditable.
